fdroid:com.monostr.app.name: Monostr
fdroid:com.monostr.app.summary: Nostr with Monero tips. No Lightning, no custodian, no wallet inside.
fdroid:com.monostr.app.description:
Monostr is a Nostr client for Android with tips in Monero.
 Nostr, the way you know it 
• Feed of the people you follow, threads, profiles with Posts, Replies, Reposts, Articles and Lists tabs
• Like, repost, quote, reply; mentions, hashtags and links you can tap
• Galleries of up to 20 pictures you swipe through, videos up to 2 minutes with their length shown, your own uploads (Blossom), sensitive content blurred
• Read long-form articles (NIP-23) right in the app, with likes, reposts, replies, bookmarks and tips; links to articles, live streams and other events show as cards
• Polls (NIP-88): vote and see the results, or create your own with 2 to 4 choices for up to 7 days
• Private messages (NIP-17), private bookmarks and mutes (NIP-51)
• Search for people and notes (NIP-50), notifications for likes, reposts, replies and tips
• Your relay list (NIP-65); write relays of an author are added while their profile is open
• Sign in with Amber (NIP-55), a key, or a password-protected key backup (ncryptsec, NIP-49); you can also back up your key with a password; light and dark theme, 8 languages
 Tips in Monero 
• Tip a note or a profile from your own wallet app (Unstoppable, monfluo, Cake …) through a monero: link
• Monostr holds no wallet and no spend key
• To receive tips there are two ways. Either just publish your Monero address (NIP-A3 payto): others pay from their wallet, without a receipt in Monostr
• Or you register your address and private view key with a watcher (watcher.monostr.com by default, or your own). The watcher sees your incoming payments and publishes signed tip receipts on Nostr, so everybody sees the tip on the note
• Anonymous tips are possible
 Privacy 
• Tor built in, off by default. Switched on, relays, pictures, uploads and the watcher see Tor instead of your IP address, messages and tips are checked through Tor in the background too, and nothing goes out directly while Tor is not connected
• Onion relays in your own relay list when Tor is on
• Web links ask before they open; with Tor on you can copy them to paste into Tor Browser
• Tor hides your IP address, not your account, your wallet or your browser
 Open 
Monostr is free software (AGPL-3.0-or-later). Notes, likes and reposts say “via Monostr” (off by default, can be switched on).
Tor is a trademark of The Tor Project. Monostr is not endorsed by or affiliated with the Tor Project.
Monostr is in beta.

fdroid:io.github.pastthepixels.freepaint.description:
FreePaint is a vector graphics drawing program for Android. Select a tool and turn your ideas into SVGs!
# FEATURING
- Material Design 3 with dynamic colors
- Custom document sizes, fill/stroke colors, and stroke sizes
- Eraser tool erases shapes from closed paths, or points from open paths
- Saving/loading SVG files
# Using FreePaint
## Paint tool
Using this tool, you can either draw open or closed paths. Simply go to the overflow menu > Settings to access this and more options.
## Eraser tool
When you select this tool, you can draw a shape to define the area you wish to erase. One of two things can happen depending on which path you want to erase from:
For closed paths, the entire path will become green, and you can draw a shape to erase from the path.
For open paths, individual points will become highlighted, and if those points are included in your eraser path, they will be deleted. Erasing a point inside a path will create 2 new paths.
## Pan/zoom tool
With one finger, you can pan across the document. If you pinch the screen with two, it'll zoom in and out from the center.
## Selection tool
You can draw a rectangle for an area you wish to select (marquee select). If any paths overlap that area, they will become "selected" and the rectangle will resize to include the selected paths.
You can drag on that rectangle to move those paths, or draw on an empty space to create a new selection.

fdroid:tribixbite.cleverkeys.summary: Open-source gesture keyboard with Termux support
fdroid:tribixbite.cleverkeys.description:
CleverKeys is an open-source gesture keyboard featuring a custom neural network engine, unlimited clipboard history, and extensive customization. Unlike other open-source keyboards, gesture typing works reliably everywhere — including Termux and terminal emulators.
 RELIABLE GESTURE TYPING IN TERMUX 
CleverKeys is the only open-source keyboard with stable, production-ready gesture typing that works in Termux. Other keyboards either disable gestures in terminals, produce corrupted output, or remain in alpha/experimental state. CleverKeys works everywhere — terminal emulators, SSH sessions, and developer tools.
 NEURAL NETWORK SWIPE ENGINE 
• Custom transformer neural network trained for gesture recognition
• Sub-100ms predictions with XNNPACK hardware acceleration
• 100% local processing — works offline, no cloud dependency
• Tunable beam search (width, length normalization, pruning, early stopping)
• Open training code and datasets at github.com/tribixbite/CleverKeys-ML
 208 CUSTOMIZABLE SHORT-SWIPE GESTURES 
• 8 directions × 26 letter keys = 208 one-touch gestures
• Per-key customization — assign any action to any direction on any key
• Navigation: arrow keys, home/end, page up/down
• Editing: select all, undo/redo, cut/copy/paste
• Function keys: F1-F12, Escape, Insert, Delete
• No long-press menus needed
 UNLIMITED CLIPBOARD HISTORY 
As an Input Method Editor, CleverKeys has legitimate clipboard access that other apps lack:
• Truly unlimited history (configurable by count or storage size)
• Pin important items for quick access
• Full-text search through history
• Persistent across reboots
• Export/Import for backup
 PRIVACY FIRST 
• Zero network permissions — literally cannot phone home
• No analytics, telemetry, or tracking
• No cloud sync or data collection
• All processing on-device
• Open source = fully auditable
 EXTENSIVE THEME ENGINE 
• 18+ built-in themes including Material You (Monet)
• DIY theme creator with full control over colors
• Key colors, label colors, border colors, swipe trail effects
• ePaper, Neon, Everforest, and more styles
 100+ KEYBOARD LAYOUTS 
• QWERTY, AZERTY, QWERTZ, Dvorak, Colemak
• Programming layouts with special characters
• International layouts for 30+ languages
• Customizable bottom row and modifiers
 POWER USER FEATURES 
• Terminal mode with Ctrl/Meta/Fn keys
• Backup & Restore all settings and custom data
• Layout profile import/export with gestures included
CleverKeys is a complete Kotlin rewrite of Unexpected Keyboard with neural network gesture typing, clipboard history, and per-key gesture customization added. The ML model architecture, training code, and datasets are all publicly available.

 physical models of fluid dynamics, structural mechanics, electromagnetics,
 heat transfer and acoustics, for example. These are described by partial

flathub:io.github.xfuentes.smart-video-p.name: Smart Video Processor
flathub:io.github.xfuentes.smart-video-p.description:
Smart Video Processor tidies up your movie and TV show collection. It recognizes each video
 using online databases, then renames the files so that media servers such as Jellyfin find them,
 adds posters and details, fixes the language of audio and subtitle tracks, joins or splits files
 and converts them to a lighter format, all in one place.

flathub:me.proton.Mail.name: Proton Mail
flathub:me.proton.Mail.summary: Secure email that protects your privacy
flathub:me.proton.Mail.description:
Keep your conversations private. Proton Mail is encrypted email from Switzerland. Used by millions
 worldwide, our all-new email app protects your communications and has everything you need to easily
 manage your inbox.
 The Wall Street Journal says:
 "Proton Mail offers encrypted email, which makes it virtually impossible for anyone to read
 it except the sender and the recipient."
 With the all-new Proton Mail app, you can:
 Create a @proton.me or @protonmail.com email address
 Send and receive encrypted emails and attachments with ease
 Switch between multiple Proton Mail accounts
 Easily manage your email with conversations
 Keep your inbox tidy and clean with folders, labels and simple swipe-gestures
 Receive new email notifications
 Send Password-protected Emails to anyone
 Enjoy your inbox in dark mode
 Why use Proton Mail?
 Proton Mail is free — We believe everyone deserves privacy. Upgrade to a paid plan to get
 more done and support our mission.
 Easy to use — Our all-new app has been redesigned to make it easier to read, organize, and
 write your emails.
 Your inbox is yours — We don't spy on your communications to show you targeted ads. Your
 inbox, your rules.
 Rigorous encryption — Your entire inbox is secured, on all your devices. No one can read
 your emails but you. Proton is privacy, guaranteed by end-to-end and zero-access encryption.
 Unmatched protection — We offer strong phishing, spam, and spying/tracking protection for
 all your communications.
 Industry Leading Security Features
 Messages are stored on Proton Mail servers using end-to-end encryption at all times and are
 transmitted securely between Proton servers and user devices. This largely eliminates the risk
 of message interception.
 Zero Access to Your Email Content
 Proton Mail's zero access architecture means that your data is encrypted in a way that makes
 it inaccessible to us. Data is encrypted on the client side using an encryption key that Proton
 does not have access to. This means we don't have the technical ability to decrypt your messages.
 Open-Source Cryptography
 Proton Mail's open-source software has been thoroughly vetted by security experts from around
 the world to ensure the highest levels of protection. Proton Mail only uses secure implementations
 of AES, RSA, along with OpenPGP, while all of the cryptographic libraries used are open source.
 By using open-source libraries, Proton Mail can guarantee that the encryption algorithms used do
 not have clandestinely built-in back doors.
 Proton Mail in the press:
 "Proton Mail is a Gmail-like email system which uses end-to-end encryption, making it impossible
 for outside parties to monitor." Forbes
 "A new email service being developed by a group who met at MIT and CERN promises to bring secure,
 encrypted email to the masses and keep sensitive information away from prying eyes." Huffington
 Post

flathub:net.mediaarea.AVIMetaEdit.name: AVI MetaEdit
flathub:net.mediaarea.AVIMetaEdit.summary: Embed, validate, and export AVI files metadata
flathub:net.mediaarea.AVIMetaEdit.description:
AVI MetaEdit is a tool that supports embedding, validating, and exporting of metadata in AVI files.
 This tool can also enforce file structure and metadata recommendations and specifications from U.S. National Archives, Microsoft, and IBM.
 Initially funded by NARA (National Archives and Records Administration) supported by the FADGI; designed and led by AVPreserve; developed by MediaArea.

flathub:network.loki.Session.name: Session Desktop
flathub:network.loki.Session.description:
Session is a new breed of private messenger, built on a unique network of user-operated servers
 spread all over the world. With no central servers, Session can’t leak or sell your data. And with
 Session’s private routing protocols, your messages are completely anonymous. No one ever knows
 who you’re talking to, what you’re saying, or even your IP address.
 Fully anonymous account creation: No phone number or email needed to create a Account ID
 Decentralised server network: No data breaches, no central point of failure
 No metadata logging: Session doesn't store, track, or log your messaging metadata
 IP address protection: Device IP addresses are never exposed to the person you're talking
 to or the servers holding your data
 Groups: Private, end-to-end encrypted group chats for up to 100 people
 Secure attachments: Share voice snippets, photos, and files with Session's secure encryption
 and privacy protections
 Multi-device syncing: One Account ID for your phone and computer
 Free and open-source: Don’t take our word for it — check Session's code yourself
 Session is free as in free speech, free as in free beer, and free of ads and trackers. Session
 is built and maintained by the Swiss based Session Technology Foundation. Take back your online
 privacy today — download Session.

flathub:org.gnome.Robots.name: Robots
flathub:org.gnome.Robots.summary: Avoid the robots and make them crash into each other
flathub:org.gnome.Robots.description:
It is the distant future: the year 2000. Evil robots are trying to kill you.
 Avoid the robots or face certain death.
 Fortunately, the robots are extremely stupid and will always move directly
 towards you. Trick them into colliding into each other, resulting in their
 destruction, or into the junk piles that result. You can defend yourself by
 moving the junk piles, or escape to safety with your handy teleportation
 device.
 Your supply of safe teleports is limited, and once you run out, teleportation
 could land you right next to a robot, who will kill you. Survive for as long
 as possible!

Since it has to be run on your server and have access to your private Let's Encrypt account key, I tried to make it as tiny as possible (currently less than 200 lines). The only prerequisites are python and openssl. Well, that and a web server - but then you only need this with a web server. It was implemented by David M. Mount of the University of Maryland, and Sunil Arya of the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology. ANN (pronounced like the name ``Ann'') stands for Approximate Nearest Neighbors. ANN is also a testbed containing programs and procedures for generating data sets, collecting and analyzing statistics on the performance of nearest neighbor algorithms and data structures, and visualizing the geometric structure of these data structures.

firefox-addons:1607086.name: Simplify Gmail
firefox-addons:1607086.summary: Your time and attention matter -- Simplify Gmail enhances Gmail to boost productivity, strengthen privacy, and reduce stress. From the co-founder of Google Inbox.
firefox-addons:1607086.description:
SUPERCHARGE GMAIL WITH SIMPLIFY
Brought to you by the co-founder and design lead for Google Inbox, Simplify Gmail is a browser extension for desktop Gmail that boosts productivity, strengthens privacy, and reduces️ stress by:
 ✔️ BETTER DESIGN: Hundreds of improvements (small and large) to streamline, simplify, and enhance Gmail’s design and functionality. Hide the features you don’t use, customize the ones you do including setting the list and message width and fonts.
 ✔️ BUNDLES: Group conversations with the same label or category into a single row in your inbox for easier bulk reading and processing.
 ✔️ SAVED SEARCHES: Add commonly used searches or bookmark any message to your nav for easy access. Simplify includes 24 useful searches by default like Travel, Purchases, Archived, Attachments, Notes to self, PDFs, Photos, and more.
 ✔️ PAUSE INBOX: Pause new mail or hide the inbox entirely for deep focus. Optionally disable notifications when the inbox is paused or hidden.
 ✔️ BLOCK TRACKERS: Simplify blocks over 250 email spy trackers (more than any other tracker blocker extension).
 ✔️ KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS: Navigate faster with your arrow keys, Enter (to open, then to reply), and Escape (close a message, then to return to inbox). Use familiar shortcuts like Ctrl+A / ⌘A to select all or Ctrl+Z / ⌘Z to undo. Press "?" in Gmail to see all shortcuts. Also includes advanced shortcuts like [ I ] to reply to an intro and move the sender to BCC.
 ✔️ DARK MODE: Auto-switch with OS with options to invert all of Gmail’s UI and some or all messages.
 ✔️ GROUP BY DATE: Group messages list by date with bulk actions to one-click archive or delete.
 ✔️ INBOX ZERO BACKGROUND: Choose a different background to get when you reach inbox zero. 
 ✔️ AUTO-CC/BCC: Set addresses to add to every new message and/or reply
And much more...
_________________________________________________________
PAID PLAN REQUIRED AFTER 1 MONTH TRIAL
Comes with a free 1-month trial after which a paid plan is required. Learn more and sign up when you're ready at https://simpl.fyi/plans -- Feel free to email me at hi@simpl.fyi if you want to extend your trial a week to decide.
_________________________________________________________
WHO MADE THIS?
Simplify was made by Michael Leggett ( leggett.org ), Gmail's lead designer from 2008 to 2012 and the co-founder of Google Inbox. With the unfortunate demise of Google Inbox, Leggett wanted bring the simplified email experience to Gmail. Thus, Simplify Gmail was born on April 2, 2019. 
_________________________________________________________
IS IT SAFE?
You should always be super careful what extensions or apps you use with your email.
 ✔️ Simplify always puts your security and privacy first.
 ✔️ The code for Simplify is entirely stored on your computer (no remote code) and is for the sole purpose of improving and enhancing Gmail's user interface and functionality. 
 ✖️ Simplify does NOT request full access to your email (no API permissions required).
 ✖️ None of your data is collected, stored, or sent to Simplify.
 ✖️ Simplify has no tracking or analytics software.
 ✖️ Simplify will never have ads. Ever.
_________________________________________________________
PRIVACY POLICY
Simplify's products have no ads, no analytics, no trackers, no cookies, and do not send or receive personal information of any kind from your account or device.
Your privacy and the security of your account and data is of the utmost importance to us. We aim to make software worth paying for and taking the strictest stance on privacy possible.
_________________________________________________________
HAVE FEEDBACK OR QUESTIONS?
There are over 100,000 unique combinations of Gmail’s options, features, and user states. Add in other 3rd party add-ons, different languages, browsers, screen sizes, and more and it grows to over a billion. Simplify strives to support them all, along with the more popular 3rd party extensions and add-ons. I wrote more about the complexity of building on top of Gmail here: https://on.simpl.fyi/p/complexity-of-simplify -- You can send feedback or report issues via https://simpl.fyi/support (I usually respond within one business day).

firefox-addons:991415.name: Refined Prime Video
firefox-addons:991415.summary: Simplifies the Amazon Prime Video interface and adds useful features such as the ability to hide spoilers about unwatched episodes by hiding thumbnails and descriptions.
firefox-addons:991415.description:
★ Hide spoilers 
Accidentally scrolling too far down and catching a glimpse of a spoiler sucks. Refined Prime Video allows you to hide them by blurring the thumbnails and hiding the descriptions of episodes you haven’t watched yet. You can control when that happens in the extension settings.
 ★ Continue watching 
Wanna quickly continue watching your favorite series without drowning in the sea of thumbnails of Prime Video’s home page or managing bookmarks? Just click on the Refined Prime Video icon, select the series from a list of things you’ve recently watched, and that’s it! The episode you left off at will start playing instantly.
 ★ Skip shortcut 
Seeing a trailer for a new series while watching something else is super annoying and in the time that it takes for you to move your mouse to the “Skip” button and click, the trailer has already finished playing. With Refined Prime Video all you have to do is press the “S” key on your keyboard. This works with trailers, intros, recaps, and the “Next up” countdown.
 Why does Refined Prime Video need permission X? 
 Access your data for sites in the primevideo.com domain 
 This permission is required so that the extension can modify Prime Video’s behavior and appearance.
 Access your data for sites in the amazon.com / amazon.co.uk / amazon.de / … domain 
 This permission is required because there are some regions where Prime Video is part of the Amazon website (like amazon.de/video ).
 Access browser tabs 
 This permission is required so that when you click on a series in the extension popup, a new tab can be opened.
 Disclaimer 
Prime Video is a trademark of Amazon Technologies, Inc., a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc. The author of Refined Prime Video is not affiliated with these companies.

bluejetty:00066059:ios.description:
SET YOUR PRICES, BUY, SELL, BUILD, AND MAKE CHOICES BECAUSE ONLY ONE CLAN CHIEFTAIN WILL WIN
Five clans are fighting to rule over the Isle of Skye. Only the chieftain who develops the best clan territory and trades wisely will be king! 
When leaving your castle, build up the Isle of Skye by adding green hills, perfect beaches and mountain ranges. Raise livestock, produce precious whisky, build forts and ships... Expand your territory tile by tile, pay to keep hold of your tiles or sell them to an opponent for the price you've set... Tile price setting, purchases, sales, and structures are the key to becoming the ruler of the Isle of Skye!
Every game is different and will see you developing different strategies and tactics! With changeability and easy to learn rules, Isle of Skye is the perfect game for all types of players.
Features:
• Both simple and tactical game mechanics, adapted from the award-winning Isle of Skye: From Chieftain to King board game by Andreas Pelikan & Alexander Pfister
• 1 to 5 players
• Play in single-player with challenging computer opponents, against your friends in local multiplayer, or face clans from all over the world in online mode!
• Choice of objectives: Select 4 of 16 different objectives for a unique gameplay that changes every time
• Learn the rules with our Interactive tutorial or even watch games of the top players on your device!
• Take your time in asynchronous game mode with push notifications and never miss a turn.
• See fabulous illustrations by Klemens Franz, which make for a true Scottish atmosphere!
Awards for the original board game
• 2016 UK Games Expo Best Boardgame Winner
• 2016 Tric Trac Nominee
• 2016 Kennerspiel des Jahres Winner
• 2016 Kennerspiel des Jahres Nominee
• 2016 International Gamers Award - General Strategy: Multi-player Nominee
• 2015 Meeples' Choice Nominee
• 2015 Jocul Anului în România Beginners Finalist
• 2015 Golden Geek Board Game of the Year Nominee
• 2015 Golden Geek Best Strategy Board Game Nominee
• 2015 Golden Geek Best Family Board Game Nominee
• 2015 Cardboard Republic Architect Laurel Nominee
Available languages: French, English, German, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Chinese, Italian.
To find more information about Asmodee Digital, please go to http://www.asmodee-digital.com/

CRED is a members-only app for all payment experiences.
Trusted by over 1.4 crore+ creditworthy members, CRED rewards you for the payments & good financial decisions you make.
What payments can you make on CRED?
→ Credit card bills: Check & manage credit cards without multiple credit card apps.
→ Online payments: Pay via UPI or credit card on Swiggy, Myntra & more, with CRED pay.
→ Offline payments: Scan QR codes or activate Tap to Pay for contactless payments.
→ Pay anyone: Send money to anyone through CRED, even if the recipient uses BHIM UPI, PhonePe, GPay or any other UPI app.
→ Transfer money to bank accounts: Send rent or education fees from your credit card.
→ UPI Auto Pay: Set up UPI autopay for recurring bills.
→ Pay bills: Pay utility bills, credit card bills, DTH bills, mobile recharge, house/office rent, and more. Get automatic bill payment reminders so you never miss a due.

→ Manage multiple credit cards easily
→ Track your credit score & bank balance
→ Spot hidden charges & duplicate spends
→ Get smart statements for better insights
→ Unlock exclusive rewards & privileges

→ Rent: Pay your house rent, maintenance, office rental, security deposit, brokerage, etc.
→ Education: College fees, school fees, tuition fees, etc.
→ Telecom Bills: Recharge your Airtel, Vodafone, Vi, Jio, Tata Sky, DishTV, prepaid or postpaid connections, broadband, landline, cable TV, etc.
→ Utility Bills: Electricity bills, LPG cylinder, water bill, municipal tax, piped gas bill payment online, etc.
→ Other Bills like Fastag recharge, insurance premium, loan repayment, etc.

→ To become a CRED member, you need a credit score of 750+.
→ Download CRED → Fill your name, mobile number & email ID → Get a free credit score report

→ Credit score is more than a number, it indicates your financial health
→ Keep a tab of your past scores and track your present one

→ Make predictions based on foresight & improve your CIBIL score
→ Every credit information is encrypted, monitored and protected

bluejetty:00023504:ios.name: Tuner T1
bluejetty:00023504:ios.summary: Tuner T1 is the ultimate instrument tuner, designed for precision tuning of a wide range of musical instruments. Whether you're tuning a guitar, violin, viola, bass, piano, cello, flute, or any other instrument, Tuner T1 ensures impeccable
bluejetty:00023504:ios.description:
Tuner T1 is the ultimate instrument tuner, designed for precision tuning of a wide range of musical instruments. Whether you're tuning a guitar, violin, viola, bass, piano, cello, flute, or any other instrument, Tuner T1 ensures impeccable accuracy and ease of use. Ideal for both professional musicians and beginners, this chromatic tuner app is built to handle all common instruments with incredible precision, making it an essential tool for any musician.
Key Features:
• Extremely Accurate Tuning: Tune your instrument with an exceptional level of accuracy (within ±0.1 cents), ensuring perfect pitch every time.
• Chromatic Tuner for All Instruments: Tuner T1 supports a broad range of instruments, including guitar, bass, violin, viola, cello, piano, flute, and more. Whether you're tuning strings, winds, or brass, Tuner T1 has you covered.
• Transpose Mode: Instantly transpose the tuner’s note display without affecting pitch detection - perfect for real-world playing scenarios. Supports transposing notes up or down in ½-step increments (−12 to +12). Shows written pitch for transposing instruments such as Bb Trumpet, Eb Alto Sax, F Horn, and more.
• Tone Generator: Generate reference tones over a 3-octave range. Perfect for ear training or manual tuning when needed, the tone generator covers every note you need.
• Adjustable A₄ Frequency: For those who need custom tunings, Tuner T1 allows you to change the A₄ reference frequency from the standard 440 Hz to other frequencies to suit any musical or regional style.
• Beautiful, Simple, & Easy-to-Use Interface: Tuner T1 is designed to be intuitive, allowing you to start tuning instantly without any complicated setup. It’s built with simplicity in mind while maintaining all the advanced features you need for professional-grade tuning.
• Perfect for Professional and Amateur Musicians: Whether you're a professional musician performing on stage or an aspiring player honing your skills, Tuner T1 provides the accuracy and reliability you need to ensure your instrument is perfectly in tune every time.
• Optimized for Low-Latency Performance: Our app delivers low-latency pitch detection, ensuring quick response times without sacrificing accuracy, making it a great tool for live performances or recording sessions.
• Battery-Efficient: Tuner T1 is designed to minimize battery consumption, letting you use the app for extended tuning sessions without draining your device’s power.
Why Choose Tuner T1?
Tuner T1 stands out from other tuning apps because of its superior accuracy, intelligent transpose capabilities, and low-latency pitch detection, specifically optimized for tuning a wide variety of common instruments. This app is built to cater to the needs of guitarists, violinists, pianists, and wind players using transposing instruments across different genres. With its sleek interface, customizable settings, and tone generation capabilities, Tuner T1 is not only powerful but incredibly user-friendly.
Unlock Your Musical Potential
With Tuner T1, you’re not just getting an ordinary tuner. You’re getting a tool that helps you achieve perfect pitch, fine-tune your ear, and enhance your performance. Whether you're practicing, recording, or performing live, Tuner T1 gives you the professional-level tuning accuracy you need.
Download Tuner T1 today and experience the next level of tuning accuracy for all your musical instruments!

bluejetty:00041994:ios.name: Translate
bluejetty:00041994:ios.summary: Translate lets you quickly and easily translate your voice and text between languages. Designed to be the best and easiest-to-use app for translating phrases, conversations, and even the text around you. Translate combines high-quality tran
bluejetty:00041994:ios.description:
Translate lets you quickly and easily translate your voice and text between languages. Designed to be the best and easiest-to-use app for translating phrases, conversations, and even the text around you. Translate combines high-quality translations with an intuitive design, so that translating is quick and easy.
Features
• Text translation — Text translation is fast, simple, and intuitive. All supported languages include their keyboards so you don't have to download or manually switch between them
• Dictionary - Tap a word in a completed translation to see the definition in the built-in dictionary
• Translate camera — Translate text around you using the camera view. Translate text in real-time, pause the view to zoom in for a closer look, or translate text in photos from your Photos library
• Auto Translate — Translate speech without tapping the microphone button in a conversation. Auto Translate automatically detects when you start speaking and when you stop, so the other person can just respond
• Voice translation — Translate your voice from one language to another. The app detects which of the two selected languages you're speaking and provides the translated text and audio in the other language
• Conversations — In the Conversation tab, tap the single microphone button to speak, and automatic language detection will transcribe what you say in chat bubbles on the correct side of the conversation
• Face to face view — Change the conversation view when chatting face to face so that each person can see the conversation from their own side
• Live Translation with AirPods (iPhone only) — Hear, hands-free, in your preferred language with AirPods to help you bridge language barriers in person
• On-device mode - Enable a fully offline experience in Translate and for downloaded languages. Keep your translations private without needing to turn off your internet connection
• Favorites — For phrases you use frequently and want to keep, save them to your Favorites for easy access later
• New in iOS 27: Hindi language support
Translate currently supports translation between any combination of these languages:
• Arabic
• Chinese (Mandarin, Simplified)
• Chinese (Mandarin, Traditional)
• Dutch
• English (US)
• English (UK)
• French (France)
• German (Germany)
• Hindi
• Indonesian
• Italian (Italy)
• Japanese
• Korean
• Polish
• Portuguese (Brazil)
• Russian
• Spanish (Spain)
• Thai
• Turkish
• Ukrainian
• Vietnamese
NOTE: The languages listed above are supported in the most recent operating system. Not all languages may be available in previous operating systems. Live Translation with AirPods requires an iPhone running iOS 26 paired with AirPods 4 (ANC) or AirPods Pro 2 and later and is supported in English (US, UK), French (France), German (Germany), Portuguese (Brazil), and Spanish (Spain).

**Angry Cat Gangster Crime Prank** is the ultimate open-world action game where you step into the paws of a fierce feline gangster! Roam the city, cause mayhem, and prank unsuspecting citizens in this wild cat crime adventure. 
### Rule the Streets as a Gangster Cat! 
Take control of a mischievous and fearless cat ready to dominate the city. Jump, scratch, and pounce on anything in your way. From stealing food to knocking over objects, every action adds to your reputation as the ultimate gangster cat!

Complete thrilling missions that involve stealing fish, breaking into stores, scaring people, and pulling off the funniest pranks ever. The more chaos you create, the more points you earn!

Wander through a lively city filled with interactive environments. Sneak into restaurants, run across cars, jump on rooftops, and cause mischief everywhere!

Play as a crazy gangster cat! 
 Hilarious pranks & crime-inspired missions. 
 Action-packed chases with police. 
 Open-world exploration with dynamic NPCs. 
 Intuitive controls & smooth animations. 
Get ready to unleash your inner gangster cat and turn the city into your playground! Download **Angry Cat Gangster Crime Prank** now and start the ultimate feline crime spree!

本アプリは、海外在留邦人がパスポートを電子申請する際に、「券面撮影・旅券ICチップ読み取り」「本人写真撮影」「自署写真撮影」の3つの機能を提供する外務省公式アプリです。ブラウザの海外旅券電子申請システムと連動して動作するアプリのため、本アプリを単体で起動してもエラーが表示されて動作しません。本アプリを使用するためには、オンライン在留届に登録している必要があります。 「海外旅券電子申請システム」からの起動をお願いします。本アプリをiPhoneのホーム画面から起動した場合はエラーが表示されて動作しません。
在留届の提出は、外国に住所または居所を定めて３ヶ月以上滞在する方にご提出いただいておりますが、３ヶ月未満の在留邦人の方でも電子申請を利用される場合には、在留届を提出の上、登録される必要があります。
オンライン在留届（ORRネット）のリンク　https://www.ezairyu.mofa.go.jp/RRnet/index.html
【使用方法】
① PCまたはiPhoneのブラウザでオンライン在留届にログインし、「海外旅券電子申請システム」にアクセスします。
② 「本人確認、顔写真・所持人自署の登録」メニューの「二次元コードを読み取り、アプリを起動」をクリックします。
③ PCのブラウザに表示された二次元コードをiPhoneで読み取るか、iPhoneのブラウザでリンクをタップするとアプリが起動します。
④ 券面撮影・旅券ICチップ読み取り、本人写真撮影、自署写真撮影が終わったら、アプリを閉じてブラウザで申請内容の入力を続けます。
※本アプリで撮影した写真は、暗号化されて外務省の旅券発給システムに送信されます。
※本アプリで撮影した写真はiPhoneのカメラライブラリに保存されます。
※本アプリの利用は無料ですが、通信に要する費用（データ通信料等）は、ユーザの負担となります。
■動作環境
iOS 13 以上

bluejetty:00038101:ios.description:
Control your smart kitchen and home appliances in a simple and convenient way with the Home Connect app. Download the free Home Connect app now!
Intelligently connected to your household
Get the most out of your smart home appliances from Bosch, Thermador, and Gaggenau by connecting them to the Home Connect app.
• Control and monitor your kitchen and home appliances
• Easier use of appliances – start & stop, select quick or silent options
• Get helpful notifications, e.g. when your dishwasher is finished
• Save time and energy by creating favorites
• Enable exclusive in-app features and receive software updates for your appliances
• Find recipes, recommendations, and endless cooking inspiration
Control and manage your smart appliances anywhere
Did I switch off the oven? Instead of heading back home to check, simply take a look at the app. You will see and be able to control the status of your appliance straight away with immediate access to important functionalities, whether at home or on the go.
Be aware of all that’s important
Oh, the fridge door has been left open? When do I need to descale the coffee machine? How often should I clean the oven? Important notifications and reminders regarding care and maintenance will be sent to you automatically. Even if things don’t go to plan: use the support section to contact customer service or find helpful videos and articles.
Voice-control your appliances via Amazon Alexa or Google Home
Whether it’s making coffee, preheating the oven, or starting the washing machine: Use your voice and Google Home or Amazon Alexa will take care of the rest. What’s more, you can use predefined or personalized routines for recurring tasks, like having your coffee ready at the same time each day.
Finding the best program and other little helpers
Dishwasher, dryer, oven, or cooktop – depending on the appliance and task at hand, the app can recommend the right program and ideal settings & options, whether it’s a pile of dirty dishes, a load of clothes, or the cheesecake recipe for your next family gathering. Also, with the coffee playlist, you can even fulfil your guests’ coffee needs to match that cheesecake. Found the perfect program or cycle? Store it as a favorite for quick access next time you need it.
Do you have any questions or feedback? Drop us a message at home-connect.us@Home-Connect.com, we’re happy to hear from you.

bluejetty:00032848:ios.name: Bro Royale: Top-Down Shooter
bluejetty:00032848:ios.summary: Jump into Bro Royale, the multiplayer shooter experience where every moment is packed with intense action and fierce competition. Dive into heart-pounding battles against terrorists and fellow bros in dynamic "1 vs All" and "2vs2" modes, wh
bluejetty:00032848:ios.description:
Jump into Bro Royale, the multiplayer shooter experience where every moment is packed with intense action and fierce competition. Dive into heart-pounding battles against terrorists and fellow bros in dynamic "1 vs All" and "2vs2" modes, where your shooting skill is put to the ultimate test. With an expansive arsenal of powerful firearms, strategic traps, and familiar heroes. 
Every match is more than a multiplayer PvP battle for victory, it’s a mission to liberate a world suffering in chaos and pain.
Key Features:
Immerse Yourself in Explosive Shooter Battles: Engage in adrenaline-pumping PvP & PvE shootouts, confronting global threats and engaging in intense battles with other bros for dominance.
Diverse Characters and Deadly Arsenal: Choose from a diverse roster of bros, each armed with unique skills and a lethal arsenal, poised to dominate the battlefield with precision and firepower.
Employ Tactical Shooting Strategies: Trick opponents with strategic trap placements and weapon-based combat, turning the tide of battle in your favor with calculated precision.
Fight for Victory and Domination: Dedicate yourself to the pursuit of victory, whether forging alliances with comrades or standing as the lone warrior against odds.
Embrace Co-op and Competitive Modes: Team up for cooperative triumphs or showcase your individual skill in competitive modes, engaging in heart-pounding battles against enemies and rival bros.
Enjoy Non-stop Action and Competitive Challenges: Earn epic rewards and continual upgrades to enhance your arsenal, fueling the multiplayer PvP competition and pushing your limits as a player.
Conquer Hardcore Shooter Challenges: Test your mettle in hardcore shooter challenges, confronting the most formidable adversaries in the ultimate test of marksmanship and tactics.
Compete for Glory: Ascend the ranks in our Championships and dominate the Leaderboards to claim the prestigious title of Bro Royale champion. Unlock a plenty of rewards, collect an arsenal of heroes, and customize them with unique, lethal skins. Each bro's collection of skins not only transforms their appearance but also adds to the intensity of the battlefield.
Bro Royale is an multiplayer shooter, delivering intense battles, thrilling shootouts, and fierce competition for a gaming experience like no other. Gear up, rally your comrades, and dive into the heart-pounding chaos of Bro Royale – where bros unite for glory and triumph.
Bro Royale promises action, epic rewards, and challenges that will keep you on the edge of your seat. But hold onto your weapons, because the excitement doesn't end there! Prepare for surprises and challenges that will test your skills and determination as a shooter.

bluejetty:00159725:ios.summary:
Shaw's Grocery Deals & Delivery 
Shop, save & simplify your meal planning with Shaw's all-in-one grocery app. Find everything you need, from fresh produce to pet food and pharmacy prescriptions.  Choose convenience that fits your schedule:
bluejetty:00159725:ios.description:
Shaw's Grocery Deals & Delivery 
Shop, save & simplify your meal planning with Shaw's all-in-one grocery app. Find everything you need, from fresh produce to pet food and pharmacy prescriptions.  Choose convenience that fits your schedule: grocery delivery or DriveUp & Go™ grocery pickup service. 
CONVENIENT GROCERY DELIVERY OR PICKUP 
Get grocery delivery or choose DriveUp & Go™ for easy curbside grocery pickup. Use Schedule & Save to automate your household essentials and save more on every order. Flash™ 30-minute delivery available in select markets for additional convenience. 
SEND GROCERIES AS A GIFT 
Shop, add a personalized message & send fresh groceries, flowers, chocolates or everyday essentials to anyone — delivered to their door or ready for store pickup. Select "Make this order a gift" at checkout, with no extra gifting fees. It is the perfect way to care for loved ones, celebrate special occasions, send a thoughtful thank-you gift or help out a friend with a fully stocked fridge. 
MEET YOUR AI SHOPPING ASSISTANT 
Take the guesswork out of meals with Ask AI. Use everyday language to ask for recipe ideas, find items based on dietary needs or compare products. Whether you're asking "What can I make with chicken and rice?" or looking for "gluten-free snacks," our assistant helps you build your grocery list fast. 
MEAL PLANNING & RECIPES 
Get inspired with thousands of shoppable recipes designed to fit every budget and preference. Import your favorite recipes into the app to convert ingredients into a digital shopping list. Plan your weekly menu & add all necessary items to your grocery shopping list with a single tap. 
SHOP EASIER & FASTER 
Quickly add items to your cart based on frequent purchases, recommendations & past orders. View and reorder from your order history at any time. Save your favorite household items, scan barcodes at home to add products to your digital cart instantly and build repeatable shopping lists. 
LOYALTY, DEALS & COUPONS 
Maximize your budget by clipping digital coupons, tracking your reward points and watching your savings stack up automatically at checkout. Find hundreds of weekly grocery coupons, digital offers and exclusive sales. Earn, track and redeem Shaw's for U™ rewards automatically as you shop. Try FreshPass® for unlimited free grocery delivery on eligible orders, exclusive perks and subscriber-only savings. 
SECURE SNAP/EBT & WIC PAYMENT OPTIONS 
Use your SNAP/EBT benefits to easily pay for online grocery delivery and DriveUp & Go™ grocery pickup orders on eligible items, subject to state availability. WIC benefits are also accepted in store at participating Shaw's locations only. 
YOUR NEIGHBORHOOD PHARMACY & HEALTH APP 
Order eligible prescriptions in the app and pick them up curbside through DriveUp & Go™ at 1,700+ participating pharmacy locations nationwide. Transfer your prescriptions to save more on your next grocery order, refill scripts for your family or pets, schedule vaccine appointments, access health tests and manage your wellness goals with Sincerely Health. Choose to bundle your Rx with your grocery pickup in one easy trip or go pharmacy-only. 
BUILD HEALTHY HABITS 
Monitor your nutrition, steps, sleep and activity. Earn rewards as you eat better, move more and stay active through the Sincerely Health wellness hub. Take advantage of custom health insights, track your daily wellness metrics, unlock premium rewards for making positive health choices and set achievable goals that support your complete physical well-being. 
Download the Shaw's app and sign in or create your account to start shopping, saving and simplifying your week.

bluejetty:00081095:ios.description:
Widgets and Themes – Personalize Your iPhone Like Never Before
Widgets and Themes is your ultimate toolkit for transforming your iPhone’s home screen into a uniquely personalized experience. Whether you want to keep important information at your fingertips or completely redesign the look of your phone, this app offers everything you need. From smart widgets to beautifully curated themes, custom app icons to real-time system status indicators—Widgets and Themes brings functionality and aesthetics together in a seamless package.
Bring your iPhone to life with cute imagination. From widgets to themes, every detail reflects cute imagination. Personalize icons with cute imagination that makes your home screen unique. Explore wallpapers and packs designed with cute imagination. Express yourself daily through endless cute imagination styles.
--
Smart Widgets – Designed for Simplicity and Utility
Gain quick and easy access to essential information right from your home screen. Our wide range of widgets are crafted to show you what matters most without opening any apps.
-- Clock, Date, and Time Widgets Display the current time, date, and day with beautifully designed widgets that come in small, medium, and large sizes. These widgets are customizable and can even include built-in reminders and scheduled notes, making them both stylish and functional.
-- Battery Widgets Always stay updated with the status of your battery. Choose from multiple widget designs that display your battery percentage and charging status in real time. Available in various sizes, these widgets match the rest of your home screen design effortlessly.
-- Storage Widgets Keep track of your device's storage usage with detailed widgets that show both available and used storage. These widgets are a practical addition to your home screen, presented in clean, attractive formats that keep you informed at a glance.
--
Widget Library and Design Tools
Create widgets from scratch or explore the widget library to pick from pre-designed options. Whether you prefer minimal, vibrant, or futuristic styles, you’ll find widgets that match your mood and theme. Personalize them with custom fonts, colors, and layouts to make your home screen truly yours.
--
Custom App Icons – Redefine How Apps Look
Why settle for the default app icons when you can design your own? With Widgets and Themes, you can create and apply custom icons to any app. Choose from hundreds of pre-made icons included in each theme pack or create new ones from scratch. Every icon can be tailored to your preferred style, whether modern, abstract, pastel, or bold.
--
Themed Home Screen Packs
Instantly transform the look and feel of your entire home screen with professionally designed theme packs. Each theme includes a matching set of app icons, widgets, and wallpapers that work together to create a harmonious visual experience. Browse through our growing library of themes to find something that suits your personality or current vibe.
--
** Why Choose Widgets and Themes? **
- Easy to use and beginner-friendly
- Beautifully designed themes and widgets
- Seamless integration with iOS
- Real-time status updates on storage and battery
- Fully customizable app icons and layouts
- Regular updates with new designs and features

bluejetty:00180254:ios.summary:

NEW — C
bluejetty:00180254:ios.description:
Cee is the driving companion that warns you before speed cameras and radar — and now lets you drive together. See your friends live on the map, talk hands-free on a built-in walkie-talkie, and navigate to one destination as a crew.
NEW — CONVOY: DRIVE TOGETHER
Heading out in more than one car? Create a convoy, share the invite code, and drive as one crew:
• Live map with your crew as 3D cars — no one gets lost, no "where are you?" calls
• Built-in walkie-talkie: push to talk, your voice reaches the whole convoy instantly
• Shared destination: the leader sets it once and navigation starts for everyone
• Leader tools: mute members, transfer leadership, end the convoy anytime
• Free convoys for up to 4 drivers — Premium unlocks 12 seats and an open voice channel
Perfect for road trips, family travel between cities, wedding convoys, and group rides.
SPEED CAMERA & RADAR ALERTS
Instant audio and haptic warnings as you approach speed cameras, radar, and reported hazards. Smart filtering uses road-snapping and direction awareness so you only hear alerts that matter — your side of the road, on your route.
• 145,000+ camera locations in 110+ countries, updated daily
• Community-verified reports from drivers near you
• Custom alert mode per type: sound, vibration, or mute
• Works in the background while you use other apps
SMART NAVIGATION
Professional turn-by-turn navigation with traffic-aware routing, precise road-snapping, and a 2 km look-ahead preview of alerts on your route.
SPEEDOMETER & TRIPS
A clean real-time speedometer with speed limits, automatic trip tracking, and detailed driving statistics.
REWARDS
Earn XP for reports, streaks, and distance. Climb five tiers from Bronze to Diamond and collect trophies along the way.
APPLE WATCH
Get alerts as vibrations on your wrist — built for riders who can't hear their phone.
MADE FOR THE REGION, READY FOR THE WORLD
English, Kurdish (Sorani), Arabic, and Turkish with full right-to-left support. Community-powered coverage that's strongest where other apps are weakest.
Download Cee — never miss a camera, never lose your crew.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

• Upload Any PDF – No file size limits, no restrictions.
• Chat with Your Document – Ask questions and get direct, AI-powered answers.
• Summarize Pages, Sections, or Full PDFs – Perfect for quick insights or deep dives.
• Find Specific Information Instantly – Ask about keywords, references, page numbers, and data points.
• Analyze Documents with AI – Let AI do the heavy lifting in extracting important content.
Save Time & Boost Productivity

• Learn Faster & Retain More – AI-enhanced reading experience for better comprehension.
• Make Smarter Decisions – Quickly find relevant details in contracts, reports, and policies.

Download ChattyPDF AI Today!
Join thousands of users saving time and getting smarter with AI-powered document insights.
• Stay Updated – New features are added regularly.

• Enjoying ChattyPDF AI? Leave a review and help others discover this game-changing document assistant.

bluejetty:00123855:ios.name: Dragon King:Fish Table Online
bluejetty:00123855:ios.summary:
Dragon King Fishing Game Online is a complete set of mesmerizing online fish games and slot games.
Dragon King 2 : Golden Dragon Awaken is the latest in the Ocean King fish hunting series. It is loaded with all-new characters and game fea
bluejetty:00123855:ios.description:
Dragon King Fishing Game Online is a complete set of mesmerizing online fish games and slot games.
Dragon King 2 : Golden Dragon Awaken is the latest in the Ocean King fish hunting series. It is loaded with all-new characters and game features that both first-time and experienced Fish hunters will enjoy.In Dragon King 2 , one and four players can battle it out to catch as many of the 28 fish characters as possible within the game’s timeframe. features include high quality 3D graphics, under the sea themes, more fish characters .
Features
The features in Dragon King Fishing Online : Golden Dragon Awaken include:
1.Fast Bombs
Players are able to catch fish within the limited time.
2.Fire Storm
When pressing the SHOOT button in quick succession, you can increase the attack speed.
The final scores will be multiplied by the multiplying value as the result.
3.Lightning Chain
Fish species will appear as Lightening Fish.
Lighting Fish can be: flying fish, clown fish, butterfly fish, fugu, lionfish, flatfish, lobster, spearfish and octopus.
Catching a Lightning Fish will trigger a Lightning Chain.
Lightning Chain will continue to catch fish automatically until time runs out.
4.Vortex Fish
Fish species will appear as Vortex Fish.
Vortex Fish can be: flying fish, clown fish, butterfly fish, fugu, lionfish, flatfish, lobster, spearfish, octopus, lantern fish, sea turtle and saw shark. Catching a Vortex Fish will suck all fish of the same species in the area into a whirlpool.
5.Emperor Crab 
Catching the Emperor Crab – Power Up summons waves of multiple crabs to attack all the fish in the sea with a lightning attack.
This gives you a chance to multiply your win.
6.Almighty Octopus 
Catching the Almighty Octopus summons the tentacles of the Almighty Octopus to attack all the fish in the sea.
This gives you a chance to multiply your win.
7.Fire Dragon Turtle 
Catching the Fire Dragon Turtle – Power Up causes the Fire Dragon Turtle to explode attacking all the fish in the sea.
This gives you a chance to multiply your win.
8.Darkness Monster 
Catching the Darkness Monster – Power Up can summon seven waves of giant Lantern Fish to attack all the fish in the sea.
This gives you a chance to multiply your win.
9.Ancient Crocodile 
Catching the Ancient Crocodile – Power Up summons waves of giant crocodiles to attack all the fish in the sea.
This gives you a chance to multiply your win.
Mini Games
The mini games in Dragon King 2 : Golden Dragon Awaken include:
Super Bomb Crab
Catching a Bomb Crab will trigger the chained bomb attack in a wide explosion.
It may give players a chance to help catch fish within.
Laser Crab
You will get one shot using a laser beam for a limited time.
Drill Crab
When a Drill Crab is caught it fires drills, penetrating the area and may have a chance to catch the fish.
The drill explodes after a while, and may also give you a chance to catch the fish within the explosion range.
Roulette Crab
Golden Roulette is a bonus game. You press the SHOOT button to stop the roulette.
The bigger the roulette number, the higher the score.
The Fish
There are 8boss Fish characters in Dragon King 2 : Golden Dragon Awaken, including:
Almighty Octopus , Emperor Crab , Darkness Monster , Ancient Crocodile ,Flaming Dragon,Fire Kirin,River Sweeps,VPower Dragon

bluejetty:00162665:ios.description:
МедТочка помогает найти врача рядом, выбрать специалиста по отзывам и записаться на приём. Семейные профили, электронная медкарта, дневники здоровья, женский календарь и онлайн-консультации помогают заботиться о себе и близких.
Создавайте семейные профили, записывайте родных к врачу и управляйте их записями. В электронной медкарте можно хранить результаты обследований, заключения, назначения и другие медицинские документы. Информация защищена шифрованием, нужный документ можно показать врачу прямо с телефона или отправить заранее.
Дневники здоровья помогают наблюдать за самочувствием между приёмами и видеть динамику. Отмечайте давление, уровень сахара и приступы мигрени — эти записи помогут подготовиться к консультации и дать врачу полную картину. В женском календаре удобно следить за циклом, отмечать симптомы и изменения в самочувствии.
С МедТочкой вы также можете:
— Получать напоминания о предстоящих приёмах.
— Просматривать историю записей и записываться повторно.
— Сохранять врачей и клиники в избранное.
— Переносить или отменять запись.
— Консультироваться с врачом онлайн.
— Общаться с врачом в чате после приёма.
— Делиться с врачом медкартой и дневниками здоровья.
— Оставлять отзывы после приёма.

Encontre passagens aéreas baratas comparando preços de vários sites de viagem e agências. Escolha até quatro datas de ida e quatro de volta e receba um alerta quando o preço baixar. É fácil e rápido!

Voopter é o app ideal para você, que quer viajar muito e gastar menos. A Voopter te ajuda a economizar nas passagens e gastar com o que realmente interessa: as experiências!

Selecione os detalhes mais cômodos para você, como datas e local de partida, crie alertas de preços personalizados e acompanhe as promoções e preços especiais! Encontre os melhores preços das principais companhias aéreas, como GOL, LATAM, Azul, TAP e United, em diversos sites de viagem e agências parceiras. Já sabe qual seu próximo destino?

Viaje mais pelo Brasil e pelo mundo com a Voopter! Encontre a passagem ideal para viagens nacionais ou internacionais. Aproveite para conhecer o Brasil, as praias do Nordeste, visitar São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Curitiba, Minas Gerais, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Norte e todos os estados do nosso país! Ou embarque para os Estados Unidos, México, Europa, Chile, Uruguai, Austrália, Canadá, Japão, um mundo de ofertas e opções para viajar por todos os continentes com ofertas imperdíveis!

**Achados de passagens:** Veja ofertas de passagens aéreas selecionadas na aba Achados e receba um aviso no celular quando surgir um novo achado.

**O que falam da Voopter?**

"Um agregador de ofertas de passagens aéreas que busca facilitar a pesquisa de preços dos usuários" - Exame

"Economize nas passagens aéreas e seja avisado quando preços baixos surgirem" - TecMundo

Gostou do Voopter? Suas sugestões e observações são muito importantes para nós. Escreva para suporte@voopter.com se tiver dúvidas, dificuldade para usar o aplicativo ou encontrar algum erro. Obrigado! :)

bluejetty:00062663:ios.description:
The new SchoolMessenger app gives busy parents, students, and staff a powerful way to stay engaged with their school or district, and connect to each other.
App Features:
- Easy-to-read inbox that captures all SchoolMessenger notifications, and now two-way teacher-parent-student messages (if enabled by school or district)

- Detailed preference control allows adjusting notification settings
- Push notifications are available for alerts when school or district sends a message

- For notifications, valid email address on file with your school or district
- WiFi or data plan for internet access
- iOS 14+
Note: 
SchoolMessenger app is not for sending broadcast messages. If you are a SchoolMessenger Communicate notification customer looking to send broadcast messages, please download the SchoolMessenger Admin sender app.

bluejetty:00157705:ios.description:
Looking for a smart receipt organizer and inventory management app?
Look no further than Categorizr – the all-in-one receipt organizer, spending tracker, and inventory management app – Try it now!
With this application you can:
• Automatically upload eReceipts to the App using your @categorizr.com email account
• Scan, organize, and save all your receipts, and never lose or misplace another one again
• Track details of your home and business inventory
• Keep track of your insurance policies and maintain a record of your assets
• Capture specific information for warranty claims
• Tag items to sell, donate, repair, and more
• Generate PDF reports of receipts (your accountant will like this!) and inventory
Categorizr respects the environment and your health – With this application, users can help reduce the use of paper receipts and companies can minimize their carbon footprint. Using Categorizr will also keep customers and cashiers healthier by removing the need for paper receipts and reducing contact with harmful chemicals often coated on paper receipts.
As the smartest shopping organizer and inventory management app, Categorizr’s features include:
• FREE @categorizr.com email account that allows you to send eReceipts to the App automatically
• Quick Add Receipt feature that allows you to save receipts by taking a photo and converting them into searchable digital copies
• Add Item feature that allows you to add items in a snap
• Predefined Categories, Locations, and Tags that allow you to get started right away
• Customizable Categories and item descriptions, allowing you to include details such as serial number, purchase date, warranty, and other information you feel is important to save
• Add multiple photos and save important documents such as warranty info, owner manuals, and product registrations to any item
• Add photos of your NFT and any digital assets in your portfolio
• Store Driver, Vehicle, and Property Information for quick reference
• Email, print, and share item photos and important documents
• Filter your info and create PDF reports
• View summary and detailed item lists, including item count and total purchase price
• Powerful searching and sorting tools so that you can retrieve information quickly
• Export data as a PDF or CSV file and send it to your accountant when it’s tax time
• And many more features!
Organize your life, download Categorizr today – the smartest all-in-one receipt organizer and inventory management app!

bluejetty:00187525:ios.summary: Whether you're driving for an approved rideshare or delivery service or in need of a flexible car rental option, KINTO empowers you to take the wheel. Apply in minutes and get approved in days, then with a few taps on your phone, search for
bluejetty:00187525:ios.description:
Whether you're driving for an approved rideshare or delivery service or in need of a flexible car rental option, KINTO empowers you to take the wheel. Apply in minutes and get approved in days, then with a few taps on your phone, search for availability, reserve your car, and unlock it, all at your convenience. Experience the freedom of renting affordable vehicles on a weekly basis from all locations. Hourly and daily offerings are available at participating locations in the Dallas, Texas, area. 
Our service is available in Napa, California, and throughout Southern California. If you want to rent a car in Texas, you will find many lots in the Dallas and Houston, Texas, areas. Whether you're looking for an electric, hybrid, fuel-efficient car, van, or SUV, we've got the perfect vehicle to suit your needs.  
With KINTO, you can bid farewell to the uncertainty of car payments, unexpected repairs, and insurance costs. We've got your back with comprehensive vehicle insurance, maintenance, and 24/7 roadside assistance; all included in your rate. To learn more about these features, visit www.kinto-us.com. The weekly rate for non-electric vehicles includes 1,400 miles, with an overage fee of $0.25 per additional mile. For electric vehicles, 1,750 miles are included, with an overage fee of $0.25 per additional mile. 
Get started today and download the app. It's free, signing up is easy, and there are no membership fees. 
Ready to get started: 
1. Download the app to apply, complete the application, and pay the non-refundable $35 application fee. Approval traditionally takes a few days. 
2. Link your KINTO account to the approved rideshare provider, if applicable 
3. Make a reservation 
4. Use the KINTO app to start your reservation and unlock your vehicle effortlessly. No more waiting in lines or dealing with pick-up counters! 
5. Enjoy driving with KINTO 
Whether you are new to rideshare, food delivery, or package delivery or looking for a new alternative to traditional car rental services, KINTO has the perfect car. 
KINTO® is a trademark of Toyota Motor Credit Corporation. KINTO® is currently serving California and Texas. Not all products and services are available in all geographic areas. Drivers must be at least 25 years old and meet driving record and criminal background check requirements. Additional terms and restrictions apply. The KINTO carshare program, including any benefit provided in connection with the program, is subject to suspension or termination by KINTO in its sole discretion without prior notice. Pricing may vary by location and vehicle type.

bluejetty:00187677:ios.name: I-Ching App of Changes
bluejetty:00187677:ios.summary: Simply the best. Whether you're new to the I Ching or have used the book as an oracle, an aid to creativity, or a mirror of your subconscious, you'll love the clarity of writing, the intuition in the design, and the simplicity of use of thi
bluejetty:00187677:ios.description:
Simply the best. Whether you're new to the I Ching or have used the book as an oracle, an aid to creativity, or a mirror of your subconscious, you'll love the clarity of writing, the intuition in the design, and the simplicity of use of this digital I Ching or Yi Jing. The modern, no-nonsense interface delivers new users straight to the basics: you ask a question, the I-Ching answers. For old souls who know the book well this app holds a wealth of features for deeper research. There's a journal where you can save and search your questions and readings, a notes area where you can record any length of text as context, a lookup library organized by number and trigram. You can recreate any I Ching reading using decimal notation. Cast a line at a time, an entire hexagram with a button press, or shake the phone gently to cast virtual coins. Original Chinese text and the Legge Translation included in an alternative selectable library. 
The I Ching software engine emulates precisely the ancient yarrow stalk method, which was slightly more likely to cast yang than yin. A changing yin line is very rare using stalks, but of equal probability to changing yang using coins. The ancient divination method uses stalks rather than coins. 
If you prefer to count your own stalks or cast your own coins there's a manual hexagram builder to look up and record your results. 
The wisdom and philosophy of the ancient Chinese texts blend seamlessly with commentaries that gently mix a dash of modern poetry, a pinch of humor, and cultural grace notes from the worlds of art, music, divination, literature and Human Design to bring you what many daily users have called the very best I-Ching app available. 
---------
Among my favourite reviews: 
"Of all the versions I've used, your renderings of the Book of Changes are my heart-felt favorites. They have inspired me, made me laugh and cry and everything in between."
“Pretty profound! This Iching app gave me spot-on advice. I've never paid for an app before, but I had a strong urge to get this one. I'm impressed! Not to sound all new-age but I totally laughed out loud at the reading it gave me, it was like it was sitting here looking over my shoulder and telling me exactly what I needed to know about my grumpy husband. P.S. Grumpy husband called and apologized..."
"Carl Jung would have been happy to have this Yi Jing on his phone - great to use, unfussy, untechy, respectful of the original. The journal feature is great for storing readings and referring back. Well done!"
---------
All of us sometimes need a sympathetic ear and wise guidance, whether it's in matters of romance or finance: the I-Ching can become a companion along life’s journey like no other. It's a book that helps you explore questions and, if you're lucky, find answers: Whether you believe it's because the book is an oracle or the answers are simply unearthed from your subconscious -- the book's true magic lies in its ability to be a helpful guide (sometimes astoundingly so) to all these different forms of curiosity. 
Following the tradition of Baynes and countless interpreters of the original texts, I've written commentaries which borrow words and inspiration from a multitude of sources: Bob Dylan, Lao Tzu, Doctor Who, the Tarot, T.S. Eliot, Emily Dickinson, John Lennon, Maya Angelou, the Grateful Dead and Martin Luther King all make appearances. The language, unlike so many translations, makes every attempt to be gender-neutral when it's not gender-specific.
I wanted the sparest interface possible. No fake parchment backgrounds, no gimmicky images of bamboo or cartoon sages with oracles and winning lottery numbers.
I strived to create a quiet, reflective, slowed down experience in an environment that normally shouts.
I hope you enjoy using this I-Ching app as much as I enjoy crafting it, improving it, and hearing from people who have found it helpful in their lives.

bluejetty:00168470:ios.description:
PlantSaver is your trusted companion at all times!
Through our app's features, you'll be able to identify the plant in front of you, determine the ideal watering schedule for your flowers, access proper care plans, and understand the reasons behind dry leaves on your plants.
We offer numerous features designed to assist novice owners:
Watering Calculator
This tool helps you accurately determine the watering needs of your beloved plants. Simply answer a few questions about your plant's condition, and you're all set!
Disease Diagnosis
Revive your ailing plant! If you're wondering why your plant no longer appears healthy, it could be due to an incorrect care plan or illness. PlantSaver can investigate with just a few clicks! Take a picture of your sickly plant, and the PlantSaver app will help you confirm its health status, identify any diseases, and provide guidance on how to treat and prevent them. Become a true plant expert with PlantSaver.
Care Plans
Plant maintenance becomes even more effortless with our Care Plans. Access a plan for nearly any plant species, from common houseplants to exotic varieties. Whether your Aloe Vera needs improvement or you're unsure about how to care for your new Money Tree, easily access comprehensive instructions on watering, fertilization, lighting, and even pruning to help them thrive!
Care Notifications
Our users confirm that our plant care app simplifies daily routines! Rest assured, we'll send you reminders to ensure all your green companions adhere to their watering and fertilization schedules.
PlantSaver is your best companion for plant care, whether you're a beginner or a seasoned enthusiast. We simplify plant care, helping you understand your plants better, keep them healthy, and ensure they thrive. With our app, you can easily navigate watering, diagnose plant issues, access care plans, and receive timely reminders. Let PlantSaver change your plant care routine to make it enjoyable and rewarding. Grow a lush, vibrant garden quickly with PlantSaver by your side.
Terms of Use: https://plantsaver.app/terms-and-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://plantsaver.app/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00040963:ios.name: Maturi App
bluejetty:00040963:ios.summary: Conheça o aplicativo da Maturi! Conecte-se a uma comunidade vibrante de profissionais 50+, onde você encontra atualização, networking e novas oportunidades de trabalho. Participe de eventos, mentorias e cursos exclusivos que podem transform
bluejetty:00040963:ios.description:
Conheça o aplicativo da Maturi! Conecte-se a uma comunidade vibrante de profissionais 50+, onde você encontra atualização, networking e novas oportunidades de trabalho. Participe de eventos, mentorias e cursos exclusivos que podem transformar sua carreira. Faça o download e inicie essa jornada incrível!
Na nossa comunidade, você encontrará:
Discussões Diárias: Participe de conversas sobre mercado de trabalho, empreendedorismo, mudança de carreira, tecnologia e outros temas relevantes. Troque ideias e mantenha-se atualizado com as últimas tendências.
Cursos e Workshops: Acesse uma diversidade de conteúdos desenvolvidos especialmente para profissionais 50+, focando em tecnologia, desenvolvimento pessoal e inovação.
Networking: Conecte-se com outros profissionais e amplie sua rede de contatos por meio de eventos virtuais e fóruns de discussão.
Oportunidades de Trabalho: Explore vagas e projetos freelance que correspondem às suas habilidades, com anúncios exclusivos de empresas parceiras.
Mentoria: Aprenda com especialistas ou compartilhe seu conhecimento como mentor, contribuindo para a formação de novas gerações profissionais.
Empreendedorismo: Acesse recursos e suporte para iniciar ou expandir seu negócio, além de participar de discussões focadas na área.
Tecnologia: Atualize-se sobre tendências tecnológicas e descubra como aplicá-las em sua vida pessoal e profissional.
Desenvolvimento Pessoal: Envolva-se em atividades que promovem autoconhecimento e empoderamento, ajudando a aumentar sua confiança.
Eventos e Palestras: Fique por dentro da agenda de eventos online e presenciais, incluindo workshops e feiras de emprego voltadas para o público 50+.
Classificados: Publique e encontre anúncios de serviços e oportunidades para facilitar colaborações entre os membros.
Biblioteca de Recursos: Acesse artigos, vídeos e guias sobre desenvolvimento pessoal, empreendedorismo e tecnologia.
Suporte e Orientação: Receba ajuda de especialistas e tire suas dúvidas com nossa equipe e comunidade.
Curadoria de Notícias: Mantenha-se atualizado com notícias relevantes e estudos de caso inspiradores.
Lives e Webinars: Participe de discussões ao vivo sobre temas como empreendedorismo e tecnologia, interagindo com especialistas e membros.
Benefícios Exclusivos: Aproveite descontos e ofertas especiais em produtos e serviços de parceiros da Maturi.
Benefícios de Participar da Comunidade Maturi:
Aprendizado Contínuo: Fique por dentro das novidades em sua área.
Valorização da Experiência: Um espaço onde seu conhecimento é reconhecido.
Inclusão Digital: Ferramentas para navegar no mundo digital com confiança.
Suporte Especializado: Acesso a aconselhamento para sua jornada profissional.
Junte-se à Maturi e faça parte de uma comunidade que acredita que o aprendizado e o crescimento não têm idade. Transforme o mercado de trabalho e promova uma sociedade mais inclusiva.
Por que escolher a Maturi?
Especialização: Conteúdos e oportunidades personalizadas para o público 50+.
Comunidade Ativa: Mais de 200 mil membros engajados.
Reconhecimento: A Maturi é referência em diversidade etária no Brasil.
Baixe agora o app da Maturi e descubra todas as oportunidades que esperam por você! Sua próxima grande chance está a um clique de distância!

With PulseMate, you can easily log daily heart rate records and other wellness information, v
bluejetty:00097114:ios.description:
PulseMate is a simple and intuitive wellness app designed to help you record, organize, and review your personal health-related data in one place.
With PulseMate, you can easily log daily heart rate records and other wellness information, view trends over time, and build better awareness of your body through consistent tracking.
Key Features
- Heart Rate Records
 Log your heart rate data and review changes over time.
- Wellness Data Tracking
 Record information such as blood pressure, blood sugar, body weight, and related metrics manually for personal reference.
- Insights & Trends
 Visual charts help you understand patterns and changes across your recorded data.
- Local Data Storage
 Your records stay on your device, giving you full control over your data.
- Simple & Clean Design
 A distraction-free interface makes daily recording quick and easy.
PulseMate is built for users who want a lightweight and private way to keep track of wellness-related information without complexity.
Subscription Information
PulseMate offers optional subscription plans that unlock all premium features, including access to advanced insights and more metrics.
- Subscription options include weekly and yearly plans.
- A 3-day free trial may be available for eligible subscriptions.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase or after the free trial ends.
- Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your Account Settings.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when a subscription is purchased.
DISCLAIMER
- PulseMate is not a medical device and is not intended for medical use.
- The app does not provide medical advice and should not be used for diagnosis, treatment, or prevention of any disease or medical condition.
- All data and insights provided by PulseMate are for informational and personal wellness purposes only.
- Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical guidance.
Privacy Policy: https://pulsemate.quantagarage.com/static/pulsemate/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://pulsemate.quantagarage.com/static/pulsemate/terms-of-use.html

Czytasz ebooka, ale chcesz dokończyć historię w f
bluejetty:00187706:ios.description:
Zyskaj dostęp do ponad 240 000 ebooków, audiobooków i podcastów. Czytaj i słuchaj ulubionych tytułów w jednej z najpopularniejszych aplikacji z książkami w Polsce.
 - Nowość: funkcja Switch
Czytasz ebooka, ale chcesz dokończyć historię w formie audio? Dzięki Switch przełączysz się między czytaniem a słuchaniem tej samej książki w dowolnym momencie - aplikacja zapamięta miejsce, w którym skończyłeś/-aś, i przeniesie je między formatami w obie strony, bez utraty postępu. Funkcja dostępna dla abonamentów Go Max, Go Smart oraz abonamentu bibliotecznego, dla tytułów obsługujących Switch.
 - Słuchaj audiobooków i podcastów, gdziekolwiek jesteś
Na siłowni, podczas biegania, sprzątania, spaceru, jazdy samochodem czy przed snem - audiobooki i podcasty będą towarzyszyć Ci wszędzie. Rozwijaj swoje umiejętności lub daj się porwać pasjonującej historii, nie tracąc ani chwili.
 - Tryb samochodowy
Słuchaj bezpiecznie podczas jazdy dzięki Apple CarPlay.
 - Słuchanie do snu
Ustaw wyłącznik czasowy, który automatycznie wyłączy aplikację - idealnie na dobranoc.
 - Dostosuj tempo słuchania
Lektor czyta zbyt wolno lub za szybko? Wybierz idealną prędkość odtwarzania - wolniejszą, normalną lub przyspieszoną.
 - Słuchaj w streamingu lub offline
Nie potrzebujesz dostępu do internetu - słuchaj offline, np. w samolocie, metrze czy pociągu.
 - Czytaj tak, jak lubisz - na telefonie, tablecie lub czytniku
Aplikacja Empik Go oferuje intuicyjny czytnik e-booków dostępny na smartfony, tablety i czytniki. Możesz pobrać aplikację na swój czytnik Kindle, PocketBook, inkBOOK lub korzystać z dedykowanego czytnika GoBook, który automatycznie synchronizuje się z Twoją biblioteką.
 - Personalizuj swój sposób czytania
Dostosuj rozmiar czcionki, styl i kolor tła. Dodawaj zakładki, notatki i zaznaczaj ważne fragmenty - wszystko po to, by uczynić czytanie jeszcze przyjemniejszym.
 - Stwórz własną bibliotekę i korzystaj z rekomendacji
Otrzymuj spersonalizowane sugestie i polecenia dopasowane do Twojego gustu.
 - Strefy tematyczne - łatwiej znajdziesz to, co lubisz
Przy tak dużym i stale rosnącym katalogu odnalezienie kolejnej wartej uwagi książki bywa wyzwaniem. Dlatego porządkujemy ofertę Empik Go w strefy tematyczne, dopasowane do Twoich zainteresowań i potrzeb - m.in. Strefę Wyobraźni, Słuchowiska oryginalne, Strefę Rozwoju oraz Klub Czytelnika.
 - Społeczność czytelników
Czytaj opinie innych użytkowników, dodawaj własne recenzje i polecaj ulubione tytuły znajomym - jednym kliknięciem.
 - Synchronizacja z empik.com
Wszystkie ebooki i audiobooki zakupione w empik.com automatycznie pojawią się w Twojej aplikacji Empik Go.
 - Tryb dziecięcy / Kids Mode - Strefa Wyobraźni
Przełącz aplikację na Tryb Dziecięcy i oddaj dziecku dostęp do bezpiecznego świata bajek i opowieści:
 - Tylko treści dla dzieci, w odpowiednich kategoriach wiekowych
Tysiące bajek, słuchowisk i ebooków
Możliwość ustawienia drzemki i słuchania do poduszki
Ty ustawiasz PIN kontroli rodzicielskiej i masz pełną kontrolę
Kategorie, które pokochasz:
Kryminał i sensacja - odkrywaj mroczne tajemnice, intrygi i śledztwa, które trzymają w napięciu do ostatniej strony
Fantastyka i sci-fi - przenieś się do innych światów, w których wszystko jest możliwe
Dla dzieci i młodzieży - bajki, opowieści edukacyjne i literatura młodzieżowa
Biografie i reportaże - historie znanych ludzi i spojrzenie na świat oczami reporterów
Literatura faktu i obyczajowa - opowieści inspirowane życiem, które poruszają i skłaniają do refleksji
Lektury szkolne i języki obce - pomoc naukowa, klasyka literatury i wsparcie w nauce języków
Pobierz aplikację i zyskaj dostęp do jednej z najszerszych ofert na rynku
Zaloguj się danymi z empik.com lub zarejestruj się w kilka sekund.
Korzystaj z wbudowanego czytnika ebooków i odtwarzacza audiobooków.
Ciesz się swobodą czytania i słuchania - gdziekolwiek jesteś!
