bluejetty:00151938:ios.description:
Christmas JigSlide Tile Puzzle – A Cozy Holiday Sliding Puzzle Game
Step into the warmth of Christmas with a relaxing new way to enjoy sliding puzzles!
In Christmas JigSlide Tile Puzzle, slide and rearrange tiles to restore beautiful holiday pictures filled with Santa Claus, snowy winter scenes, Christmas trees, gifts, reindeer, ornaments, and festive decorations.
Simple to learn yet satisfying to master, every puzzle combines relaxing gameplay with light logic and observation challenges. Move each tile carefully, reveal the complete picture, and enjoy the rewarding feeling of bringing a Christmas scene back together piece by piece.
How to Play
– Slide tiles into the correct positions with simple, intuitive controls
– Observe the picture and plan each move carefully
– Rearrange the mixed tiles until the full Christmas image is restored
– Complete puzzles and continue through increasingly challenging levels
Key Features
– Beautiful Christmas puzzle pictures featuring Santa, snow, gifts, trees, reindeer, ornaments & more
– Classic sliding tile puzzle gameplay that is easy to understand and satisfying to play
– Progressive difficulty with relaxing early levels and more challenging puzzles as you continue
– Cozy HD holiday visuals designed to bring the warmth of Christmas to every puzzle
– Simple controls and smooth gameplay for an easy, comfortable puzzle experience
– Relaxing logic and brain challenges that encourage observation, focus, and spatial thinking
– No complicated rules — simply slide, solve, relax, and enjoy
– Perfect for quick puzzle breaks or longer relaxing play sessions
Perfect For
– Fans of sliding puzzles, tile puzzles, logic games, and relaxing brain games
– Players who love Christmas, winter scenes, Santa Claus, gifts, snow, and festive decorations
– Anyone looking for a calm and rewarding puzzle experience
– Players who enjoy beautiful holiday images while giving their brain a gentle challenge

Slide the tiles, solve the picture, and celebrate the season one puzzle at a time.
Download Christmas JigSlide Tile Puzzle now and start your relaxing Christmas puzzle journey!

bluejetty:00160077:ios.name: Weave Chat AAC
bluejetty:00160077:ios.summary:
Weave Chat AAC is a free, dynamic, and completely customizable AAC app that is available to a variety of devices. 
There are over 3,500 pre-configured words with a symbol library including more than 65,000 symbols that you can choose from.
bluejetty:00160077:ios.description:
Weave Chat AAC is a free, dynamic, and completely customizable AAC app that is available to a variety of devices. 
There are over 3,500 pre-configured words with a symbol library including more than 65,000 symbols that you can choose from.
Weave Chat AAC offers a large variety of verbs (green), pronouns (yellow), questions (purple), nouns (tan/orange), adjectives (blue), and conversational words (pink). All color choices were made based on the Fitzgerald Key and new vocabulary is added weekly. 
Users can add their own custom images and categories in Settings —> Manage Custom Images.
In addition, users can add their own custom phrases that can easily be accessed from their board; to add phrases, go to Settings —> Manage Phrases. 
Users can select a synthetic voice (dependent on their device settings) from Settings —> Change Voice Settings - here you can select your voice, vocal pitch, and rate of speech.
Image and text size can be personalized from Settings —> Change Image & Text Size (select from default - small, medium, and large). Settings —> Configure Image Keyboard allows the user to turn on/off features that allow for the category text to be read aloud (synthetic voice for categories), to keep the user in the category after a image has been selected (stay on category after image selection), and disable the speech output for individual words so that it only reads aloud when the white text screen is touched (synthetic voice disabled for individual words). 
The AAC board can be modified in Settings —> Manage Board Builder. Here, the user can select from the default board (you must make a copy to edit it - to do this select “Add new keyboard” and then select “Hide Images” for Type of Keyboard); grid position boards (ranging in size from 1x2 - 7x15 rows/columns); and Board Builder (gives you the option to build a board from scratch). All boards are completely editable and all custom images and categories can be used from all boards.
Lastly, Manage Pin Configuration allows the user to set a pin over all (or just some) aspects of customization to lock down features as needed.
Feature List:
- Dynamic, customizable, AAC boards
- Large variety of verbs, nouns, and adjectives with additional vocabulary added weekly
- Add custom images and custom categories
- Create and save phrases
- Select a synthetic voice (as available per your device settings)
- Copy & Paste AAC picture icon messages via “share”
- Create and/or modify AAC boards via 3 options: grid position boards (ranging from 1x2 - 7x15), hide images, and/or create a new board from scratch
- “Text” others who have the app using AAC picture icons
- Set a passcode to lock down features as needed
- Weave Chat AAC currently only has English buttons/images

bluejetty:00039888:ios.description:
Shini Markets is the largest hypermarket chain in Palestine that meets “Palestinian Consumers’ Everyday Needs”. Began in 1965 with the first store opening. Today it is the leading hypermarket chain in Palestine with 11 branches across the country of Palestine and still expanding. 
Shini Markets is the first face of the Palestinian people to obtain any product they are looking for. Shini Markets continuously strive to develop service policies in their branches, providing a pleasurable shopping experience with competitive shelf pricing, special offers, contests, and raffles for its consumers. 
eShini application is a visual online store that allows its users to shop online and obtain free delivery. The application is user-friendly and allows the consumer to shop as if on-ground with easy navigation from adding items to check out of the cart. Upon installing the application you may add your personal information and address for delivery purposes and easily start your shopping journey through our app. The search feature in the app also allows the shopper to easily find what they are looking for. 
Shini Markets branches and eShini App contain several sections such as the vegetables and fresh fruits section, meat and poultry, in addition to milk and eggs, the ice cream section, canned foods, juices, household items, cleaning, and a special section for child and mother care, the roastery. Also, the branches contain a bakery that provides a wide variety of fresh eastern and western bakeries and sweets.

أسواق شيني هي الوجه الأول للشعب الفلسطيني يحصل على أي منتج يبحث عنه. تسعى Shini Markets باستمرار إلى تطوير سياسات الخدمة في فروعها ، مما يوفر تجربة تسوق ممتعة بأسعار تنافسية وعروض خاصة ومسابقات وسحوبات لعملائها.
تطبيق eShini هو متجر مرئي عبر الإنترنت يتيح لمستخدميه التسوق عبر الإنترنت والحصول على توصيل مجاني. التطبيق سهل الاستخدام ويسمح للمستهلك بالتسوق كما لو كان على الأرض مع سهولة التنقل من إضافة العناصر لإتمام الشراء من سلة التسوق. عند تثبيت التطبيق ، يمكنك إضافة معلوماتك الشخصية وعنوانك لأغراض التسليم وبدء رحلة التسوق بسهولة من خلال تطبيقنا. تتيح ميزة البحث في التطبيق أيضًا للمتسوق العثور بسهولة على ما يبحث عنه.
فروع أسواق شيني وتطبيق eShini تحتوي على عدة أقسام مثل قسم الخضار والفواكه الطازجة واللحوم والدواجن بالإضافة إلى الحليب والبيض وقسم الآيس كريم والأطعمة المعلبة والعصائر والأدوات المنزلية والتنظيف وقسم خاص للأطفال ورعاية الأم ، المحمصة. كما تحتوي الفروع على مخبز يقدم تشكيلة واسعة من المخابز والحلويات الشرقية والغربية الطازجة.

listings.name: Go&
listings.description:
Shini Markets is the largest hypermarket chain in Palestine that meets “Palestinian Consumers’ Everyday Needs”. Began in 1965 with the first store opening. Today it is the leading  hypermarket chain in Palestine with 11 branches across the country of Palestine and still expanding.  
Shini Markets is the first face of the Palestinian people to obtain any product they are looking for. Shini Markets continuously strive to develop service policies in their branches, providing a pleasurable shopping experience with competitive shelf pricing, special offers, contests, and raffles for its consumers. 
eShini application is a visual online store that allows its users to shop online and obtain free delivery. The application is user-friendly and allows the consumer to shop as if on-ground with easy navigation from adding items to check out of the cart. Upon installing the application you may add your personal information and address for delivery purposes and easily start your shopping journey through our app. The search feature in the app also allows the shopper to easily find what they are looking for. 
Shini Markets branches and eShini App contain several sections such as the vegetables and fresh fruits section, meat and poultry, in addition to milk and eggs, the ice cream section, canned foods, juices, household items, cleaning, and a special section for child and mother care, the roastery. Also, the branches contain a bakery that provides a wide variety of fresh eastern and western bakeries and sweets.

bluejetty:00160914:ios.description:
Spring Health provides personalized mental healthcare and wellness support designed to help you feel your best. Download the app to unlock your benefit (at no cost to you). Browse our diverse provider network and schedule therapy or other care appointments from anywhere. No matter what you’re going through, you’ll find therapists who can relate. Explore our library of self-guided exercises, called Moments, and build skills to manage stress, anxiety, sadness, or whatever you’re experiencing in life right now. 
Depending on your benefit’s coverage, Spring Health can also be available for your family. Get mental health support for your loved ones right from the app.
About Spring Health 
Finding the right mental health resources can be daunting and confusing — that’s why we’re here. Spring Health’s whole mission is to get more people better support for managing stress, anxiety, depression, or anything else they experience. Our data-based approach reduces the trial-and-error period of your treatment, so the support you get is actually supportive. 
Download the Spring Health app to:
Schedule appointments (get access to a provider in as little as 2 days)
Access Moments, our library of wellness exercises on subjects like meditation, sleep, and more
Search our diverse network of licensed clinicians (our providers have an average 9.4/10 rating among our members)
Receive personalized care recommendations
Message your dedicated Care Navigator at any time
Get 24/7 support
Getting started is simple:
Sign up to create your free account
Take a quick assessment: Answer a handful of questions so that we can tailor your care to you. Our clinically-validated wellness assessment personalizes your care, addressing your immediate needs and long-term goals.
Get a personalized care plan: Once you complete your assessment, you’ll get a care plan that is made for your immediate needs. We’ll also match you with a Care Navigator (a licensed clinician), who can help set up appointments, answer your questions, and guide your care.
Explore your care: Book a session, or just explore the app. If you’re hesitant about taking the first step or have any questions, check in with your dedicated Care Navigator – that’s what they are there for. If you’re feeling like some quick support right away, try Moments, our collection of guided exercises.
Does Spring Health keep my participation confidential?
Absolutely – your privacy is our priority. We only use your answers and information to create a personalized treatment to help you get better, faster.
How much does Spring Health cost?
Spring Health is no additional cost to you. Depending on your benefit, your dependents may also have access to the benefit at no additional cost. Costs for therapy and medication management may be subject to costs associated with your health plan.

bluejetty:00185734:ios.description:
Fight, chat, grow!
Choose your path; rule as a powerful QUEEN or fight as a brave KNIGHT to defend her honor! Raise a DRAGON to fight for your kingdom. Form close bonds with Queens and Knights from around the world!
FEATURES
-- Raise a young dragon from birth and train him to fight for your army.
-- The dragon hunting campaign pits your most powerful forces against deadly dragons.
-- Queens and Knights play together on our global server and grow their kingdoms together.
-- Recruit “citizens” to build and upgrade multiple buildings at once.
-- Streamlined gameplay that makes for a smoother experience and faster growth.
-- Mages join your forces, making your armies stronger than ever.
-- The in-app translator allows you to meet new friends and form strong alliances in any language.
-- Alliance members send resources, reinforcement troops, and building speed-ups.
-- Large scale battles with multiple alliances on both sides.
-- New events keep you on your toes and give you chances to win gold and other prizes.
GAMEPLAY
Experience next generation mobile gaming in this brand new MMO world.; this fun new RTS war game pits your army against other Queens and Knights from all over the world in a battle to control the throne. Meet and chat with guys and girls from around the world while you grow your kingdom, in this tactical MMORPG game. Research new skills to increase the power of your defenses and your army. Station archers, infantrymen, cavalry, and powerful mages to guard your city from attack as you work to manage your resources, upgrade your castle, and plan your next attack against other Kings and Queens, dragons, and other monsters in medieval PVP and PVE combat! Do you have what it takes to crush your enemies in this real-time combat MMO game?

Q: Where can I find these stations online?

Q: Why does the music occasionally skip?
A: When songs are skipping, it is often because 1) that station's server has recently been reset or 2) the internet isn't filling the audio buffer fast enough. Usually these issues are resolved with faster internet, changing to a new station, or they resolve on their own after the server resets.

Q: Why are some stations blank at times?

Perfect Beauty Salon: Glam Up! – your beauty world, your style empire.
Welcome to the ultimate beauty salon tycoon. In this game, you’re not just doing nails – you’re building a makeup, hair, and spa empire. Start small with a nail studio and expand into a full glam world: makeup bars, hair styling rooms, tattoo shops, piercing booths, and luxury spa zones.
How to Play:
Drag to move, collect payments, and keep your salon running smoothly.
Unlock new beauty zones: nails, makeup, spa, tattoos, piercings, and more.
Hire staff to manage the glam rush and help your clients.
Upgrade, expand, and build your very own salon empire.

Nails, makeup, tattoos, hair styling, spa treatments, and DIY fashion in one game.
Hire and manage your glam squad of stylists and beauty experts.
Fast-paced idle gameplay with satisfying progress.
Create your dream salon, from nail polish stands to luxury spa lounges.
Play offline – glam up anytime, anywhere.
Grow Your Glam Empire
Your salon starts with one chair, but every upgrade brings new clients and bigger profits. From makeup to manicures, every choice grows your reputation. With each expansion, your salon turns into the ultimate glam up beauty empire.
The Ultimate Beauty Challenge
Balance speed, style, and strategy. Can you handle the rush of clients? Will you hire the right staff? Manage your resources wisely to keep the glam flowing.
Design Your Dream Salon
Pick your upgrades, open new rooms, and customize your salon’s flow. Nails, hair, makeup, tattoos, spa – every part of your beauty world is in your hands.
Download Perfect Beauty Salon: Glam Up! today and start building your glam beauty empire. Free to play with optional in-app purchases.

bluejetty:00115936:ios.description:
Free version with advertising can be consulted offline, with content stored in the application.
Need to check a verb or practice French conjugation? This is the app for you!
With the La conjugaison app, you'll be able to consult all the conjugations of over 9,000 French verbs. In addition to a verb conjugator, you'll also find conjugation exercises for each verb, with the option of selecting your favorite verbs, groups, auxiliaries, modes and tenses for practice.
This application offers you:
* Over 9,000 French verbs conjugated in all tenses (present, past, future...), all modes (indicative, subjunctive, imperative, conditional, participle, gerund, infinitive...), voice (active, passive), gender (masculine, feminine), and pronominal form where available.
* Essential information on groups: auxiliary, first, second or third group.
* The ability to select favorite verbs for use in exercises.
* The ability to modify verb parameters: alternative auxiliary, pronominal voice, gender, etc.
* Conjugation exercises with a multitude of options for selecting favorite verbs, verb types or tenses to test yourself on (auxiliaries, 3rd group verbs, tenses, modes, voice...).
For quick access to the verb you're looking for (whatever its group, tense or mode), use the search engine, typing the infinitive verb directly into it.
With the conjugation app, conjugation becomes child's play again, and you'll no longer fall into the traps of the many irregular French verbs.
Happy French conjugation!
We also offer paid conjugation apps for German, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese verbs.

bluejetty:00158747:ios.description:
Weather Pet: Your Daily Dose of Adorable Forecast Fun!
Welcome to Weather Pet, the playful app that turns checking the weather into a daily dose of aww-inspiring cuteness! Get ready to experience a fun forecast that delivers accurate weather updates presented by dogs, cats, or a delightful mix of both. The pets also react to the weather! Imagine seeing a cute kitten sporting a cozy scarf on a snowy day or a happy puppy reacting to a burst of sunshine – every forecast brings a smile to your face.
Choose Your Furry Forecast:
Enjoy your weather updates with adorable dogs, cats, or a combination of both. Each pet adapts in real-time, making every weather check a dose of surprise & joy!
Accurate & Detailed Weather:
Add any city worldwide to access up-to-date weather, including hourly forecasts, 7-day forecasts, daily high and low temperatures, humidity, wind, sunrise/sunset times, and more.
Unlimited Pets for Free:
Experience endless fun with unlimited cute pets that make you wonder: am I checking the weather or the pets? 
Engaging Weather Alerts:
Receive cute, interactive alerts delivered with playful barks and meows, so you never miss an update on your local weather.
Daily Deals for Pet Lovers:
Access daily deals on products that pets will adore – enhancing your experience without any commitment to spending.
Support a Great Cause:
With optional subscriptions that remove ads, you can support animal shelters while enjoying an ad-free experience.
Why settle for a boring weather app when Weather Pet transforms every forecast into an exciting, heartwarming experience? Whether you're a dog lover, a cat lover, or both, let our fun pet forecast brighten your day and keep you informed about the weather around the globe.
Download Weather Pet now and discover a world where weather meets whimsy – because every forecast should be a reason to smile!

•Our Terms of Use can be viewed here: https://www.alphapaw.com/pages/terms-conditions

bluejetty:00133489:ios.description:
Commander,
 This universe is a wild frontier filled with danger, mystery, and rare resources critical to humanity's survival and expansion among the stars.
 You'll discover planets torn apart by savage sandstorms and prowled by colossal dreadwyrms… frozen blue oceans locked in eternal ice… crimson worlds bubbling with lava and ash… and lush green jungles teeming with towering alien flora and strange, elusive creatures. And beyond these lie countless uncharted planets, just waiting for you to conquer. Assemble your fleet. The unknown awaits.
Commander,
 Out here, you build your fleet your way. Recruit terrifying alien lifeforms, unleash ruthless machines, or blend the two into a force no one dares to challenge. There are no rules, only victory.
 In this vast galaxy, you'll clash with alien empires, forge alliances with powerful factions, and survive sudden ambushes from rival fleets. The universe is chaotic and unforgiving, but we believe in you.
 Out here, legends are born. This is your moment to crush your enemies, conquer new worlds, and rise to rule the stars. Now go, Commander. Your conquest begins.
PROJECT ENTROPY FEATURES:
ASSEMBLE YOUR CREW: As an Interstellar Trial Commander, you'll encounter and recruit incredible species from across the universe, harnessing their unique technologies to fortify your forces. Carve your own path through the stars.
JOIN A FLEET COMMAND: You have the freedom to create a team that perfectly suits your playstyle and strategy, and upgrade them with powerful weapons to build the best fleet command to increase attack and defense. Customize your vehicles and weapons.
CUSTOMIZE EPIC HEROES: Uncover the stories of war heroes as your epic journey unfolds. Recruit heroes to your team for a united front and upgrade their skills.
DEEP AND DYNAMIC COMBAT: Prepare for the Grod! These alien beasts have been roused. As an Interstellar Trial Commander, you'll need to harness advanced technology and cunning strategies to quell the threat.
VERSATILE WARFARE: Command powerful tanks and aircraft, each with their own unique tactical advantages. Whether you're facing Grod swarms or enemy forces, your strategic choices will define your legacy.
ADVANCED ARMAMENTS: Choose from a vast array of high-tech weaponry, including patrolling tanks and combat mechs. Shape your armory to suit your gameplay style.
REAL-TIME BATTLE STRATEGY: Engage in real-time multiplayer combat. Battle against other alliances on the region map for control of territories and resources, and encounter a wide variety of environments, creatures, and technologies throughout the game.
ALLIANCE WARFARE SYSTEM: In times of crisis, allies are invaluable. Join an alliance and fight for the glory of your comrades-in-arms.
GLOBAL INTERACTION: Converse with players from around the world, breaking down language barriers with our powerful real-time translation system.
In Project Entropy, you can command your troops and recruit the best crew of heroes in this sci-fi and RPG legends game. Navigate through the galaxy by engaging in epic space battles, discovering new civilizations, and completing challenging missions. Join the fleet; the cosmos is calling. A myriad of planets await your conquest. Seize your opportunity to become a legend among the stars.

Privacy Policy: https://funplus.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: https://funplus.com/terms-conditions/
Discord Server: https://discord.gg/mRVQcXJP

bluejetty:00158092:ios.description:
► BETRAYAL 3D – WHO’S GOT THE DEVIL INSIDE?
Up for some devilish casual gaming fun? Join the thrilling action in the hunt-or-be-hunted world of Betrayal 3D, where you switch roles between Devil and Protector. 
When you’re the Devil, your task is to take out all the other characters without being caught: employ your stealth and assassin’s craft to sneak up on each character in turn and slaughter them while no one’s looking, then evade detection while the timer runs down. 
As the protector, you’ll need all your powers of observation and deduction to catch the killer before they get the chance to murder you and all the other innocent bystanders – unless you catch them in the act, you’ll never know who’s got the devil inside!
► LADIES AND GENTLEMEN, THERE’S A KILLER AMONG US…
• Which side are you on? The stakes are life or death, but you get to decide whether you’re on the side of the angels or would rather get away with committing dastardly crimes in this easy-to-play but fast-moving and endlessly entertaining action game.
• Go on a spree – with over 120 different levels to play, the murder, mayhem and action never end. As you progress through the game, the locations get larger and more labyrinthine, and the number of characters grows and grows, making it ever more difficult to avoid a brutal end or—if you’re the one doing the brutal ending—escape undetected.
• Master of disguises – complete levels to progress through the game and earn rewards including 38 different character skins representing fun mystery movie archetypes, as well as attractive new locations and in-game currency.
• Devilish mechanisms – the rules are straightforward, but the gameplay is constantly enhanced with tricksy new mechanics, including jump pads that help Protectors race to the scene of the crime, Vents that allow assassins to move from room to room with ultimate stealth, locked doors, and CCTV cameras that can see straight through your angelic disguise.
• All the best tunes – Betrayal 3D boasts fun character designs and a killer soundtrack that kicks in at the moments of greatest tension to enhance the action and your gameplay experience.
► WHAT THE DEVIL’S GOT INTO YOU?
Want all the thrills of being both an ace detective and an arch assassin? Looking for a game that provides bite-size chunks of excitement and adrenaline? Ready to play both sides of the law? Eager to test your stealth and strategy skills? 
Download Betrayal 3D right now and dive into a noirish world of murder, betrayal, and devilishly good fun.
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00154228:ios.description:
How well do you really know your partner? Loverzz turns that question into a game you'll want to play every day.
One of you answers, the other guesses. Match answers to score points, unlock how in-sync you really are, and start the kind of conversations you never knew you needed. With 3000+ questions across 13 categories, you'll never run out of things to talk about.
PLAY TOGETHER
Pick your vibe and take turns guessing each other:
- Would You Rather
- Never Have I Ever
- This or That
- You or Me
- Who's Most Likely To
- Multiple choice, photo uploads, and a drawing game
From light and silly to Deep Conversations that bring you closer, there's a pack for every mood. Feeling competitive? Jump into Battle Quiz and race each other against the clock.
KEEP YOUR STREAK ALIVE
A fresh question lands every day. Answer together to build your Daily Streak, and if life gets busy, grace and streak repair keep your momentum going. It's the tiny daily ritual that quietly brings you closer.
CUTE HOME & LOCK SCREEN WIDGETS
Keep each other close without saying a word. Add widgets that live right on your Home and Lock Screen:
- Time Together counter (days and hours since day one)
- Countdown to your next big date
- Distance widget with 5 visual styles
- Shared drawing canvas
- Favorite photo and love notes
- A random quiz to answer on the spot
DRAW & SURPRISE EACH OTHER
Open a shared canvas and doodle together in real time, even miles apart. Or send a Scratch: hide a drawing or photo under a scratch surface and let your partner scratch to reveal your little surprise.
MADE FOR LONG DISTANCE
Closing the gap is what Loverzz does best. The Distance widget shows how far apart you are right now, daily questions keep you talking, and your widgets keep each other present all day long.
YOUR STORY, SAVED
Build a shared Journal of your favorite memories with photos, titles, and locations, then see them pinned on your Photo Map. Add your Special Dates and never miss an anniversary again.
SEE YOUR COMPATIBILITY
Watch your connection grow across 6 dimensions: Vision, Closeness, Adventure, Life Habits, Social Dynamics, and Crisis Management.
SETTLE IT WITH CARE
Had a rough moment? The AI Argument Analyzer helps you understand a disagreement with calmness, empathy, and de-escalation insights, so you come back stronger.
WHY COUPLES LOVE LOVERZZ
- Fun guessing games that actually deepen your bond
- A daily streak that turns connection into a habit
- Adorable widgets for your Home and Lock Screen
- Drawing, photos, and surprises across any distance
- Deep conversations that bring you closer
Whether you're newly dating, long distance, or years in, Loverzz makes growing closer the best part of your day.
Download Loverzz and see how well you know each other.
*Some features require subscription.
TERMS: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00141929:ios.summary: Galileo is a virtual doctor’s office that provides high-quality health care remotely with an easy-to-use app. From 24/7 virtual care with real doctors to fast prescription refills, Galileo makes it easier than ever to get the care you need,
bluejetty:00141929:ios.description:
Galileo is a virtual doctor’s office that provides high-quality health care remotely with an easy-to-use app. From 24/7 virtual care with real doctors to fast prescription refills, Galileo makes it easier than ever to get the care you need, when you need it.
No waiting rooms. No surprise fees. No insurance required. 
24/7 Virtual Care
- Book same/next-day appointments. 
- See a doctor anytime — even nights, weekends, and holidays. 
- Get answers in hours, not days.
- Skip the long wait (and even longer bills) at urgent care. 
Convenient, In-Network Care
- Looking for a doctor that takes your insurance? Congratulations — your search is over. Galileo is in-network with most insurance plans.
- No insurance? No problem. Access unlimited appointments with an annual or monthly membership, or pay a fee for an individual visit.
- Get prescriptions from $0. 
Comprehensive Primary, Urgent, and Specialty Care
- Enjoy ongoing primary care from real doctors.
- Routine checkups, annual wellness visits, and preventive care
- Lab orders and bloodwork 
- Other virtual care apps only treat urgent conditions, like UTIs. 
- Our providers can treat up to 90% of conditions in the app, saving you money on unnecessary urgent care visits or expensive specialists.
We Can Help You With
- Everyday issues, like prescriptions and refills, acne, birth control, weight loss, hair loss and more. 
- Acute issues, like allergies, cold and flu, UTIs / STIs, headaches, nausea, strep throat, rashes, and more.
- Chronic conditions, like diabetes, hypertension, heart disease, and asthma.
- Mental health, like anxiety, depression, and insomnia.

bluejetty:00123500:ios.summary: Ketogenic Diet App - get healthy, feel good, and lose weight. Our app is your ultimate companion in adopting a flexible, low-carb diet for health benefits and weight reduction, combining our successful meal plans with over 200k happy custom
bluejetty:00123500:ios.description:
Ketogenic Diet App - get healthy, feel good, and lose weight. Our app is your ultimate companion in adopting a flexible, low-carb diet for health benefits and weight reduction, combining our successful meal plans with over 200k happy customers! 
The Keto Diet App is designed to help you realize the health benefits of one of the world’s most celebrated diets in burning fat and decreasing insulin levels, focusing on low carbohydrates, healthy fats, seafood, and simple, clean eating in 2024. This app offers hundreds of keto and carb-friendly recipes, diet tips, and guidance right at your fingertips. If you are looking to eat healthy, meet your weight loss goals, or increase your longevity, our app makes meal planning and grocery shopping effortless, all in the palm of your hand! Tracking and shopping for food has never been so easy - simply type the name or follow your customized meal plan, tailored to to promote a healthy lifestyle and balanced diet!
Get Your Customized Meal Plan and Start Your Journey to Eating Well!
Key Features:
• Customizable Ketogenic Diet Plans: Tailor your Ketogenic diet experience with our simple clean-eating meal plans. Whether you desire less carbs or wish to focus on healthy fats, our app adapts to your dietary preferences for optimal wellness management.
• Recipe Flexibility for Every Mood and Occasion: Easily swap out recipes in your daily diet plan to suit your mood, occasion, or dietary requirements. Ideal for those with food allergies or aversions, our extensive recipe library ensures healthy eating is always enjoyable and stress-free.
•Hundreds of Healthy Recipes at Your Fingertips: Explore a variety of Ketogenic diet and recipes, or create and save your favorites, featuring ingredients like low carb, non-starchy vegetables, grass-fed beef, bacon, wild-caught fish, organ meats, eggs, and fods high in fat, such as avocado, coconut, and nuts (macadamia, walnuts, almonds, pecans), and seeds.
• Personalized Diet Counseling with Kelly: Get expert advice and personalized support from Kelly, our in-house diet counselor. Whether you're new to the Ketogenic diet, kicking it in ketosis, or looking to refine your meal plans, Kelly is there to assist you on your journey to wellness.
How It Works:
• Effortless Planning: Our app customizes your meal plans for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks each week.
• Streamlined Grocery Lists: Automatically generated shopping lists make your grocery trips more efficient.
• Flexible Serving Sizes: Adjust serving sizes to feed your family or plan for leftovers, fitting your busy lifestyle.
• Quick and Easy Meals: Simplify your cooking with easy-to-follow recipes and healthy meal options.
Subscription Information:
Download the Keto Diet App for free, including a trial period. Upgrade to Premium for full access to all features and professional support. Subscription details are available within the app.
Privacy Policy: http://healthyhappysmart.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://healthyhappysmart.com/terms-conditions/

https://health.gov/our-work/nutrition-physical-activity/dietary-guidelines

Contact Us:
Have questions or feedback? Contact us at http://www.healthyhappysmart.com/contact.html. Don't forget to share your app experience with friends and diet buddies!

bluejetty:00044809:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00044809:ios.description:
Welcome to Pocket Puppy School, a family-owned dog training platform dedicated to making canine education accessible, flexible, and easy to follow.
Whether you just brought home a brand-new puppy, are navigating the chaotic teenage dog phase, or are looking to guide a grown-up canine, PPS provides the clear answers and structural support you need to build a lifelong bond.
Real Solutions for Real Dog Owners
As owners of a reactive, high-energy dog ourselves, we know first-hand how overwhelming behavior challenges can be. Many intricate dog behaviors simply aren't covered in standard classes. PPS simplifies these complex topics, breaking them down into actionable steps.
Get expert guidance on common behavior challenges, including:
Potty training and housebreaking routines
Separation anxiety and building independence
Leash pulling and loose-leash walking skills
Barking, reactivity, and aggression management
Socialization strategies for the real world
Nipping, biting, and chewing furniture prevention
A Positive, Lifestyle-Focused Approach
Our platform focuses on a positive reinforcement approach to build a healthy lifestyle with your dog. We don't just teach commands; we show you how to establish a long-lasting routine to create a happy, calm, and balanced household.
Interactive & Personalized Learning
We designed the human experience to be as engaging as the training itself. Say goodbye to dry, confusing text. PPS utilizes clear videos, helpful images, highlighted takeaways, interactive quizzes, and educational games.
Choose the learning style that fits your life:
Topic-by-Topic Approach: Perfect for those who love deep dives and structured, comprehensive reading.
Bite-Sized, Gamified Steps: Ideal for quick learning sessions, splitting complex topics into tiny, rewarding pieces that fit into a busy schedule.
All-In-One Toolkit & Key Features
Pocket Puppy School comes packed with built-in tools to streamline your daily routine:
Built-In Digital Clicker: Access a fast positive reinforcement tool right inside the app, or add it directly to your phone’s home screen for instant access.
Sound Desensitization Library: Train your dog to remain calm around scary triggers by gradually introducing common household and environmental sounds.
Smart Calendar & Reminders: Keep track of your dog's schedule. Store veterinary appointments, set notifications for feeding times, and never miss a training session.
Multiple Puppy Profiles: Create dedicated profiles for every dog in your home to track their individual growth and milestones.
Global Puppy Community: Join a supportive feed of fellow dog owners. Share pictures of your furry friend, exchange encouragement, and celebrate training victories together.
Comprehensive Search Tool: Instantly find the exact topic or behavior guide you need to solve pressing issues.
1-on-1 Chat with a Trainer: Need personalized support? Access our optional digital coaching feature to connect directly with a professional dog trainer for tailored advice.
Master Obedience & Fun Tricks
Keep your dog mentally stimulated with an extensive library of behaviors and tricks. From foundational dog obedience to fun party tricks, we cover:
Sit, lay down, and roll over
Wait, stay, and crate training
Reliable recall (coming when called)
Nose work, heelwork, and much more!
Clear up the confusion and start building a better relationship with your canine companion. Download Pocket Puppy School today and take the first step toward a well-behaved, happy puppy!

bluejetty:00062172:ios.name: Easy Pose -Best Posing App
bluejetty:00062172:ios.summary: Easy Pose is a human body pose app for people who draw or is learning to draw. Have you ever wanted a personalized model to show various poses while drawing animation, illustration or sketching? Easy Pose was developed for these people. Var
bluejetty:00062172:ios.description:
Easy Pose is a human body pose app for people who draw or is learning to draw. Have you ever wanted a personalized model to show various poses while drawing animation, illustration or sketching? Easy Pose was developed for these people. Various angles of different poses can be inspected. Now you do not have to draw with a wooden joint doll or figure as a model. Even yoga or exercise poses can be checked from various angles.
1. Sensitive Operation – Easy Pose allows control over the main joints in an amazingly smooth manner. It provides multiple functions previously unavailable in other pose apps such as a highlight on movable parts, initialization of joints and manipulation state, and finding a symmetrical pose with the mirroring function. Experience controls that are more convenient than with a mouse.
2. Comic Style Models – Previous pose apps had many realistic eight-head ratio men and women, making it unsuitable for animation, webtoon or game illustrations. Easy Pose is prepared with models with various body types.
3. Multi-Model Control – A scene can be made with a made with a maximum of 6 people at once! It is now possible to make a scene of a soccer player avoiding a tackle or a couple holding hands and dancing.
4. Tens of poses that have already been completed. Poses that are used often are already made. About 60 poses have been prepared and these poses will be regularly updated.
5. Other Characteristics
- Sensitive light expression using direct and backlight settings
- Able to observe various poses at various angles
- Realistic shadows such as shadows of models being cast over other models
- Able to change the angle of view (possible to use an exaggerated vanishing point such as a panorama)
- Provides a wire mode that allows lines drawn over models
- Able to download models without the background in a PNG clear background.
- Automatic saving, making it safe whenever there is a device error.
- Able to easily control hand movements.
6. Functions Provided in the Free Version
- Model poses can be freely controlled.
- Moods can be freely controlled by controlling the light angle.
- Able to save the image in PNG. Use it when using Easy Pose with another program to draw!
- A scene can be made by freely controlling the camera distance
7. Paid Version Upgrade Benefit
- Completed poses can be saved and recalled.
- A woman (normal), woman (small), man (small) is provided other than the original model.
- Several models can be brought on screen at once.
- There are no ads.
- All “Completed Poses” can be used.
** Since the data is not saved to server, when you delete an app, the saved data is also deleted.
** when you delete Pro version and re-install it, click "purchase Pro version" in the app again to complete installation.

bluejetty:00128184:ios.description:
Adopt an adorable virtual puppy to care for and love. Pat them, feed them treats and earn gifts by walking every day.
Digital Dog is a great way to motivate yourself to get out and walk!
* Interact with your puppy by patting, scratching and feeding them treats!
* Name your puppy and see their name on some dog bowls!
* Set your step target from 1,000 to 10,000 steps and earn rewards when you reach your goal!
* Unlock treats, new dog bowl, puppy mats and balls every day!
* Your puppy will never grow old or die, so rest easy if you miss a day walking!
* Earn ribbons for achieving special awards for caring for your puppy and walking!
* Check in every day to earn doggy treats to make your puppy happy!
* Perfect for all ages!
* Optional Feature: If you neglect your puppy they may run away, but a short walk will help you find them! Turn this on under the settings.
* Uses HealthKit to measure your steps.
* For Apple Watch and iPhone
Thanks,
Johnno and Pete

The ASL App is designed to help you learn a new visual language in a way tha
bluejetty:00126764:ios.description:
The ASL App is made by Deaf people for you! Learn conversational ASL right now, on the go, with all phrases and signs organized to make it easy for you to learn. 
The ASL App is designed to help you learn a new visual language in a way that is easy, intuitive, and well paced. You can drag your finger on the videos to control the speed - totally at your pace. There is a search index (when you need to know a sign right away), slow-motion option, info (tips), and a favorites folder. 
You can save the signs you want to review again in your own favorites folder where you can go back to it and practice more; and even better - you can upload different what signs you've learned to Twitter and Facebook. Share with your friends, make learning ASL fun, and progressive!!
Get started NOW - download and get your first bundle of signs today! 
The ASL App Pack offers you everything - the entire collection - of current available bundles and future releases! Everything for $9.99. This also removes ads.
Bundles:
• Know Your ABCs - Learn the ASL alphabet (included, FREE!)
• Know Your Numbers - Learn all the numbers (included, FREE!)
• Universal Gestures - Review what you already know (included, FREE!)
• Handshape Exercises - Warm up your hands, and get used to the different handshape positions. Get your muscles to become fluently aware. (included, FREE!)
• The Basics! A good way to get started! (included, FREE!)
• More Basic Signs! Again, a collection of more basic signs. (Paid)
• Looking Good Today! A collection of signs that is related to looks, fashion, and different complimenting phrases. (Paid) 
• Mood Swings! A collection of signs for different moods, emotions, feelings. (Paid)
• Life of the Party! A collection of signs/phrases designed to fit what will be said at social events, or at bars. (Paid)
• Dining & Signing! Signs and phrases for eating out, for the restaurant industry. (Paid)
• Foodies, Rejoice! Signs and phrases covering food, dishes, drinks, and different ways related to eating. (Paid) 
• The Wilderness Beckons! Different signs and phrases of our natural environment. Perfect if you like camping, hiking, or road trips a lot. (Paid)
• Great Timing! Signs related to time, scheduling, calendars, days of the week, and more. (Paid)
• Dollar and Signs! Everything related to money, budgeting, invoicing, making payments and so on. (Paid)
• Country Name Signs! Learn the name signs of countries around the world. 
• Colors! Learn all the signs for colors with some phrases! (Free)
•Nyle's Sampler! Features Nyle DiMarco, winner of American's Next Top Model and ABC's Dance With The Stars. (Free)
• Sign That! with Nyle. Many fun signs and phrases you want to ask Nyle, or ask through social media! (Paid)
• Celebrations! Nyle loves holidays and celebrations, especially Halloween and Valentine. He will teach you how to be festive in ASL! This bundle include a variety of signed words and beneficial phrases to help your season greetings look authentic. (Paid)
• Family Signs! This bundle will teach you the signs for family members: immediate and extended, loved ones and even your nosy neighbors!
• Family Milestones & Life Events! You'll learn signs for marriage, wedding, divorce, children, adoption, pregnancies, and much more!
• Pop Culture and Social Media! What's current, popular and trending? Here, Nyle shows you the signs from 3D movies to buying tickets for Broadway!
• Sign and Vote! Learn how to say "register to vote" and how to sign President, blue or red states, and many more!
• All About Sports! Learn signs to use with your fellow sports fans!
• Education & Higher Education! Learn all about those signs used in Education!
• LGBT & Pride! Learn all about Pride and LGBT signs!
• Emergency Signs! Learn signs to use in first responder or emergency situations.
Got questions, comments, or ideas - contact us at hello@theaslapp.com!
Start signing!

bluejetty:00024548:ios.description:
Join users that have tracked over a million Disney & Universal vacations with the best countdown app on the app store.
"Hands down the best Disney vacation countdown app. Do yourself a favor and get this one!"
"Super easy to use, and I love widgets and Siri for checking my countdown."
"Love how I can make it look the way I want with nice wallpapers and my own photos. Two thumbs up!"
Countdown by Magical Trip Guide is the premiere vacation countdown timer app for Disney parks, Universal parks, and Disney Cruise. Simply enter your vacation start date and the type of vacation, and you'll get a beautifully designed view of the time to your trip, right down to the second. Customize the look of your countdown by selecting from a series of themed wallpapers, import your own from your photo library, or use the power of AI to generate a custom Magic Wallpaper.
** NEW: Track multiple vacations **
Tracking more than one upcoming trip? Add as many vacations as you'd like and switch between them with a tap.
Need more help planning your vacation? We've got you covered there too. Once you've set your trip start date, the app shows you a list of important to-do items with due dates — whether you're planning a Disney Parks visit or a Disney Cruise. Easily toggle push reminders or export straight to iOS calendar/reminders.
Countdown by Magical Trip Guide is also a great iOS citizen. It supports Siri Shortcuts, allowing you to ask Siri to "check my vacation countdown", right on your iPhone or Apple Watch and to incorporate your countdown into any routine within the Shortcuts app. With both home screen and lock screen widgets, you can check your countdown at a glance. With full support for both light and dark modes, the app looks beautiful under any configuration. And, for users of assistive tech, you'll find it is fully optimized for accessibility features such as VoiceOver and Dynamic Type.
FEATURES
* Easy-to-use countdown timer for your next vacation
* Built-in support for Disney/Universal parks and Disney Cruise
* Track multiple vacations and switch between them with a tap
* Magic Wallpapers: use the power of AI to create customized wallpapers like a pro
* Home screen and lock screen widgets for checking your countdown at a glance
* Themed and custom wallpapers to customize the look and feel of the app
* Vacation to-do list with automatic due dates and reminders
* Siri shortcut for checking your countdown
* Easy sharing to your favorite social networks
* Support for dark mode
* Fully accessible for VoiceOver and Dynamic Type
We appreciate you checking out Countdown by Magical Trip Guide and welcome any and all feedback. Drop a review or send us an email to let us know how we can improve.

Feel stronger, move better, and
bluejetty:00128854:ios.description:
Meet HitFit—a workout planner & tracker for everyday fitness. Build strength, improve body composition, and stay active with guided home workouts, expert-led challenges, and simple meal plans—all in one app.
Feel stronger, move better, and reach your weight loss goals—no gym membership required. Every training program features step-by-step video guidance and real-time audio coaching to keep your form on point. Balanced meal plans fuel your progress, helping you lose weight, boost energy, and feel your best.
Whether you have five minutes or a full hour, HitFit adapts to your schedule—just like it does for tens of thousands of users already training with it.
With HitFit, you can:
– Work out anywhere—at home, outdoors, or in the gym.
– Build lasting habits—complete challenges that keep you consistent.
– Reach your weight loss goals—access meal plans with nutritious recipes to improve your body composition
– Target specific areas—train with abs workouts, butt workouts, and full body programs.
– See your progress—use the workout tracker to stay motivated and measure results.
What you'll find in HitFit:
● WORKOUTS FOR EVERY STYLE
Choose from calisthenics, pilates, yoga, HIIT workouts, micro workouts, tai chi walking, and more. Every home workout includes video demonstrations and coaching tips for safe, effective training.
● FITNESS CHALLENGES
Stay motivated with 7-day, 14-day, and 28-day challenges. Follow a daily training plan, track progress, and stay accountable across nearly 100 challenge options, including abs workout routines and butt workout programs.
● FULL BODY TRAINING
Sculpt glutes with butt workout routines, build core strength with abs workout programs, tone arms and legs, or go all-in with bikini body and full body training. Step-by-step home exercise guidance keeps your form solid.
● MEAL PLANS MADE SIMPLE
Fuel your training with easy-to-cook recipes for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks. Support your journey with meal plans that make healthy eating effortless.
● APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION
HitFit's built-in workout tracker syncs with Apple Health, so your steps, activity, and stats update automatically. Track daily movement alongside your workout progress and get a full view of your achievements.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick your program—flat belly, strong legs, or full body.
2. Choose a workout or challenge that fits you.
3. Train with video guidance and audio coaching.
4. Watch your progress in the workout tracker and celebrate every win.
5. Fuel your training with simple, healthy meal plans.
Hit start on better fitness. Download HitFit—the workout planner that keeps you moving.
FAQ
Q: Do I need equipment?
A: Most at-home workouts require no equipment—perfect for training wherever you are.
Q: Is HitFit good for beginners? 
A: Absolutely. Pilates, calisthenics, tai chi walking, and HIIT workouts suit all fitness levels.
Q: Is this workout planner suitable for both men and women?
A: Yes. HitFit includes men workout and women workout programs designed specifically for each gender.
HITFIT PREMIUM
• Full library including pilates, calisthenics, HIIT workouts, tai chi walking, and more
• All 96 fitness challenges with home workout programs
• Complete meal plans for weight loss
• Video and audio guidance for all at-home workouts
• HitFit + HitMeal Bundle—users can choose the bundle plan to include HitMeal, the dedicated nutrition app, at no extra cost. 
• Individual challenges are available as standalone in-app purchases.
Subscriptions are billed weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annually. Payment is charged to your Apple ID on confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage subscriptions in Account Settings.
Please consult a doctor before beginning any workout program.
By using HitFit, you are agreeing to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
http://aiby.mobi/fitness/privacy 
http://aiby.mobi/fitness/terms

bluejetty:00178878:ios.description:
Put your worries in a bubble and blow them away!
Match Triple Ball is a relaxation 3D match game that satisfies even the busiest person, makes your free time valuable. Where can you find and match all the 3D objects to win the game? – In the bubble! All of the items are now in a ball that you can rotate 360° in any direction.
 How to play:
- Simply find and connect three identical objects till the bubble ball is completely cleaned to solve the tile puzzle.
- Unlock hundreds of adorable 3D objects and themes level by level as your reward.
- Pause if you need to leave, and continue anytime with the auto-saving system.
- Design your own relaxing room with beautiful background sceneries and special theme 
- Hunt down all the eggs collection on the special level and earn even more rewards!

- Stunning physical effects and HD graphics
- Unlock a series of levels, sceneries, and objects
- Well-designed brain trainer levels
- Auto-saving system
- Colorful 3d objects
- Hint boosters and rewards
- It's free after all!

There are no lives to lose, and you don't have to annoy your friends to progress. Play as long as you want. This game will fill your holidays with lots of pleasure!
The higher level you reach, the more challenge you face. Become a match bubble master not only powers up your senses but also train your brain to improve memory and concentration. You can test your skill, collect various tiles by playing special daily puzzles! The higher level you reach, the more challenge you face. Become a master of matching triple puzzle games! bluejetty:00044275:android.description:
Put your kevlar and helmet on, get on your motorcycle without brakes and hit the track for glory in the "Speedway Challenge 2025" game! This product will allow you to fulfill all your speedway dreams - become the next world champion, as well as lead your beloved club to the league pedestal. The path of your individual or club career is up to you.
Game modes waiting for the player:
- Quick Match - a quick way to stand with your rivals under the tape and fight a fierce battle for victory! Choose the teams, indicate the location and go, because the referee has started the two-minute clock, so it would be a shame to be late for the first race.
- Career (after in app purchase) - create a new virtual rider or choose one of over a thousand available riders and lead his career according to your own discretion. It's up to you whether you'll become a speedway globetrotter or lead a quiet life and riding once or twice a week.
- League (after in app purchase) - build a club from scratch or choose one of the available centers and lead it to the very top in one of several European leagues. Make sure to have a team that complies with the regulations, but remember to be able to afford the salaries. The medal will be the summary of your hard work.
- Challenges - accept the challenge and do the task that awaits you. Achieve a specific result as a team or individually, win expected number of times or do not let the rival achieve a significant score.
- Online - test your skills in a confrontation with players from all around the world in the ranking game or invite a group of friends (after in app purchase) to play together.
You will compete on almost 70 tracks from all over the world - from South America, through the Antipodes to Europe, with competitors who have been precisely reproduced in terms of skill level and riding silhouette. Each competition will be held in accordance with the applicable rules of speedway sport.

bluejetty:00188129:ios.name: Mazii: Japanese Dictionary
bluejetty:00188129:ios.summary:
You're staring at a kanji you can't read. A word goes by in a Tokyo meeting before you catch it. Your JLPT is a week away and you're jumping between five apps to get through a single page.
Mazii is a Japanese dictionary — built to put the
bluejetty:00188129:ios.description:
You're staring at a kanji you can't read. A word goes by in a Tokyo meeting before you catch it. Your JLPT is a week away and you're jumping between five apps to get through a single page.
Mazii is a Japanese dictionary — built to put the right answer in your hand the moment you need it. Start there, and everything else is right where you'd expect it.
170,000 WORDS, DEFINED IN FULL
Look something up and you get more than a translation: native pronunciation, meanings, usage notes, and example sentences drawn from how Japanese is actually written and spoken. The dictionary holds 170,000+ Japanese–English and 140,000+ English–Japanese entries, and every one of 12,000+ kanji comes with its readings, meanings, and stroke order.
MORE THAN JAPANESE–ENGLISH
Your phone is in English, but you might think in another language. Mazii is also a Japanese dictionary and translator for Vietnamese, Chinese, Korean, Indonesian, French, and Filipino — so you can look a word up in the language you know best.
LOOK UP GRAMMAR THE WAY YOU LOOK UP A WORD
Search any grammar point from N5 to N1 and get a straight explanation with example sentences that show it in use — the pattern you couldn't parse in your textbook, broken down in seconds.
FOUR WAYS TO FIND ANY WORD
Typing Japanese is the slow part, so Mazii lets you skip it. The two learners reach for most:
- Handwriting: draw a kanji stroke by stroke and find it, even when you have no idea how it reads.
- Camera: point your phone at a sign, a menu, a label, or a page of a textbook and read it on the spot.
And when typing or speaking is faster:
- Voice: say the word out loud.
- Text: enter kanji, hiragana, katakana, or romaji.
AI TRANSLATE, IN CONTEXT
Give Mazii a full sentence or a whole conversation and it translates the meaning in context, not word by word — so what comes back reads the way a person would actually say it. Wondering why a word is used that way? Ask the AI and it explains in plain English.
SPEAK JAPANESE AND GET CORRECTED
Talk to Mazii in Japanese. It listens to your pronunciation and points out what to work on, corrects your grammar as you write, and keeps the conversation going, so you practice speaking, not just reading.
TURN EVERY LOOKUP INTO A FLASHCARD
Save any word you search into your own notebook and review it by listening, speaking, writing, and matching. The words you look up today become the ones you keep, and your notebook syncs across every device you use.
BUILT FOR JLPT
Sit N5 to N1 mock tests written to match the actual exam — vocabulary, grammar, reading, and listening. Finish one and you see exactly which sections are shaky, so you know what to look up before test day.
NEWS, AND A COMMUNITY THAT ANSWERS
Read Japanese news updated every day and tap any word to get its meaning without leaving the page. When you're stuck, over a million learners are in the community, answering questions and trading study tips.
GO PREMIUM
Premium clears the ads, unlocks offline lookup and translation for when you have no signal, and lifts the limits on camera lookups and your notebook. Add the AI plan for pronunciation coaching, grammar feedback, and Mazii's full set of AI translation models.
MADE FOR SERIOUS LEARNERS
- Living or working in Japan — read daily life as it happens
- Studying for JLPT — every level in one app
- Teaching yourself — everything in one place, not a dozen open tabs
- Traveling — signs, menus, and documents, decoded on the go
- Working through a textbook (Genki, Minna no Nihongo) — your dictionary and grammar, always open
Start free. Look up your first word.
Privacy Policy: https://mazii.net/privacy-policy.html
Terms of user: https://mazii.net/terms-of-user.html
Support: support@mazii.net

bluejetty:00025406:ios.description:
BeePass is a simple and secure VPN. Designed with your privacy in mind, BeePass VPN will help you access the internet securely and improve your digital privacy.
BizzBizz!!
- BeePass VPN is different.
- BeePass VPN is unlimited.
- BeePass VPN is Secure.
- BeePass VPN is open source.
Over the past 10 years, we’ve worked with and learnt from leading technologists, academics and researchers at the forefront of making internet access safer for all. Now we’ve put this knowledge into BeePass VPN to make it easier for you to securely access all your favourite websites and apps whenever and wherever you are. 
Here’s why BeePass is the right VPN for you:
Instead of running ads, we work directly with content providers, including civil society and media organizations, to deliver content to users via the landing page . These partnerships, in addition to our enterprise solutions and public funding sources help us keep BeePass VPN available to users.
It’s built with trust. Building on the model of Google Jigsaw’s Outline, BeePass is fully open source and powered by the well tested ShadowSocks protocol. We have worked over a decade to find the rights solutions for and with the user communities.
It goes the extra mile to protect you. We don’t ship BeePass VPN with servers because publicly listed servers come with certain risks. Our user-friendly system will help you find our servers safely and set up your private connection. It’s one extra click, but it’s worth it! 
It guards your privacy. We believe in privacy by design. BeePass VPN changes your IP, masks and encrypts your Internet traffic to better protect your online activities. We’ve designed our system to maintain the minimal amount of data necessary for us to provide you with a reliable service. Make sure to check out our Privacy Policy for more information. 
Please note that using BeePass VPN will not make you anonymous online. If you’re looking for a tool for anonymity, check out the Tor Project. 
It’s secure. We developed BeePass VPN using open source software that has gone through multiple security audits. It uses strong encryption to protect your Internet traffic in transit.

Whether you need a dictaphone for quick voice notes, an audio recorder for meetings, or a voice journaling app, Whisper Memos does it all. Just speak, and we turn your voice recording into clean, readable text.
START RECORDING INSTANTLY
-------------------------
Ideas are fleeting. Record audio in a fraction of a second with:
• Lock screen widget — tap once, start speaking
• Apple Watch complication — always one tap away, no unlocking
• Siri, Shortcuts & Action Button — hands-free voice recording
BEST AI SPEECH TO TEXT
----------------------
Choose between two leading speech recognition models:
• OpenAI Whisper — fast and reliable for everyday voice notes
• ElevenLabs Scribe — up to 96.7% accuracy, great for accents and multilingual speech
Transcribe voice memos in over 50 languages. Convert voice to text with near-perfect accuracy.
AI SUMMARIES & CUSTOM PROMPTS
-----------------------------
Every voice note gets an automatic AI summary. Create custom summary tabs with your own prompts — extract action items from meeting notes, organize your thoughts by topic, or format your AI notes however you like.
ADHD-FRIENDLY REMINDERS
-----------------------
Start any memo with "Remind me to..." and it gets pinned to your lock screen until you dismiss it. Perfect for an ADHD brain dump — capture what you need to do the moment it hits you.
VOICE RECORDER THAT TRANSCRIBES
-------------------------------
More than a simple dictaphone or sound recorder. Whisper Memos combines audio recording with powerful transcription and summarization, so you can record and transcribe in one step.
IMPORT ANY AUDIO FILE
---------------------
Already have recordings? Import MP3, M4A, WAV, AAC, FLAC, and OGG files and get audio to text transcription and summaries — just like a live recording.
WORKS EVERYWHERE
----------------
• Apple Watch app with standalone recording — a meeting recorder on your wrist
• Lock screen widget and Live Activity timer
• Offline recording — syncs when you're back online
• Up to 90-minute recordings with no daily limits
THOUSANDS OF INTEGRATIONS
-------------------------
Send your voice note transcription to Notion, Reflect, Todoist, Things 3, Day One, Evernote, Trello, Drafts, iCloud, and thousands more through Zapier.
ONE APP, MANY USES
------------------
• Voice to text dictation for drafts and outlines
• Meeting notes and lecture transcription
• Audio journaling and voice diary
• ADHD brain dump and task capture
• Personal note-taking and reminders
SIMPLE PRICING
--------------
One plan. All features. Unlimited recordings. Starting at $5/month.
For terms of use, visit https://whispermemos.com/terms

bluejetty:00087362:ios.name: Proof Meister: Measure Spirits
bluejetty:00087362:ios.summary:
DISTILL SMARTER. MEASURE ABV. STAY IN CONTROL. 
Proof Meister makes it easy to measure, monitor, and manage your distilling process. Whether you're making gin, whisky, vodka, grappa, or liqueurs, measure alcohol content, track distillation
bluejetty:00087362:ios.description:
DISTILL SMARTER. MEASURE ABV. STAY IN CONTROL. 
Proof Meister makes it easy to measure, monitor, and manage your distilling process. Whether you're making gin, whisky, vodka, grappa, or liqueurs, measure alcohol content, track distillation cuts, and organize your production runs — all in one app. 
Pair the app with EasyDens, SmartRef, or pH2Go to record precise measurements with ease. Measure density, refractive index, and pH with your Tony measuring devices. Combine EasyDens and SmartRef to determine ABV in liqueurs. 
No measuring device? You can also enter readings manually. 
TRACK YOUR PROCESS FROM MASH TO BOTTLING 
Stay in control of your spirits production, from fermentation to the finished product. 
- Monitor pH during mashing and fermentation 
- Measure ABV and proof throughout distillation 
- Document foreshots, heads, hearts, and tails during distillation 
- Log measurements at each stage to support decisions on distillation cuts 
- Track measurements during blending and bottling
RESULTS WITH CONTEXT 
Go beyond the measurement and understand what your results mean at each stage of the distilling process. 
- Select your spirit type, such as gin, vodka, whisky, or grappa 
- See expected ABV ranges based on the spirit you're making 
- Get measurement guidance that matches your distilling process 
- Check alcohol content and proof to reach your target bottling strength 
MEASURE SMARTER, CALCULATE LESS 
Spend less time calculating and more time perfecting your spirits. 
- Measure ABV and proof with EasyDens 
- Determine ABV in liqueurs with EasyDens and SmartRef 
- Automatic temperature compensation without manual correction tables 
- Switch between ABV (%v/v, %w/w), US Proof, and UK Proof 
- Measure in a range of units, including ABV at 15 °C and 20 °C, US Proof (60 °F), UK Proof (20 °C), density (g/cm³), and temperature (°C/°F) 
MANAGE RUNS & COMPARE RESULTS 
Keep your distilling history organized and use previous results to improve consistency from run to run. 
- Create custom batches and organize measurements with notes and timestamps 
- Save distillation runs, measurement notes, and project notes for recipes 
- Compare results across distilling runs 
- Find previous measurements and batches with full-text search 
- Copy or share individual measurement results 
- Export your data as PDF or CSV
YOUR DISTILLING, ALL IN ONE PLACE 
From fermentation and distillation to blending and bottling, Proof Meister brings your measurement data together in one place. Measure with connected devices, track distillation cuts, monitor alcohol content, and compare runs to make more informed decisions throughout your distilling process. 
With a free Meister Cloud account, sync your measurements and batches across compatible devices, including iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple Silicon Mac, Apple Vision Pro, and the web. Without a Meister Cloud account, your measurement data stays stored locally on your device. 
Learn more: https://www.get-tony.com/ 
SUPPORT 
Contact us at support@get-tony.com. 
PRIVACY POLICY 
https://www.get-tony.com/policies/privacy-policy 
TERMS OF USE 
https://www.get-tony.com/policies/legal-notice 
-------------- 
AUTO-RENEWABLE SUBSCRIPTION TERMS 
Proof Meister is free to download, with optional monthly and annual subscriptions for advanced features. 
Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. Payment and renewal pricing are displayed before purchase. 
Subscriptions and free trials can be managed or canceled in your Apple Account settings. If a free trial is offered, the subscription renews at the displayed price unless canceled before the trial ends.

bluejetty:00019251:ios.name: Moonlight Mahjong Lite
bluejetty:00019251:ios.summary: Moonlight Mahjong is Mahjong Solitaire in virtual reality 3D, designed specifically for the iPhone and iPad. Intuitive touch control allows you to tilt and turn, zoom in and out to match tiles in 3D. Play “arcade style” with progressively d
bluejetty:00019251:ios.description:
Moonlight Mahjong is Mahjong Solitaire in virtual reality 3D, designed specifically for the iPhone and iPad. Intuitive touch control allows you to tilt and turn, zoom in and out to match tiles in 3D. Play “arcade style” with progressively difficult levels and high scores, or relax with one of the non-competitive game modes. The gameplay is simple yet addictive.
Moonlight Mahjong features four main types of play:
• Scramble Mode: Match tiles faster than the automated opponent "Tilebot" through increasingly difficult levels. The board is automatically reshuffled when you run out of matches, making this game mode easy to start and fun, yet challenging on the higher levels.
• Challenge Mode: Compete against Tilebot in full puzzle mode, with no automatic reshuffling, only undo. Challenge requires more strategy than Scramble. This is the ‘pure’ form of the game, but it is difficult!
• Puzzle Mode: Solve puzzle boards with no time limit. Choose any layouts you like. This is the original game mode, what people usually think of as Mahjong Solitaire.
• Relaxation Mode: Clear boards with no time limit and automatic reshuffling when out of matches. Perfect for when you're just not in the mood to strategize or rush.
This free advertising-supported version of Moonlight Mahjong features five complete game modes (the main four, plus 'Lightning Mode'). The full version of Moonlight Mahjong offers a few additional features with no advertisements.
Moonlight Mahjong is the original 3D Mahjong Solitaire on iOS, having debuted with the launch of the App Store in 2008. It has been played millions of times and was honored as a "Best Board Game" on the App Store.

bluejetty:00121439:ios.name: Homicide Squad: Hidden Objects
bluejetty:00121439:ios.summary: The BEST crime-solving game is calling players for duty! Are you ready to prove your detective skills and step into a riveting world of danger, betrayal … and murder? Homicide Squad® is a heart-pounding hidden object and match-3 game filled
bluejetty:00121439:ios.description:
The BEST crime-solving game is calling players for duty! Are you ready to prove your detective skills and step into a riveting world of danger, betrayal … and murder? Homicide Squad® is a heart-pounding hidden object and match-3 game filled with rousing gameplay and perplexing murder mysteries!
Download this captivating crime game now and embark on a highly interactive hidden object journey. Play alongside the wisecracking Detectives Turino and Lamonte as they purge New York City of criminals and restore law and order. As cases stack up on your desk, you’ll visit unique locations and examine troubling murder scenes. Enjoy immersive gameplay and engaging storylines as you investigate haunting cases, interact with intriguing characters and catch twisted killers. Do you have what it takes to find important objects and solve a baffling crime? There’s only one way to find out! Grab your magnifying glass and put on your detective’s hat because this is one criminal thrill ride you won’t want to miss!
A string of horrifying homicides has been reported across the city in this gripping murder mystery game. To bring the perpetrators to justice and reinstate peace of mind for residents, you’ll have to:
CHOOSE your favorite gameplay mode for any scene
• FIND hidden objects and use them or
• MATCH gems in a row,
• INTERROGATE cagey suspects,
• ANALYZE strange clues, and
• SOLVE mind-blowing crimes!
Plus more criminal cases and quests are coming in regular updates that are absolutely FREE!
If you like making in-app purchases in this game, Homicide Squad: Hidden Crimes also offers three optional, auto-renewable subscriptions that provide substantial benefits compared to individual in-app purchases.
1. Bonus Tokens: Get three bonus tokens every time you successfully search an ordinary scene or complete laboratory research! The monthly subscription is only $9.99.
2. Energy Freeze: Play for 30 minutes every day without having to spend any energy! The monthly subscription is only $19.99.
3. Double Energy: Double how fast your energy restores itself! The monthly subscription is only $14.99.
A one-time, seven-day trial is available for both the Bonus Tokens and Energy Freeze subscriptions. At the end of the trial period, each subscription will be automatically renewed unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the trial period. Payment for the renewal will be automatically debited from your account.
Payments for the monthly subscriptions to Bonus Tokens, Energy Freeze and Double Energy will be charged to your Apple ID account with the confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions or turn off auto-renewal by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
Should you choose to subscribe, please note that the current payment period cannot be canceled or prorated.
While this game is absolutely free to play, you have the ability to unlock optional bonuses via in-app purchases from within the game. You may disable in-app purchases in your device settings.
You can play this game even if you’re offline!
Game available in: English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish.

bluejetty:00159365:ios.name: Arculus Wallet
bluejetty:00159365:ios.summary: Arculus is the next-gen crypto and NFT cold storage wallet solution. The Arculus Wallet App lets you securely hold the world’s leading cryptocurrencies and NFTs. Arculus features an easy-to-use mobile app and a sleek, metal card where you s
bluejetty:00159365:ios.description:
Arculus is the next-gen crypto and NFT cold storage wallet solution. The Arculus Wallet App lets you securely hold the world’s leading cryptocurrencies and NFTs. Arculus features an easy-to-use mobile app and a sleek, metal card where you store and control your private keys. Arculus was created by CompoSecure, a 20-year leader in security, payment, and digital-asset storage technology solutions. 
HOW ARCULUS WORKS
Your Arculus wallet solution is made up of two parts that work together: a physical Arculus Key™ Card and the mobile Arculus Wallet™ App. The Arculus Key Card is a sleek, metal card with leading-edge embedded security technology, a CC EAL6+ Secure Element Hardware Classification, to securely store your crypto and NFT keys. The card can be purchased at the Arculus website – getarculus.com.
Your Arculus wallet protects your digital assets with 3-factor authentication relying on something you are (a biometric marker), something you know (a PIN), and something you have (your Arculus Key Card).
Arculus has no cables, no Bluetooth, or USB connections and it never needs to be charged. It’s true cold storage. Your private keys are stored on the card and are always in your possession.
With Arculus, you don’t have to toggle between screens or push tiny buttons on a USB drive. Just enter your PIN and tap your card to the back of your phone.
It’s digital asset security made simple.

bluejetty:00063503:ios.description:
Train your baseball players and create a winning team!
Can you lead your high school baseball team to ultimate victory? It might be a small after-school club now, but with the right training, even the sky isn't the limit for this team!
Train players by assigning them practice drills. You choose what they need to focus on, such as batting or pitching.
Install batting cages, showers, or other facilities to make life better for the team. A good environment makes for more effective training! School life is not all about sports, though. Studying is just as important, so make sure to construct educational facilities to upgrade the school.
House students in a dorm and they'll have more time for both studying and baseball practice! Pick your best players for the team and test their skill at tournaments.
*This game only supports landscape mode.
--

Be sure to check out both our free-to-play and our paid games!

bluejetty:00186833:ios.description:
New cars, stickers, wheels and other improvements! Now it is much funnier to create unique cars for the race, drive faster than lightning, and cross obstacles on the road!
With this exciting app children can enjoy beeping, accelerating and jumping on trampolines as they ride on different vehicles. For some added fun, the game also includes interactive objects on the way for kids to click. Set off on an exciting journey with your friend - racer Raccoon!
Features of the app:
· Travel to 6 new different locations
· Choose from different high-speed cars
· Paint or improve your cars in a garage
· Paste bright and funny car stickers
· Enjoy this easy and fun-to-play game
· Listen to the stunning sound effects and music
· Delight yourself with the funny cartoon graphics
· Play without internet
This entertaining game is suitable for kids aged 1 year and above. Let your children learn to be creative, attentive and determined, as they play this game!
There are many different activities designed to capture toddlers’ attention as they travel around in fancy cars:
-Add improvements like turbo boosters, flashers, sirens, balloons and other accessories
-Paint the car in different attractive colors
-Draw with brushes or use paint cans - it’s your choice!
-Choose wheels for your vehicle - small, large or unusual ones
-Decorate the car with stickers and superhero badges
Have loads of fun with such superb vehicles:
· Ambulance
· Police car
· Superhero machine
· Fire engine
· Dump truck
· Mini van
· Racing car
· Yellow duck car
· Retro car
· Locomotive
· Hot dog car
· Monster truck
· Sports car and many more!
This adventurous car game is simple, exciting, and educative! That’s exactly what kids need!
