bluejetty:00177141:ios.description:
Welcome to English Conversation Practice, the ultimate app for improving your English language skills! Our app features daily conversations in English that you can read and listen to at the same time.
One of the main advantages of reading and listening at the same time is that it helps you to better understand the flow and rhythm of the language. It also allows you to pick up on common phrases and expressions that might be difficult to understand just by listening or reading alone.
With English Conversation Practice, you'll have access to a wide range of topics and scenarios, including casual conversations, business meetings, and more. Each conversation includes a transcript that you can follow along with as you listen, and the app features interactive exercises to help you practice and retain what you've learned.
Whether you're a beginner or an advanced learner, our app is designed to help you improve your English language skills in a fun and engaging way. So why wait? Start practicing your English today with English Conversation Practice!

bluejetty:00096942:ios.name: Dealer's Life Legend
bluejetty:00096942:ios.summary:
Welcome to the Pecunian Empire, travelling merchant!
Head between our many cities, expand your collection of wares, and grow your riches. If your talent and skill are sharp enough, you may be in with a shot of winning the Wandering Merchan
bluejetty:00096942:ios.description:
Welcome to the Pecunian Empire, travelling merchant!
Head between our many cities, expand your collection of wares, and grow your riches. If your talent and skill are sharp enough, you may be in with a shot of winning the Wandering Merchant Quest and proving that YOU are the best dealer in town!
The revolutionary Trade Engine makes its comeback once again, and it has never been this good! Study your customers, note their actions, and use your dealer’s skill to make the best deals!
HONE YOUR SILVER TONGUE
During your growth as a merchant, you’ll come across quests that will allow you to gain unique items or add boons to your skills. The never-ending quest to become a better trader will improve your negotiation skills and revolutionize your enterprise!
Customize your character and shop for a more personalized experience! You can change their appearances to your liking and even assign a background to your avatar by selecting their ancestry.
WARES ON WHEELS
All cities have unique gameplay mechanics and services that suit a specific type of negotiation skills. It will be up to your abilities to understand which places are the best to become rich!
AN EVOLVING WORLD CHANGING BASED ON YOUR CHOICES
While carrying your shop around the world, you may meet some recurring characters able to remember your choices and act accordingly. Did you choose to aid that poor merchant while he was struggling? He will reward you for your good deed by offering many gifts and buffs that will help you in your adventure. Oh, wait… Did you choose to ignore him, or worse, take advantage of him to take out the competition? Then you better run because they will try to pay you for the same treatment!

bluejetty:00177633:ios.summary:

Track products, equipment, supplies, stock levels, prices, and item in
bluejetty:00177633:ios.description:
Inventory Control with Scanner is an inventory management, stock tracking, and barcode scanner app for professionals, small businesses, and personal inventory workflows.
Track products, equipment, supplies, stock levels, prices, and item information from iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Scan barcodes to find items quickly, add inventory, adjust stock, and keep recently scanned products ready for follow-up.
INVENTORY MANAGEMENT
• Add, search, update, and organize inventory items.
• Track stock, product information, and prices.
• Add items manually or with the built-in barcode scanner.
• Attach product images and organize categories, storage areas, suppliers, merchants, and currencies.
BARCODE SCANNER
• Scan barcodes to find, add, open, or adjust stock items.
• Keep recently scanned items available while you continue scanning.
• Use the built-in camera scanner or compatible Bluetooth barcode scanners.
BARCODE & LABEL GENERATION
• Create and print barcode labels for products and inventory.
• Print on standard A4, US Letter, and roll formats.
• Supports EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC, Code 39, Code 93, Code 128, QR, and QR Mini.
PRO FEATURES
• Sign in with Apple.
• Work offline without requiring Wi-Fi or a data connection.
• Sync data between your devices with an eligible subscription.
REPORTS & CUSTOMIZATION
• Create, print, email, and share professional PDF reports.
• Import and export CSV files.
• Add custom attributes and personalize reports for your workflow.
STARKODE PRO
Part of the Starkode Pro series for professionals working across iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Need help? Contact support@starkode.com.
SUBSCRIPTION
Starkode membership is month-to-month with no long-term contracts or cancellation fees. Cancel anytime from your device.
Privacy Policy: https://starkode.com/privacy/

Rsbux is a fast, exciting game that trains your attention and speed in just one minute. Specially designed for kids but equally fun for adults, Rsbux challenges players to spot the odd one out among fruits, animals, and shapes. It’s simple to play yet tough to master.

• Scoring system: correct tap +10 points, wrong tap -10 points
• My Score section to track history with player name, score, level, game type, and play date/time
• Leaderboard to see the top players worldwide
• Sound control to enable or disable game audio anytime
Perfect for kids to learn while playing and for adults to sharpen focus, Rsbux is a family-friendly game that combines fun with skill-building.
Download Rsbux today and see how fast you can spot the difference.

Do you drink enough water?
Do you always forget to drink water regularly?
Are you in good shape?
You need Water Drink Reminder - a water tracker app to help you develop good habits of water drinking!
This water tracker app reminds you to drink water every day to keep you hydrated.
The benefits of drinking water:
* Stay in shape and keep fit; water is calorie free
* Clears up your skin
* Keeps your skin and nails healthy
* Helps prevent kidney stones
* Keeps you hydrated
Key Feature of Drink Water Reminder – Water Diet Tracker & Alarm :
- Drink Water Reminder and Tracker will help you by calculating how much water you need, tracking what you drink, and gently reminding you when to drink.
- My Water Balance: Daily Drink Tracker & Reminder
- Drink Water Reminder – Water Diet Tracker & Alarm is improve your health with personal drink notifications.

- Drink Water Reminder and Tracker is helps you to have a good water balance on your body using notification drink reminde

- Easy to add or remove a serving from the water tracker.
- Drink Water Reminder is easy to use yet more than effective!
- Supports imperial (fl. oz.) and Metric (ml) unit
Advantages of have a good water balance :
+ Stay slimmer
Revs up metabolism and helps you feel full.
+ Boosts your energy
If you're feeling drained and depleted, drink more.
+ Lower stress
85% of your brain tissue is water.
+ Build muscle tone
Water benefit is to prevent muscle cramping and lubricates joints in the body.
+ Nourish your skin
Fine lines and wrinkles are deeper when you're dehydrated. drinking hydrates skin cells and plumps them up, making your face look younger.
+ Better Health
Improve your health plans and move a head with finest water delivery.
Make Water as your best friend, By drinking water on time one will get the innumerable benefits of drinking water: Relief from fatigue, Weight loss, glowing skin, Heartburn etc... this Water Drinking Reminder with Alarm helps you to achieve this benefits.
Set the water reminder automatically based on your sleep time, wake up time and reminder interval based on this water drink reminder will determine how much water your body needs on a daily basis.
At present day work-life drinking enough water on time will be very challenging, this Water drinking app makes easier to stay hydrated
Water drinking tracker is a very secure app
Have fun, sharing the water intake with your friends using this drink water reminder,

bluejetty:00186742:ios.name: Dinosaur Rescue Truck Games
bluejetty:00186742:ios.summary:
Embark on an Exciting Roadside Adventure with Our Interactive Car and Truck Games for Kids!
Is there a car broken down on the roadside? It's time for your little one to spring into action! Introducing our engaging tow truck and trailer res
bluejetty:00186742:ios.description:
Embark on an Exciting Roadside Adventure with Our Interactive Car and Truck Games for Kids!
Is there a car broken down on the roadside? It's time for your little one to spring into action! Introducing our engaging tow truck and trailer rescue games, perfectly designed for young car enthusiasts. Let your child take the driver's seat in their very own tow truck to rescue the stranded vehicle. This immersive experience is not just about towing; it's a journey from roadside assistance to workshop wonders!
Our app, tailored for children aged 2-5, offers an extraordinary chance to dive into the world of car and truck games. With 4 distinct tow vehicles at their disposal, your child can enjoy the thrill of driving car models ranging from racing cars to fire trucks and even police cars. Each vehicle presents a unique challenge and learning opportunity, enhancing both motor skills and imagination.
Explore 4 Vibrant Game Scenes in Our Truck and Car Driving Games
In our dynamic game world, your child will explore 4 different scenes, each offering more than 30 interactive elements to spark curiosity and engagement. Whether it's repairing cars in the workshop, painting them in vibrant colors, or fitting them with big, beautiful new tires, the possibilities for creative play are endless.
Why Choose Our Rescue Vehicle and Race Car Games for Kids?
• Educational and Fun: These tow truck and race car games are more than just entertainment. They offer a platform for children to learn about various vehicles and their functions in a fun and engaging way.
• Inspire Imagination: Working with trucks, racing cars, rescue vehicles, and more can ignite a child's imagination. As they play, they can craft their own stories and adventures.
• Safe and Kid-Friendly: Our app is designed to be a safe digital playground. With no third-party advertising and the ability to play without the Internet, it's a worry-free app for parents.
• Designed for Young Minds: The intuitive gameplay and interactive features are suitable for toddlers and preschool children, ensuring an enriching experience for the young age group.
In this world of car and truck games, every day is an adventure. From towing broken-down vehicles with a tow truck to racing down the track in a race car, your child's journey through our game scenes will be filled with excitement and learning. So why wait? Let your child's imagination run wild with our tow truck and car driving games. It's time to go rescue!
About Yateland:
Yateland's educational apps ignite the passion for learning through play among preschool children worldwide. We stand by our motto: "Apps that children love and parents trust." For more information about Yateland and our apps, please visit https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy:
Yateland is committed to protecting user privacy. To understand how we handle these matters, please read our complete privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

bluejetty:00182664:ios.name: Rise Up! Protect the Balloon
bluejetty:00182664:ios.summary: Welcome to Rise Up, the exciting mobile game that challenges you to protect a balloon as it rises higher and higher into the sky. Get ready to put your skills to the ultimate test with this fantastic game that'll keep your eyes glued to the
bluejetty:00182664:ios.description:
Welcome to Rise Up, the exciting mobile game that challenges you to protect a balloon as it rises higher and higher into the sky. Get ready to put your skills to the ultimate test with this fantastic game that'll keep your eyes glued to the screen.
Picture this. You have a tiny balloon you need to protect. You must push away all the pointy and heavy things that get in the way of your balloon rising. But it's not that easy. The sky is full of strange things like blocks, beams, and triangles. If your balloon even touches one of these, it's all over. Exciting, right?
But it gets even better! The higher your balloon goes, the harder the game gets. The obstacles become trickier and more challenging to avoid. You can push everything out of the way, but watch out! If you send blocks flying everywhere, you'll have a hard time protecting your balloon.
Why you'll spend hours playing Rise Up:
- Tons of challenging game levels
- Ultimate test of your reflexes & quick thinking
- Perfect for on-the-go gaming
- Exciting gaming sessions
- Captivating 2D graphics & animation
Can you get to level 100? Only the best players can! Ready to give it a try? Let's play Rise Up and see how high you can go!
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
Subscription options
In Rise Up we offer you the following subscription option:
- Weekly Diamond Membership offers a weekly subscription for $3.99 after a 3-day free trial. It gives you new skins, access to special missions and removes ads.
End of trial and subscription renewal
This price is for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Canceling trial or subscription
You can turn off the auto-renew for the subscription whenever you want to through iTunes account. Check https://support.apple.com/HT202039. When your current trial/subscription period expires, you will be unsubscribed. The current active subscription period cannot be canceled. After your subscription expires, you will no longer be able to use elements offered in your chosen Subscription Option. 
Privacy Policy: https://aigames.ae/policy#privacy
Terms of Use: https://aigames.ae/policy#terms

bluejetty:00069181:ios.description:
Watermark Maker is the all-in-one app for photographers, creators, and businesses who want to protect and brand their photos and videos — effortlessly.
Whether you're posting to Instagram, sharing on WhatsApp, or publishing content professionally, stamp your identity on every piece of content before it leaves your hands.
PHOTOS & VIDEOS
Add watermarks to photos and videos in seconds. Batch-process your entire camera roll to save time.
BUILD YOUR BRAND
• Signature watermarks — draw or type your own digital signature
• Custom logos — import your logo with a transparent background
• Text overlays — names, hashtags, social handles, copyright symbols, dates, locations, and more
• Pre-designed templates — hundreds of ready-to-use watermark styles
DESIGN TOOLS
• Fonts gallery — choose from hundreds of built-in fonts
• Dynamic colors — apply any color with custom transparency control
• Cool stickers — vast library of clip art and graphic elements
• Pixel-perfect positioning — place your watermark exactly where you want it
• Advanced text tools — adjust size, spacing, and color with precision
PHOTO EDITING
• Filters — apply beautiful filters to enhance your photos
• Smart crop — crop to custom sizes or preset ratios for Instagram, Facebook, and more
STATUS & STORY MAKER
Turn your watermarked photos and videos into stunning social media stories and statuses — ready to share in one tap.
SHARE EVERYWHERE
Export directly to Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, Twitter, and any other platform.
Protect your work. Build your brand. Own your content.
This app contains subscription :
- You can subscribe for premium account to unlock all premium templates, stickers, artworks and no ads
- Subscription is from $2.99 weekly, $7.99 USD monthly and $29.99 yearly
- Subscription automatically renews for the same price and duration period as the original one month, one year package unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Links to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy can be found below
Privacy Policy: https://watermarkphotos.web.app/privacy
Terms of Service: https://watermarkphotos.web.app/terms

bluejetty:00065993:ios.name: GeoFS - Flight Simulator
bluejetty:00065993:ios.summary: GeoFS is a multiplayer flight simulator displaying a global scenery from satellite images. Whether you are a licensed pilot practicing VFR, an aviation enthusiast or just looking for some fun flying in beautiful landscapes, you can enjoy an
bluejetty:00065993:ios.description:
GeoFS is a multiplayer flight simulator displaying a global scenery from satellite images. Whether you are a licensed pilot practicing VFR, an aviation enthusiast or just looking for some fun flying in beautiful landscapes, you can enjoy any of the 20 available aircraft, ranging from paraglider to airliners, absolutely anywhere in the world..
This app includes:
- Worldwide 1m/pixel Super Resolution imagery - AI enhanced satellite images
- Worldwide (10m resolution) satellite images and elevation model
- Realistic physics and flight models
- Global multiplayer
- Navigation charts with 40,000 referenced runways
- Radio Navigation (GPS, ADF, VOR, NDB, DME)
- 30+ different aircraft with instrumented cockpits
- ADS-B real-life commercial traffic
- Replay mode
- Seasons, day/night and real-time weather conditions from METAR (wind, clouds, fog, precipitations)
Included aircraft:
- Piper J3 Cub
- Cessna 172
- Dassault Breguet / Dornier Alpha Jet
- Boeing 737-700
- Embraer Phenom 100
- de Havilland DHC-6 Twin Otter
- F-16 Fighting Falcon
- Pitts Special S1
- Eurocopter EC135
- Airbus A380
- Alisport Silent 2 Electro (Motor Glider)
- Pilatus PC-7
- de Havilland DHC-2 Beaver
- Colomban MC-15 Cri-cri
- Lockheed P-38 Lightning F-5B
- Douglas DC-3
- Sukhoi Su-35
- Concorde
- Piper PA-28 161 Warrior II
- Airbus A350
- Boeing 777-300ER
- Major Tom (Hot Air Balloon)
Available via in-app purchase:
- HD subscription for global high resolution satellite images. (Microsoft Bing Maps Imagery)
An internet connection (WiFi recommended) is necessary to run GeoFS.

Tile Axiom is an engaging and addictive tile-matching puzzle game! 
Dive into the classic world of Mahjong Solitaire with a fresh twist.

bluejetty:00185528:ios.summary:
Live results for track & field and cross country, the second they're official.
Finished Results puts the whole meet in your pocket. Follow along event by event as marks post, watch team scores move, and know exactly where your team stands
bluejetty:00185528:ios.description:
Live results for track & field and cross country, the second they're official.
Finished Results puts the whole meet in your pocket. Follow along event by event as marks post, watch team scores move, and know exactly where your team stands without refreshing a PDF on stadium wifi.
WATCH THE MEET UNFOLD
Live results, event by event, each one marked as it's scored
The full meet schedule by day, so you know what's on deck and when
Search any event, athlete or school
Official team scores for men and women, with a breakdown of every point a team earned and the event it came from
CROSS COUNTRY, DONE RIGHT
Individual results with mile splits, so you can watch places change between the first mile and the finish
Team scoring with team time, average time, average mile and 5-man gap
Top 7 for every team, with each runner's place and time
THE REPORTS THAT TELL THE STORY
Medal Count: gold, silver and bronze by team, for men, women or combined
Podium Report: every event's top finishers in one scroll, filterable to the top 3, 5 or 8
MVP Report: the meet's highest scorers, with track and field points broken out
Record Report: the moment a meet, facility or conference record falls, next to the mark it beat
Session Report: everything scheduled in each session, in order
FOLLOW YOUR TEAM
A page for every school with results across every event, plus the full roster
Follow a team and go straight to them at the next meet
Multi-event athletes covered too, with decathlon and heptathlon standings, event-by-event points and records
SHARE IT
Turn any result into a post-ready graphic: team results, individual marks, podiums
Story, post and square sizes for Instagram and anywhere else
Choose a background, toggle what appears on the card, then download or share in one tap
FIND YOUR NEXT MEET
Meets Near Me, with an adjustable radius and lookback window
A browsable calendar of meets by month, from invitationals through conference championships
Built by timers, for everyone at the meet. Finished Results is the live results platform behind high school invitationals, college conference championships and everything in between.
Free. No account. No sign-up. Open it and find your meet.

Introducing the new and exciting iKout! the famous kout game. Join your friends, family and thousands of players in a new online social gaming experience.
iKout has been completely redesigned from scratch! We’ve also gone multiplatform!
FEATURES
- Play by yourself, or with others around the world.
- Invite your friends and family and play together in a game of kout, wherever you are, and whatever device platform!
- Gain experience and level up to unlock higher multiplayer Venues, each with a different game configuration (4/6 players, 26/51/101 score).
- Complete various challenges to reach higher levels, faster!
- Compete with your friends to climb the top of the leaderboards.
- Choose from various different avatar and voice sets. Unlock characters as you play.
- Learn the basic rules of the game in the new interactive tutorial.
- Customize the highly immersive game theme to your liking. Choose your favorite custom in-game background and cards.
- Choose your preferred game interface language, as well as the character voice cues. (Available in ENGLISH and ARABIC for now. Please let us know if you feel left out!)

- Follow us on Instagram @DiwaniyaLabs

bluejetty:00113532:android.description:
Are you looking for pen pals and friends in North America & Canada countries? Apenpals app has many people looking for new friends online at these countries.
Why do you need a friend? You need a friend to share your happiness with each other. You can share and learn about different cultures, learn a new language, society, lifestyles and so on from all countries. You can connect friends locally and around the world for international email, nail mail, language exchange, friendship pen pals.
You can find online American and Canadian pen friends by a few clicks. Whether you're senior or young, you're coming to the right place. You need someone to share your daily life. Don't be alone. Go ahead to search for pal friends from a country you like. In this 4.0 internet world, finding friends online saves us time and energy.
Create your profile and tell the world about who you are and what types of pen pals in the US and Canada you are looking for. Next, upload your photos because a picture is worth a thousand words so be sure to upload some to get potential matches interested. - 18 Backgrounds

3. Master, World Cup rules based on championship matches in Germany.
Click the "i" button on the main menu for the full rulebook.

bluejetty:00147338:ios.description:
The Daily Smark is your all-in-one wrestling entertainment app for news, videos, podcasts, and events in one place. Covering WWE Raw, SmackDown, NXT, AEW Dynamite, TNA, NJPW, NWA, MLW, AAA, Evolve, Stardom, and more. Filter the news by promotion and never miss a headline. Articles and videos also display company badges so you can quickly see which promotion they're about.
Tired of cluttered, ad-heavy wrestling websites? The Daily Smark opens articles in Reader Mode, stripping away the ads and extra fluff so you can focus on the actual story.
Never miss a moment of the action. Browse the latest YouTube videos from WWE, AEW, TNA, and more. Rotate your phone to enjoy videos in full landscape mode. Short on time? Bookmark any article or video to read or watch later at your own convenience.
All wrestling fans love a great podcast. Whether it's the top stars of today or your favorite independent voices in pro wrestling, The Daily Smark has you covered. Search, subscribe, and get notified of new episodes from the best wrestling podcasts in Apple's Podcast Directory. Can't find a podcast? Report it as missing and we'll look into adding it.
Stay on top of upcoming Shows, PLEs and Live Events with the Events tab. The app shows you what wrestling to watch tonight and live events in your area. You can also ppt into push notifications for your favorite shows WWE Raw, AEW Dynamite, PPVs, new podcast episodes, and more.
Create a free account to sync your Bookmarks, Podcast subscriptions, and Settings across all your devices. Never lose your saved content when switching phones or tablets. You can also customize the app to work your way in the Settings screen.
There's no big company behind the scenes here. This app and the entire platform were built from the ground up by a wrestling fan, for wrestling fans. If you're enjoying The Daily Smark as your go-to wrestling entertainment app, please leave a review and share it with your fellow fans!

bluejetty:00023214:ios.name: Aviation Weather Route Planner
bluejetty:00023214:ios.summary: Plan the weather along your whole flight, not one airport at a time. Aviation Weather Route Planner shows METAR, TAF and NOTAM for every airport on your route — and the diversion options beside it — on one map, decoded and ready for your pr
bluejetty:00023214:ios.description:
Plan the weather along your whole flight, not one airport at a time. Aviation Weather Route Planner shows METAR, TAF and NOTAM for every airport on your route — and the diversion options beside it — on one map, decoded and ready for your preflight briefing.
ROUTE WEATHER AT A GLANCE
Build a route from 50,000+ airports worldwide. Each airport on the map carries its flight category ring (VFR, MVFR, IFR, LIFR), and airports along the corridor appear automatically as alternates, each with its own weather. Step through the stops to see leg distance, magnetic course and ETE for your cruise speed.
DECODED METAR & TAF
Raw or decoded, your choice. See wind with gusts, visibility, ceiling, temperature/dew point spread warnings and what limits the flight category. TAF periods appear as cards — TEMPO, BECMG, FM and PROB — with their own category and hazards such as thunderstorms, cumulonimbus, icing, turbulence and wind shear.
RUNWAY WIND
Headwind, tailwind and crosswind for every runway end, now and for each TAF period. Runways closed by NOTAM are flagged right on the runway diagram.
NOTAMS THAT MATTER
NOTAMs for the aerodrome and its FIR, sorted into categories you can filter: runway, taxiway, navaid, obstacle, airspace and more. Critical items stand out, active-now and expiring-soon are marked, and the last download stays available offline.
PILOT BRIEFING – OFFLINE
Save a briefing with the METAR, TAF, NOTAM and runway data of every airport on a route or group, read it in the air without a connection, and share it as text.
AIRPORT GROUPS
Keep your home field, favourite destinations or training area in groups and check them all in seconds.
MORE FOR PILOTS
• Runway lengths, surfaces, lighting and approach data
• Sunrise, sunset and civil twilight
• Search nearby airports and filter by runway length
• Built-in, searchable User Guide
• US or ICAO units, set for your region
• iCloud sync between iPhone and iPad
• iPad layout with the map beside your route
FREE & UNLIMITED
Store up to 5 airports and 5 briefings for free. A one-time Unlimited purchase removes the limits.
Weather data: aviationweather.gov. NOTAMs: FAA NOTAM System. Always verify with official sources before flight.
Enjoy the app & fly safe!
— The FlyGo-Aviation Team

Each airport on the map carries its flight category ring (VFR, MVFR, IFR, LIFR), and airports along the corridor appear automatically as alternates, each with its own weather. Step through the stops to see leg distance, magnetic course and ETE for your cruise speed.

DECODED METAR & TAF
Raw or decoded, your choice. See wind with gusts, visibility, ceiling, temperature/dew point spread warnings and what limits the flight category. TAF periods appear as cards — TEMPO, BECMG, FM and PROB — with their own category and hazards such as thunderstorms, cumulonimbus, icing, turbulence and wind shear.

RUNWAY WIND
Headwind, tailwind and crosswind for every runway end, now and for each TAF period. Runways closed by NOTAM are flagged right on the runway diagram.

NOTAMS THAT MATTER
NOTAMs for the aerodrome and its FIR, sorted into categories you can filter: runway, taxiway, navaid, obstacle, airspace and more. Critical items stand out, active-now and expiring-soon are marked, and the last download stays available offline.

PILOT BRIEFING – OFFLINE
Save a briefing with the METAR, TAF, NOTAM and runway data of every airport on a route or group, read it in the air without a connection, and share it as text.

AIRPORT GROUPS
Keep your home field, favourite destinations or training area in groups and check them all in seconds.

MORE FOR PILOTS
• Runway lengths, surfaces, lighting and approach data
• Sunrise, sunset and civil twilight
• Search nearby airports and filter by runway length
• Built-in, searchable User Guide
• US or ICAO units, set for your region
• iCloud sync between iPhone and iPad
• iPad layout with the map beside your route

FREE & UNLIMITED
Store up to 5 airports and 5 briefings for free. A one-time Unlimited purchase removes the limits.

Weather data: aviationweather.gov. NOTAMs: FAA NOTAM System. Always verify with official sources before flight.

Enjoy the app & fly safe!
— The FlyGo-Aviation Team

bluejetty:00100573:ios.description:
Welcome to Shelf Master 3D: Goods Sorting, the ultimate game for anyone who finds joy in perfect order! Experience the deeply relaxing satisfaction of tidying up, now brought to life in stunning, fully rotatable 3D. If you love the thrill of matching puzzles and the calm of a well-organized space, this is your new favorite escape.
A Satisfying 3D Organization Fantasy
Forget flat puzzles! Our shelves are vibrant, dimensional worlds. Zoom in, rotate around, and immerse yourself as you tackle cluttered shelves loaded with hundreds of unique items—from colorful beverages and sweet desserts to adorable toys. Your mission is to bring harmony to the chaos through intuitive drag-and-drop gameplay.
Intelligent & Engaging Gameplay
Smart Sorting: Organize items by type, color, or brand. Match three identical items to clear them, or create perfectly categorized sections to complete the challenge.
Strategic Challenges: Start with simple shelves and progress to complex puzzles that test your logic and foresight. Plan your moves wisely to overcome spatial constraints and tricky layouts.
Diverse Worlds: Explore various themed modes, including a delightful Dessert Mode, a refreshing Beverage Mode, and a charming Decor Mode, each with its own unique items and aesthetics.
Your Relaxing Mini-Game: ""Tidy Zen Garden""
When you need a moment of pure calm, step into the ""Tidy Zen Garden."" This serene sandbox mode offers a pressure-free space to tidy and arrange items at your own pace. No timers, no goals—just the soothing sounds and tactile joy of creating your own perfectly peaceful corner. It's the perfect digital detox.
Key Features:
Hundreds of Levels: Enjoy endless hours of brain-teasing fun with challenges that are easy to start but rewarding to master.
Smooth 360° Controls: Examine every angle with intuitive and fluid controls.
Helpful Power-Ups: Use boosts like the Magnet, Hint, and Time Freezer to get through extra-tough puzzles.
Play Offline: Your organization journey doesn't need the internet—play anywhere, anytime.
Inclusive Design: A dedicated Colorblind Mode ensures everyone can enjoy the sorting fun.
Download Shelf Master 3D: Goods Sorting now and discover why millions are finding focus, fun, and relaxation in the art of organization. Your path to a tidier, happier mind starts here!

The Federal Office provides you with the complete catalog of examination questions approved for the "Leben in Deutschland" test, allowing you to prepare for the Einbürgerungstest. This catalog comprises a total of 310 questions, including 300 general questions and 10 questions specific to the respective federal state, which are to be answered only for that particular state.
There is always only one correct answer – therefore, please mark only one box for each question. You will immediately be shown the correct answer afterward.
To proceed to the next question, please click on the "Next" button. If you wish to go back, click on the "Previous" button. Alternatively, you can display a specific question by selecting the desired number from the offered list under "Select question Nr."
------------------------------------------------------------------

- you can learn all question related to your Bundesland
- you can mark wrong answered questions and practice them later
- you can make tests to check your skills before real exam
- you can translate the questions and answers to your native language
Good luck on the exam!
Your Leben in DE Team!

Vision
The Vision instrument employs structured-light lidar-enabled infrared laser grid imaging, AI-driven computer vision, GPU-based image filtering, and advanced hardware management to deliver unparalleled night-vision, image processing, and real-time human-like figure detection.
*Lidar is available only on Pro devices.
Spirit Box
The Spirit Box instrument leverages live streaming radio stations, advanced signal processing, real-time audio analysis, and dynamic frequency scanning to generate a blend of white noise and brief audio fragments. It is hypothesized that spiritual entities can manipulate these audio fragments using their energy, resulting in intelligible communications.
Spatial Matrix
The Spatial Matrix instrument uses LiDAR depth mapping, real-time mesh reconstruction, and GPU-accelerated analysis to visualize the geometric structure of the surrounding environment. It is theorized that paranormal energies may subtly distort these patterns, allowing investigators to observe potential manifestations within three-dimensional space.
*Pro devices only.
Music Box
The Music Box instrument employs advanced sensor integration, real-time data analysis, and precise environmental monitoring to detect subtle changes in the ambient environment. In the realm of paranormal research, this instrument is utilized to identify the potential presence of paranormal phenomena.
PEVP-VOX
The Spirit Vox instrument generates a continuous sound bed composed of phonetic fragments, tonal shifts, and raw audio textures through advanced sound synthesis and real-time modulation. It is hypothesized that subtle environmental influences can manipulate these fragments, shaping them into speech-like bursts that may convey meaningful communication.
EVP-ITC
The EVP-ITC instrument employs full sensor integration to detect subtle environmental fluctuations and presents words based on an advanced, proprietary phonetically-based computational algorithm. Instrumental Trans-Communication (ITC) devices operate on the theory that paranormal entities can communicate by influencing the ITC device’s sensors.
EMF
The EMF instrument allows for precise detection, measurement, and visualization of ambient electromagnetic field levels across the electromagnetic spectrum in real-time. It is hypothesized that paranormal entities can influence and generate electromagnetic fields, which are detectable by the EMF instrument.
Audio-EVP
The Audio instrument analyzes intricate and nuanced audio signals to provide insights into the underlying acoustic properties of the environment. It is theorized that spirits or supernatural entities can manipulate acoustic wave data to produce electronic voice phenomena (EVP) not audible during the initial recording session.
Frequency-EVP
The Frequency instrument analyzes complex frequency signal harmonics to identify subtle variations and anomalies within the underlying acoustic environment. It is suggested that high audio frequencies, near and beyond the limit of human hearing, could be linked to paranormal phenomena.
Geoscope
The Geoscope instrument leverages gyroscope and accelerometer sensors to detect even the minutest device movements or vibrations. This functionality is predicated on the hypothesis that paranormal entities can induce subtle vibrations, such as footsteps or knocking sounds.
Barometer
The Barometer instrument employs the device’s advanced barometric sensor to detect extremely subtle variations in ambient pressure. This functionality is based on the hypothesis that paranormal phenomena may induce sudden or unexplained changes in pressure.

bluejetty:00120223:ios.description:
Learn Arabic Online with Kaleela!
Discover Kaleela, an innovative app crafted specifically for non-native speakers to learn Arabic in a dynamic and engaging manner. Whether you’re a beginner or an advanced learner, Kaleela provides tailored resources to meet your needs.
What Kaleela Offers
Kaleela is the ultimate Arabic learning app, designed to immerse non-native speakers in the heart of the Arabic language. We focus on five key language skills: Writing, Listening, Speaking, Reading, and Culture.
Kaleela offers a range of courses tailored to suit every level and interest:
- Arabic Alphabet: Start with the basics and shapes of the Arabic alphabet and progress to long and short vowels.
- Modern Standard Arabic: Gain proficiency in the language, from greetings to linking words.
- Arabic Dialects: Explore the unique characteristics of Jordanian/Palestinian, Syrian, Egyptian, Iraqi, and Saudi dialects.
- Grammar: Build a solid foundation in Arabic grammar to understand and construct accurate sentences.
- Comprehension: Practice reading and listening comprehension to enhance your understanding of Arabic in context.
Kaleela sets itself apart from other language-learning apps through the following points:
- CEFR Approach: Kaleela stands out by using the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR), which categorizes learners into six levels and provides a structured, personalized path for mastering Arabic.
- Interactive Learning Experience: Kaleela transforms learning into a fun experience with interactive lessons that engage users. Our method blends practical language skills with real-life contexts, keeping learners motivated and eager to progress.
- Courses Designed for Every Skill Level: Our courses are designed to cater to learners of every proficiency level, from beginners to advanced speakers. Each course offers structured content that progressively builds your skills and confidence in the Arabic language.
- Multimedia Resources: Benefit from a variety of learning tools, including videos, voice recordings, and exercises that cater to different learning styles. These resources make vocabulary acquisition, pronunciation, and comprehension easy to grasp.
- Multiple languages to serve learners globally:At Kaleela, we understand the importance of accessibility in language learning. That's why we offer a diverse selection of languages, including Spanish, French, Italian, Romanian, Portuguese, Korean, Indonesian, Chinese, Turkish, English, and more to come, ensuring that learners from around the world can easily engage with our Arabic courses.
- Learning Mechanism with Repetition and Structure: Kaleela offers a refined learning mechanism that emphasizes repetition and structured progression, making it easier for learners to recall and apply what they’ve learned.
- Cultural Context: Kaleela incorporates cultural elements and real-life scenarios to enhance the learning experience, helping users understand the context in which the language is used.
Get Started Today!
Download and subscribe to Kaleela to access a comprehensive library of Arabic lessons, dialects, and cultural insights. Our app is your all-in-one solution for learning Arabic.
Follow Us for Updates:
Facebook: KaleelaArabic
Instagram: @kaleelaarabic
Twitter: @KaleelaArabic
Download Kaleela Now and Begin Your Arabic Journey!

- Interactive Learning Experience: Kaleela transforms learning into a fun experience with interactive lessons that engage users. Our method blends practical language skills with real-life contexts, keeping learners motivated and eager to progress.


- Courses Designed for Every Skill Level: Our courses are designed to cater to learners of every proficiency level, from beginners to advanced speakers. Each course offers structured content that progressively builds your skills and confidence in the Arabic language.

- Multimedia Resources: Benefit from a variety of learning tools, including videos, voice recordings, and exercises that cater to different learning styles. These resources make vocabulary acquisition, pronunciation, and comprehension easy to grasp.

- Multiple languages to serve learners globally:At Kaleela, we understand the importance of accessibility in language learning. That's why we offer a diverse selection of languages, including Spanish, French, Italian, Romanian, Portuguese, Korean, Indonesian, Chinese, Turkish, English, and more to come, ensuring that learners from around the world can easily engage with our Arabic courses.

- Learning Mechanism with Repetition and Structure: Kaleela offers a refined learning mechanism that emphasizes repetition and structured progression, making it easier for learners to recall and apply what they’ve learned.

- Cultural Context: Kaleela incorporates cultural elements and real-life scenarios to enhance the learning experience, helping users understand the context in which the language is used.

bluejetty:00164006:ios.description:
BUILD WORLD: Build, Explore & Survive
Step into Build World, the ultimate sandbox adventure 3D game where creativity, building, crafting, and survival collide. Shape your own world, explore diverse landscapes, and take on unique adventure challenges in a limitless sandbox world full of blocks, mining, and fun gameplay.
Endless Exploration
Venture through stunning 3D environments, from lush forests to scorching deserts and mysterious realms. Each place is packed with resources, blocks, and secrets waiting to be uncovered. Mine, explore, and craft your way through a vast and immersive sandbox world.
Survive the Night
Gather materials, craft essential tools, and fortify your buildings before night falls. Dangerous mobs and creatures emerge, turning the sandbox world into a true survival challenge. Only the cleverest players will last until dawn!
Mini-Games & Fun Challenges
Take a break from building and crafting to enjoy exciting mini-games, parkour races, glider challenges, and more. Compete with friends or test your skills in a variety of fun and adventurous game modes.
Wildlife, Mobs & Mysterious Creatures
Encounter peaceful animals, hostile mobs, and hidden bosses. Gather rare loot, uncover secrets, and expand your sandbox world with every adventure. Build, craft, and survive in this endless 3D block universe.
Additional Features:
Creative and Survival Modes for endless play styles
Multiple dimensions with unique terrain, blocks, and biomes
Dynamic day-night cycle: safe days, dangerous nights
Multiplayer support to build, explore, craft, and survive with friends
Frequent updates with new blocks, creatures, mini-games, and features
Download Build World now and start your sandbox adventure, survival, crafting, and building fun today!

bluejetty:00015460:ios.description:
Muslim Pal® - Learn with Ease the Noble Quran, Dua and Allah's Beautiful Names.
For years, our app Muslim Pal® (formerly known as "Memorize Quran") has been the trusted companion of millions of Muslims worldwide, guiding users on their journey to learn the Quran by heart.
Muslim Pal is a Super-App for Muslims with the following Sub-Apps:
- Memorize the Quran
- Memorize Dua
- Memorize the 99 Names of Allah
- Beautiful Qibla Compass
- Prayer Times with various calculation methods
More Apps & Features will be added on a regular basis.
The content used in Muslim Pal was hand-selected and thoroughly verified by Muslim Scholars. Read more at www.bigitec.com
Features:
- Customizable Home Screen with various widgets
- Quran recited by various popular reciters like Al Afasy, Al-Ghamdi and Ayman Swayd
- 99 Names of Allah translated and recited in high quality
- Handpicked authentic Dua Prayers taken from Sahih Hadith and Quran Verses
- Qibla Compass and Prayer Times with various calculation methods & GPS based localization
- Multiple user profiles with avatars and names
- Memorizing Progress Indicator for each user profile
- Easily create playlists
- Short-Breaks after recitation to repeat after the reciter and Loop-Mode to memorize efficiently
- Adjust the speed of the recitation, make it slower when memorizing and faster when practicing and repeating
- Super-Fast accessible Suras & Verses
- Save your profiles with the memorization progress and settings in our cloud
- Choose between various fonts optimized for Quran Arabic with Tashkeel
- Filter Sura List by Completed, Not Memorized, Incomplete & Favorites
We'd love to hear your thoughts and will provide new content on a regular basis insha'Allah!
Visit www.bigitec.com to learn more about our products.

bluejetty:00174669:ios.description:
A better way to remember.
Tinybeans is a private family journal that helps you capture the everyday magic—first steps, messy meals, bedtime giggles—and keeps all your family memories organized for you, without adding to your mental load. It’s built by parents and designed for real life: small moments, saved when you have a minute, that slowly add up to something you’ll feel so grateful to have captured, whether you’re reminiscing in your private digital journal or flipping through a beautiful photo book.
Capture. Organize. Share. Keep.
1) CAPTURE YOUR WAY
• Easily upload baby memories (and beyond) in the moment, or bulk upload in batches.
2) ORGANIZE AUTOMATICALLY
• Moments are automatically organized and sorted by date.
3) SHARE PRIVATELY
• You choose who follows along, by invite only.
4) BRING IT TO LIFE
• Turn your memories into beautiful photo books in minutes, right in the app.
Choose from two plans:
1) TINYBEANS (FREE)
• 20 uploads per month
• Secure family sharing
• 5GB of storage space
2) TINYBEANS+
• Unlimited uploads
• High-quality videos up to 5 minutes
• 200GB of storage space
• Ad-free experience
• 2nd user account to share
• Priority support
• Secure family sharing
Start your free two-week trial of Tinybeans+ today.
Why millions of parents love us
1) YOU OWN YOUR MEMORIES: Every photo and video you upload belongs to you. 
2) YOU HAVE FULL CONTROL OVER ACCESS: Only the people you invite can see your family’s journal. 
3) YOUR DATA ISN’T FOR SALE: We use your information to improve your experience, never to sell it.
4) BUILT BY PARENTS, FOR FAMILIES: Tinybeans was created with the same care you bring to your decisions. 
5) HERE FOR THE LONG HAUL: From newborn days to teenage years, we’re committed to supporting your family over time.
Because the little moments add up fast—and future you will be so happy you saved them.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings.
Questions/feedback? Please reach out to us at info@tinybeans.com. We love to hear from you. Tinybeans website: https://tinybeans.com

bluejetty:00186532:ios.description:
The ONLY car game starring your child! Drive fire trucks, race cars, construction vehicles and monster trucks. Build your favorite cars and trucks in drag and drop puzzles, with hundreds of car puzzle pieces. After every puzzle, play exciting driving games. Just add your toddler's face - they love being the driver in all the car puzzles and games. Be a firefighter, a cop, a racing driver, a monster-truck stunt rider, a construction worker - in brilliant imaginative role-play games. Perfect for all car-loving preschool kids aged 2 to 5 years old.
"We love this! You build up the trucks with puzzles, then drive them." App Store Review
"Lovely for personalization and engaging children." Literacy Trust Best Apps
You can get behind the wheel straightaway in this free version, which comes with the Fire Truck puzzle and driving game, plus the character-creator so you can add your child’s face. Unlock all the cars and trucks with a single in-app purchase, which is behind a parent lock.
Fun stuff - and shhh, educational too :)
• Drag and drop shape car puzzles to build your cars, big trucks, and construction vehicles
• Starring your child (or Daddy, Grandma, even your pet!) at the heart of all the action
• Play with favorite vehicles - a racing Fire Truck, a chasing Police Car, a speeding race car, an off-roading Monster Truck, a gold-hunting Digger, a crashing Dozer, and a feasting Camper!
• Imaginative role play - be a fire-fighter, a construction worker, a cop & more
• Develop preschool skills and concentration
• Great for toddlers and preschoolers, ages 2-5 years old
We're parents too, so we take children’s privacy and wellness very seriously. Our app has no ads, and a single in-app purchase behind a parent lock.
• Explore at your own pace, no rules or time pressures
• No internet needed - perfect to play on road trips and flights
• Easy enough to play alone, perfect to play together for super-charged fun learning :)
• No ads
OkiPlay is a family games studio, devoted to learning and play. Our preschool apps are loved & trusted by parents, grandparents, teachers, and children all over the world. Here's what they say about OkiPlay:
* "My son LOVES this app! He is engaged from start to finish. I love this app because it works on his fine motor skills with puzzle building but also helps him to understand the concept of parts making a whole."
* "I am a Speech-Language Pathologist working with 3-5 year olds. They are very engaged and love being a part of the game."
* "All excellent apps... they are very interactive and it's brilliant how you can choose different family members to feature in them."
* "Absolutely gorgeous - both our children were totally captivated by this app ...the personalization feature is fantastic, and the graphics are charming."
* "My daughter squeals with delight at the sound of the app opening. She has a blast while developing her fine motor skills."
* "Thank you so much for creating something so adorable and educational for little ones."

bluejetty:00161880:ios.description:
Bits is an app for professional stand-up comedians. It’s designed to keep your writing process fast and organized so you can focus on your comedy instead of the tools. Here's what it offers:
*WRITE BITS*
Whenever a funny thought pops into your brain, you can quickly add it to your infinite bits list. Just open the app, hit that plus button, and start writing. All your bits are saved securely*, instantly, and automatically so you won’t have to worry about that.
*ADD NOTES*
Writing the perfect bit comes with lots of experimentation and small details to remember. To help you with the ongoing process of adjustments, each bit has its section of notes. Bits and notes always come together so you won’t be able to lose important notes you’ve written to yourself.
*BUILD SETS*
We all wish for the perfect set. The set will catch the crowd on its first bit and finish with resounding laughter. This glory set is the easiest to build and manage. You can add bits to existing sets or create a new set and add bits to it. Simply drag & drop to reorder the bits and have them ready one by one. Move jokes up and down, remove and add until you find that perfect balance of laughs.
*ON STAGE MODE*
The old days of paper pages on a stool are over! When you’re up there on stage, you can switch to the on-stage mode and have your set ready for your performance. The screen will remain turned on and all black. While you perform, you can swipe right or left to indicate if the joke did well or not so you can come back to it later and reshape it the way you think best.
*ORGANIZE WITH LABELS*
Planning a Christmas set? And how about those airport bits? Or where did you put all of your funny bits about your dad? Oh, they’re all labeled! Label each bit with any label(s) you want. Either apply labels from the bit screen or add bits to an existing label from the labels screen. Access by bit the themes you think are most suitable for your next set.
*SET STATUSES*
Writing a bit is a process. It starts with a thought and moves up the ladder until it’s done. Draft, done, or gold - these are predefined statuses for your bits which will help you plan ahead and easily see which bits need more work, which can be performed and get laughs, and which are so good that you can close and get max cheers from your crowd.
*TIME YOUR BITS*
You got only 5 minutes, 5:10 at most. Which bits can be squeezed in to fit that time limitation? Oh, that’s easy. Each bit is generated with an approximate time it’ll take you to perform it, but you can always tweak it and make sure you can plan every bit to fit perfectly into its time slot.
---- ---
*Please note that material backup, bit feedback, and custom icons are available to paid subscribers only.
---- ---
I’d love to answer your questions or just hear what you think about Bits. Find me online at:
amitay@thebits.club
Twitter: @standUpBitsApp
---- ---

bluejetty:00055458:android.description:
Learn First Words is an educational app designed to introduce your baby or toddler to everyday vocabulary. It is designed to teach your baby new words through sound, animation, and flash cards. It’s fun, free, and perfect for children between the ages of 1 to 5. 
Learn First Words features 15 kid friendly categories and over 150 words. Flashcards teaching method is great for babies, toddlers, and children allowing them to learn at their own pace. Your kid will learn everyday words while having fun. Play and learn together with your toddler. 
It is also a great way to learn English for preschool children. If English is your second language, teach English to your toddler/preschooler in a fun and colorful way with this educational game. We cover all basic vocabulary. 
It is simple to use. Select a category, review flash cards, and interact with the animations. Building a strong vocabulary, learning language and pronunciation skills have never been so easy and exciting for babies, toddlers, and preschoolers! 
Hope you and your toddlers love this game. If you like it, please rate us 5 stars. We love getting feedback from our users. If you have any questions or suggestions, please email us: toofunnyartists@gmail.com

bluejetty:00014777:ios.description:
Super Dispatch’s FREE App is built to be your one-stop shop to manage loads, move cars faster, grow your business with free access to our Super Loadboard, and improve your operational efficiency. Get access to photo inspections and eBOLs directly connecting to the Super Loadboard and transportation management software for a seamless end-to-end experience.
NEW: Move cars faster, safer, and smarter with Touchless Delivery.
RUN YOUR BUSINESS ON YOUR PHONE
Our FREE app directly connects to our Super Loadboard and Carrier TMS.Instant access to all of your orders and documents. Pick loads, track loads, and manage loads all in one place.
FIND THE BEST PAYING LOADS with Super Loadboard 
Find, bid, book, deliver, and get paid on the go - our FREE Super Loadboard connects directly to our FREE app.
Free text or email load notifications for loads posted in your lane.
Save searches for your usual routes.
24/7 one-click/no call booking. 
ELIMINATE PAPERWORK 
Photo inspection of loads where you can mark damages directly on each photo.
Manage electronic BOLs and PODs where you can send to customers, dispatchers, or yourself.
Import dispatch sheets from major brokers.
GET PAID FASTER with Instant Invoicing 
Integrated with Quickbooks.
Submit your invoice from your mobile device as soon as your load is delivered. 
The app creates the invoice for you along with the attached BOL / Condition Report.
KEEP TRACK OF PAYMENTS
Instant access to all of your orders and documents.
See who owes you money and remind them or resend the Invoice with a click of a button. 
Super Dispatch will highlight the past due Invoices to help you keep track of outstanding balances.
NEW: add expenses like gas or car pulling fees, add attachments like gas receipts to your orders.
No Dispatcher? No problem.
Owner Operators can manage their entire business from the mobile app.
For more information, visit our website to speak with our support specialists. 
---
This app may use your location when it isn’t open, which can decrease device battery life.
Super Dispatch has been designed to use a nominal amount of battery power by limiting the app’s GPS usage without compromising tracking visibility.
---

----------------------------------------------------------- 
War of Eclipse is a retro style game that combines timing action, role playing, and adventure elements. You play as a captain who crashed in a battle but is saved by human survivors. As the fight against the aliens wages on you will unveil the truth about the war for the human world.
Features
- One button gameplay that is easy to learn and play
- Retro style pixel graphics with detailed 8 bit art
- Challenge high scores in survival mode and see your ranking in the world
- Detailed tutorial and tips that are available at any time
- 7 air battleships to build and customize, including one ultimate battleship
- 7 endings to discover, see the story and experience the possibilities from different angle
- 35 enemy types to fight; they will shoot, charge, and ambush you, and also bomb your base
- Collect lost data that unveils the history behind the aliens and human world
- Random equipment includes: 20 kinds of parts combine with 50 kinds of abilities and 10 LV upgrade
- Different challenges during the battle, such as avoiding an ambush, battling in a lightning storm, and destroying the falling boss enemies before atmospheric friction burned you
- 20 achievements to conquer!

Why You’ll Love Expense Planner: Money Tracker?
💎 All-in-one expense tracker, budget planner, and finance manager app.
💎 Helps track expenses, manage budgets, and improve your personal finance management.
💎 Supports smarter budgeting money, consistent money saving, and long-term financial planning.

ONE APP - ALL YOU NEED TO PASS YOUR EXAM
You will find all the information you need to pass the NCE exam. All in one app. This study app directly aligns with the NCE exam blueprint, giving you the preparation you need to achieve the highest score possible.
"THE NCE BIBLE"... ?!

WHAT WILL YOU MASTER?
• All the NCE exam sections.

• How to practice.

Any test prep guide is only as good as its practice questions and answer explanations, and that's another area where Zen Prep stands out. The practice questions are similar to the actual exam. Each answer is explained in-depth to make the principles and reasoning behind it crystal clear.
PRACTICE TESTS

REAL EXAM SIMULATOR
Practice in conditions similar to the real NCE exam. Check your knowledge and get a sense of your predicted score.
FLASHCARDS
Swipe the cards to quickly review NCE concepts without the need to go through the whole test, complete the right amount of questions for you, and get some quick studying in.

TIPS AND RECOMMENDATIONS
Get to know how to successfully get prepared and pass the exam, learn all the strategies, tips, and tricks useful to ace the NCE exam.
Zen Prep will be your most valuable study resource – helping you prepare, stay motivated, and pass the exam with flying colors.

In short, it's everything you need to succeed with a bunch of hugely valuable extras sprinkled on top.

bluejetty:00120156:ios.name: Gravitational Wave Events
bluejetty:00120156:ios.summary:
Receive alerts of Gravitational Wave Events from the LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA Collaboration (LVK) on your iPhone.

bluejetty:00120156:ios.description:
Receive alerts of Gravitational Wave Events from the LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA Collaboration (LVK) on your iPhone.
This is an app for both the LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA Community and the general public. It provides low latency alerts using the Open Public Alerts currently being deployed by the Gamma-ray Coordinates Network (GCN) through GCN/LVK Notices (https://emfollow.docs.ligo.org/userguide/). To receive alerts using the app just select the category of alerts you wish to receive - it's that simple! 
The O4 observing run ended in November 2025. Intermediate Run 1 (IR1) is expected to start in late September, 2026. The app will download all IR1 events and counterparts as they are reported through a GCN Notice in addition to any related GCN Circulars. The app database is pre-populated with selected Notices and Circulars from all previous O1, O2, O3 and O4 events. The app retains Notices for one Mock Event reported through GCN for testing purposes. (For information on LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA Collaboration GCN Notices see: https://gcn.gsfc.nasa.gov/lvc.html .)
Includes an interactive sky map showing the location of each event.
The app also has a public Message exchange bulletin board and some interesting Links. The Links provide information on Gravitational Waves and the LIGO and Virgo observatories.

bluejetty:00115824:ios.description:
Embark on a Journey to Build the Ultimate Jungle Cafe on a mountain hiking trail!
Welcome to My Pizza Cafe Simulation Game, a unique coffee shop simulator where you; build, customize, and grow your dream cafe on a scenic mountain hiking trail. Serve adventurers, hikers, and nature enthusiasts.
Key Features: 
Build and Customize Your Cafe
Start with a humble stall and transform it into a bustling cafe in the heart of nature. Design every detail, from seating arrangements to décor, with options like tables, cozy chairs, trees, bushes, and jungle-themed decorations.
Serve Delicious Food and Drinks
Craft a variety of tasty treats and beverages! Start with simple coffee drinks and expand your menu to include gourmet pizzas, desserts, and refreshing juices. Keep your customers satisfied by catering to their unique cravings.
Food and Drinks Menu: Delight your customers with a wide range of mouth-watering items, including:
Coffee Beverages: Espresso, Americano, Decaf, Mocha, Macchiato, Latte, and Cappuccino.
Sweet Syrups: Chocolate, Caramel, Vanilla, and Mint for a personalized touch.
Juices and Refreshers: Orange Juice, Grape Juice, Mint Margarita, and Slush.
Hot Treats: Hot Chocolate, Boiled Egg, Tea, and Snacks.
Bakery Favorites: Croissants, Cookies, Doughnuts, Cheesecake, and Popcorn.
Main Courses: Burgers, Pizzas, Salads, and more.
Desserts: Strawberry Ice Cream Freezer for those with a sweet tooth.
Machines for Food and Drinks: Equip your cafe with machines for every menu item, and upgrade them for higher efficiency and faster service!
Coffee Machines: Brew Espresso, Latte, and more with faster, upgraded models.
Juicers: Extract fresh Orange Juice, Grape Juice, and Mint Margarita quickly.
Syrup Dispensers: Dispense Chocolate, Caramel, and Vanilla syrup with precision.
Pizza Ovens: Bake pizzas faster and in larger batches with high-end ovens.
Grills and Fryers: Cook Burgers, Snacks, and hot treats with speedier upgrades.
Tea Makers & Boilers: Prepare Tea and Boiled Eggs in bulk with advanced machines.
Baking Stations: Perfect for Cookies, Doughnuts, and Cheesecake.
Ice Cream Freezers: Serve Strawberry Ice Cream faster and smoother.
Popcorn Makers: Pop large batches with automatic seasoning features.
Sports Activities for Hikers: Add exciting sports and recreational activities to keep your customers entertained:
Badminton Courts: Set up a fun area for hikers to enjoy a quick match and unwind.
Swimming Ponds: Create a serene swimming spot for customers to cool off after a long trek.
Manage and Grow Your Business Expand your cafe by adding new areas, tables, and machines. Upgrade your equipment to serve customers faster and improve their experience. Hire and train staff to assist with orders, cooking, and customer service.
Attract and Serve Unique Customers
Cater to hikers, campers, and travelers, each with their own preferences and needs. Some want a quick coffee to-go, while others prefer a cozy sit-down meal after a long trek. Keep them happy to earn tips and positive reviews!
Overcome Nature’s Challenges
Navigate the dynamic challenges of a jungle cafe! Adapt to changing weather conditions like rain, fog, or snow, and deal with unexpected animal visitors or resource shortages.
Expand Your Trailside Cafe Empire
Grow beyond a single cafe by exploring new hiking trails, unlocking hidden jungle spots, and setting up additional coffee stands in remote locations.
Are You Ready to Create the Ultimate Jungle Cafe? Build, customize, and thrive in nature with Trailside Camp Cafe.

bluejetty:00070712:ios.description:
Unofficial Companion App
This app is not a game. It is a powerful companion tool designed for football game enthusiasts who want to get more from their experience. Packed with databases, calculators, tutorials, and build tools everything you need to plan your dream team.
PLAYER DATABASE
Explore a detailed player database with smart tools to help you find top talent and understand their strengths.
View player stats at max level.
See dribbling skills with controller animations.
Understand how condition affects stats and ratings.
Instantly spot top 6 key stats on every player card.
Track player form throughout the season.
MANAGER DATABASE
Stay ahead with up-to-date manager formations and tactics.
Find managers who have changed tactics weekly.
Search based on offensive and defensive playstyles.
Use the formation search tool to find your perfect setup.
SQUAD BUILDER
Build squads like a pro, with full control over strength and cost.
Automatically calculate team strength for 2, 3, or 4-star builds.
Position players under different managers.
Save unlimited squads and experiment freely.
Use Auto Build for quick team generation.
Track contract cost totals for better squad planning.
GAME PLAN
Simulate off-the-ball movement in attack and defense to spot tactical strengths and weaknesses in your squad.
HIDDEN GEM FINDER
Discover underrated players with high potential and low contract renewal cost — perfect for long-term builds.
MY TEAM
Save your favorite players and managers to access quickly when building squads or browsing stats.
SKILL MOVE TUTORIALS
Learn how to perform dribbling skills step-by-step with controller animations — for both mobile and console players.
Disclaimer
This is an app designed for learning and planning purposes. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by any football game developer or publisher.
COMMUNITY Share builds, discuss tactics, and learn from other players.
Comment on player builds and squad setups.
Vote on the best builds from the community.
Follow other players and see their latest builds.
> Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00064046:ios.description:
The Austrian pub card game for two - now always in your pocket.
You can learn Schnapsen in five minutes. Mastering it takes years. That is the whole appeal: 66 points, 20 cards, one trump suit - and the art is knowing the exact moment to close the deck.
AN OPPONENT AT ANY HOUR
Thousands of players are online day and night. No lobbies, no waiting - open a table and play. From complete beginners to people who have been at it for decades, you will find someone at your level.
FRIENDS AND TEAMS
- Add friends, challenge them directly and take your revenge
- Join a team, play team matches and talk in the team chat
- See who is playing nearby
NO INTERNET? SIT DOWN TOGETHER
Bluetooth mode connects two devices directly - on a train, up a mountain, anywhere the signal gives up. Two phones, one table, no connection needed.
TOURNAMENTS AND RANKINGS
Daily, weekly and monthly tournaments, plus the world ranking. Climb the levels and measure yourself against your friends.
PRACTISE AGAINST SERIOUS OPPONENTS
Our computer opponents learned their game from millions of played hands. From a relaxed opponent to one that will genuinely make you think - pick the strength that suits you. All offline, no internet needed, and after a won training game you can double your winnings by watching a short video.
LIKE THE REAL TABLE
- Three card decks: traditional double-German cards or two French designs
- Chat with animated emojis and pictures
- Game history and replays - see how the deal actually went
- Wheel of fortune, daily challenges and free credits every day
THE RULES, BRIEFLY
Two players, 20 cards - Ace, Ten, King, Queen and Jack in four suits. Each player gets five cards and one card is turned face up to set the trump suit. First to 66 points wins the deal.
Schnopsn is free to play. Full rules and more at http://www.schnopsn.com/

bluejetty:00066114:ios.description:
[PLAY] [MAKE] [SEARCH]
The Power of imagination can touch the sky!
Make your very own action game stages and share them with your friends & family!
You can play this game absolutely free!
This game is perfectly suited for everyone including KIDS.
-Basic Instructions-
There are [PLAY], [MAKE] and [SEARCH] option buttons on the main menu.
Tap [PLAY] button: Play the games all you want!
You have a variety of stages to choose from.
The range of stage levels are widely prepared, 
from beginners to advanced level,including the extreme levels that are crazy difficult!
Tap [MAKE] button: Make your own stages. You become the game creator!
Simple tap controls make it easy!
Select from 30 types of items you can place anywhere you want.
Tap an item on the list and then tap on the position where you want to place it.
(Squares like a chess board are shown in a stage screen in order to make this process simpler.) 
Once an item is placed, you can place the same item continuously by alternating between tapping the position (square) in a stage and the "PLACE" button.
You can also tap an item you've already placed to see additional options.
(e.g. You can choose specific settings for the speed of cannon shell movements and the moveable range of blocks!)
Play & find out if you can complete the stage you made!
You can even do the test play during the process of making a stage by using the "TEST" button in the upper right corner of the screen.
Try your own brand-new stage right away!
Tap [SEARCH] button: Find popular stages -- stages made by other users and more.
-Random: Search for random stages made by players using this App. 
-History: Look through stages you've already played. (You can also check if you've completed a stage or not.)
-Official Website: Open this App’s official website to start the search.
 When you have found the one you want to play, tap on the stage and use "START" button. 
-Enter ID: Paste the GameID and tap "Enter ID" button, if you are unable to start the stage after using "START" button in the official website.
(32 alphanumeric characters shown on the official website is the GameID.)
Now, you're ready to start the game you found. Enjoy!
[Send your original stage to friends & family]
If you want to share your original stage with someone, send them the copy of your stage's URL via email!
(Downloading this App is required in order to play your stage.)
Post your original stage on Twitter, Facebook and LINE are also available! 
You can also have fun searching online for "PicoPicoMaker" in your free time!
Enjoy finding new stages other users have made!
Everyone loves the retro-looking pixel graphics games they grew up with!
Connect with people from all over the world with PicoPicoMaker!
Start your global action game adventure!

bluejetty:00085952:ios.description:
# MMORPG REBORN - START FRESH AT ZERO
Zero Paywalls. Pure Progression. The first-ever FRESH START SERVER ZERO has arrived!
Earn Farming Crystals through field hunting and grow faster with less pressure!
Experience massively boosted equipment drop rates and hunting EXP. We've also removed Mythic-grade Summons and Awakenings to level the playing field!
Enjoy field hunting without random PKs, receive Legendary Holy Garment and Legendary Familiar rewards, and claim up to 550 Summons!
Start a fresh journey of progression in ZERO now!
# Festival of Legends Begins!
A grand festival for all Special Corps Members is now live!
Join the events to earn your Legendary Holy Garment, Legendary Familiar, and Legendary Stella!
Receive 330 Summons and boost your progression through the Elite Special Corps Growth Event!
Log in now and claim all your Festival of Legends rewards!
▣ Game Overview ▣
# Enter RAVEN2, the brutal dark fantasy MMORPG
Step into a boundless world where untamed adventure awaits!
Experience a world of breathtaking scale and beauty powered by Unreal Engine.
A brutal tale where darkness and beauty coexist...
Witness the ultimate real dark fantasy like never before.
# Forge your own epic tale
A gripping story brought to life through immersive cinematic storytelling.
An open-world adventure with a character of your choice...
The fate of the world lies at your fingertips.
# Choose from unique classes! Your fate in combat awaits!
Your decisions shape the flow of battle!
The "Assassin" who delivers lethal strikes from the shadows
The "Berserker" who annihilates enemies with overwhelming destructive power
The "Vanguard" who protects allies with a shield of steel
The "Elementalist" who dominates the battlefield with magic
The "Divine Caster" who supports allies with divine power
The "Night Ranger," who subdues enemies from afar
The "Destroyer," who throws enemy formations into chaos
The "Deathbringer," who turns the tide in battle with the power of Specters
The "Gunslinger", a hunter who overwhelms enemies with sharp judgment and precise skill
The “Warlord,” the commander who controls the flow of battle with overwhelming control abilities
Become the champion of this battlefield who will bring light to the world.
# Perfect your hero with limitless customization
Intricate detail and total freedom.
A deep customization system that delivers powerful visual impact.
Create a hero that reflects your unique style and beauty, one unlike any other.
# Born in Blood. Built for War.
The battlefield calls. The war begins now.
Engage in massive battles filled with striking visual effects.
Fight relentlessly, overcome the inevitable, and rise as a legend.
Visit the official site for more information about the game.
Official Forum: https://forum.netmarble.com/raven2_gb
Official Website: https://raven2w.netmarble.com 
Official Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/@RAVEN2_gb

Official Discord: https://discord.gg/raven2

bluejetty:00014979:ios.description:
Your study and clinical companion. Get fast, reliable answers to clinical questions while studying, preparing for exams, or managing patients. 
IMPRESS YOUR ATTENDING & PROVIDE EXCELLENT PATIENT CARE WITH AMBOSS
- Find the answers you need with the AMBOSS Knowledge app. It works offline so you can use it in the hospital and on the go. 
- Interpret key clinical findings on diagnostic images with image overlays. 
- Stay on top of every patient with evidence-based patient-care tools, such as diagnostic flowcharts, acute management checklists, drug dosing, clinical calculators, warning signs, and more.
- Make quick decisions confidently, so you can spend more time with your patients.
ACE YOUR MEDICAL SCHOOL EXAMS 
- Be prepared for every exam (in-house, USMLE® Step, or NBME® Shelf exams) with expertly-created high-yield content that covers the entire USMLE® content outline. 
- Connect your Anki flashcards to the AMBOSS library and remember everything you learn. You’ll get pop-up explanations of medical terms and images right there in your Anki decks. Now available on mobile.
- The library content is designed for quick and easy access so you can find the relevant info you need in seconds. And if you want to dive deeper for a more thorough understanding of the topic at hand, all you need to do is click.
- Succeed on Shelf exams and honor clinical rotations with the Clerkship Survival Guides and clinical content. 
- The AMBOSS Qbank app is the ideal way to apply your knowledge and become a top-tier test-taker with its learning features. It is available as a separate app. Once downloaded, both AMBOSS apps integrate seamlessly with each other for a complete studying experience. 
*AMBOSS users score higher on exams and perform better in the hospital. Learn more here. 
GETTING STARTED 
- Create your account at amboss.com/us
- Download the AMBOSS Medical Knowledge Library app.
- Once that’s done, you’ll have 5 days to explore the platform for FREE.
- When your 5-day free trial is up, choose the membership that’s right for you and become part of the AMBOSS medical community.
IN CASE YOU NEED HELP
If you have any questions, check out our Help Center or get in touch and we’ll be happy to assist.
support.amboss.com/hc/en-us
