bluejetty:00122544:ios.summary: The BOC Go App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organiz
bluejetty:00122544:ios.description:
The BOC Go App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Bank of Clarkson customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the BOC Go App, you must be enrolled as an Bank of Clarkson Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00037805:ios.developer: Muenchner Verkehrs- und Tarifverbund Gesellschaft mit beschraenkter Haftung (MVV)
bluejetty:00037805:ios.summary:
Mobility for Munich and the region - get to your destination easily with the MVV-App
The MVV-App is the cost-free and ad-free app for timetable information and public transport tickets in the entire Munich transport network (Münchner Verk
bluejetty:00037805:ios.description:
Mobility for Munich and the region - get to your destination easily with the MVV-App
The MVV-App is the cost-free and ad-free app for timetable information and public transport tickets in the entire Munich transport network (Münchner VerkehrsVerbund).
Whether you use a regional train, suburban train (S-Bahn), underground (U-Bahn), streetcar (Tram), bus, or on-demancd services (RufTaxi, FLEX or FLEXlinie) - with the app you will always find the fastest connection to your destination in Munich and the districts of Bad Tölz-Wolfratshausen, Dachau, Ebersberg, Erding, Freising, Fürstenfeldbruck, Garmisch-Partenkirchen, Landsberg a.L., Landshut, Miesbach, Munich, Rosenheim, Starnberg, Weilheim-Schongau and in the cities of Landshut and Rosenheim.
Thanks to real-time information (forecasts), you are always well informed. You can buy the right ticket directly via smartphone, with MVVswipe conveniently via check-in and check-out, without having to know our tariff details. You’ll also get information about sharing services and can book your MyRadl directly in the app.
The MVV-App was the only public transport app to be rated “very good” in a comparison test by the magazine connect (edition 11/2023). FOCUS MONEY has repeatedly listed the MVV-App as the best app in the public transport sector in its satisfaction study (edition 14/2025 and 14/2026).
Key functions at a glance:
• Trip planner: Our journey planner always finds the fastest connection - conveniently from your location or from and to any address throughout the entire MVV area. Convenient: Our app always shows you the correct tickets for your connection.
• Real-time information: Stay informed about punctuality, delays, cancellations, disruption notifications and occupancy forecasts.
• Live map: Our map shows you the current position of buses, trains and additional mobility services (scooters, hire bikes, car sharing) for a flexible route planning.
• MVVswipe: Buy tickets without knowing the MVV fare? All you have to do is swipe on your smartphone and you'll always get the right ticket at the best price for your connections.
• MVV MobileTickets & Deutschland-Ticket: Our MVV-App is the ticket machine for your pocket - with just a few clicks you can purchase the Deutschland-Ticket (Germany-wide local public Transport ticket on subscription) as well as all our MVV-Tickets and the CityTourCard and Munich Card.
• Easy payment: Pay for your tickets conveniently with Google Pay, Apple Pay, PayPal, SEPA (direct debit procedure within the European Union) or credit card (Visa, MasterCard, American Express).
• On-Demand-Services: FLEX, FLEXlinie and RufTaxi - with our app you can book all on-demand services integrated into the MVV network. 
• MyRadl: Use the MVV-App to rent a bike from MyRadl, the bike-sharing system for Munich and the region. Enjoy discounts if you have an MVV season ticket or a Deutschland-Ticket purchased from MVV, S-Bahn or MVG. 
• Additional mobility services: Bike sharing, car sharing, scooter sharing, ride-sharing and park & ride.
• Individual settings: Unlike many other apps, we offer you many options to customise the app to your needs, e.g. avoiding stairs, walking speed, bicycle transport, fare limitations, dark mode and much more.
• Find more information at www.mvv.app
Please note: Internet access and GPS coverage are required to use all functions. All data and information are subject to change.
Feel free to leave a review in the App Store - if you have any questions, problems or suggestions for improvement, please contact MVV's customer service team directly. Our colleagues will be happy to help you and answer your questions individually.

bluejetty:00073483:ios.description:
She Reads Truth is an online community of women in the Word of God every day.
Designed with this community in mind, the She Reads Truth Bible + Devotional app is a beautiful, functional, and accessible Bible-reading tool created to help women from around the world to connect with God's Word and each other, anytime and anywhere. Whether your Truth time comes in the early morning before the world wakes, during a lunch break at your desk, or in the middle of the night with a baby in your arms—the She Reads Truth app brings your quiet (or not so quiet) time to you, right where you are. 
App Features:
- Gorgeous, user-friendly layout and design
- Full-text Bible in multiple translations
- Free and paid Bible-reading plans, with new content added daily & full-access, monthly auto-renewable subscription available
- Ability to highlight, bookmark, share, and take notes as you read
- User accounts allow you to customize your experience and keep your notes and highlights safe
- Real-time commenting that syncs with the She Reads Truth web site
- Beautiful, shareable images featuring content from the daily readings
- Free, downloadable lock screens for your phone (an excellent tool for Scripture memorization!)
- Customizable notifications to remind you to read Truth at your ideal time of day
- Free "Bible In A Year" reading plan that tracks your progress as you go
- Bible search function
- Settings for font size, preferred Bible translation, red letter function, and nighttime display
About She Reads Truth
She Reads Truth is a worldwide community of women who read the Bible together every day. Founded in 2012, She Reads Truth invites women of all ages to engage with Scripture through daily reading plans, online conversation led by a vibrant community of contributors, and offline resources created at the intersection of beauty, goodness, and Truth.
About the Monthly Subscription
She Reads Truth's Monthly Subscription is an auto-renewing subscription which will renew automatically each month, unless you cancel your subscription at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. bluejetty:00064043:ios.summary: Dish alignment, pointing and Installation has always been a complicated task, especially if you do not have a clue. That is why I posted this application that will simplify this task and allow you to install and align your antenna without t
bluejetty:00064043:ios.description:
Dish alignment, pointing and Installation has always been a complicated task, especially if you do not have a clue. That is why I posted this application that will simplify this task and allow you to install and align your antenna without the need to call a specialist.
SatCatcher is a satellite finder and dish pointer, it allows you to orient your antenna to any satellite. Using augmented reality, this application displays the target satellite in space to better choose the location of your antenna and ensure the absence of any obstacle (wall, tree ...).
SatCatcher also uses your phone GPS to show your location on a map and shows the direction of the satellite from your position.
The compass accompanied by a beep lets you orient your antenna following the acceleration of beeps or the arrow of the compass.
The accelerometer is used to verify that the holder of your antenna is vertical.
The antenna adjustment steps:
1- choose a satellite and authorize geolocation to determine the direction of the antenna orientation.
2- Show satellite in augmented reality with your camera and make sure there are no obstacles and validate the location of your antenna.
3. Check that the support of your antenna is vertical.
4. Calculate the polarization and adjust the rotation of the LNB (the head of your antenna)
5. Set the elevation
6- Search orientation with visual and sound assistant
7- Fine adjustments.
For the good functioning of the application, SatCatcher will need the camera, compass, gyroscope, accelerometer and the GPS of your smartphone.
tips:
- If your smartphone does not have GPS, you can manually move the "marker" on the card until it points your exact location. Use zoom for more detail.
- The compass is very important to adjust your dish, but if your smartphone does not have one, you can still use the application. In this case, it will help you to find clues and marks on the map from your location. It also allows you to calculate the orientation. Than you can use a manual compass to get a good orientation.
- Do not hesitate to recalibrate the compass and avoid too close to the antenna arm, because it is sensitive to metallic elements. Try to place your smartphone where there is less magnetic interference.
SatCatcher Free is the lite version of SatCatcher.
Augmented reality and compass orientation are only available in the full version here: https://appsto.re/fr/Gb6Hbb.i
Contact : infosoftycontactfree@gmail.com

As global temperatures plummet, a catastrophic disaster has obliterated human civilization. The few survivors who escaped their crumbling homes now confront a host of new challenges: relentless zombie hordes, fierce snowstorms, mutated beasts, and ruthless bandits.

bluejetty:00081974:ios.summary: Pep GLP-1 Tracker puts your whole GLP-1 routine in one place: shots or pills, reminders, medication levels, weight, meals, and side effects. Built for Ozempic®, Wegovy®, Mounjaro®, Zepbound®, Foundayo™, compounded semaglutide, tirzepatide,
bluejetty:00081974:ios.description:
Pep GLP-1 Tracker puts your whole GLP-1 routine in one place: shots or pills, reminders, medication levels, weight, meals, and side effects. Built for Ozempic®, Wegovy®, Mounjaro®, Zepbound®, Foundayo™, compounded semaglutide, tirzepatide, retatrutide, and more.
Whether it's your first dose or you're months in, Pep makes it easy to know what to take, when to take it, and how far you've come.
SEE YOUR MEDICATION LEVEL
Using published clinical data, Pep estimates how much medication is active in your body, rising as each dose absorbs and tapering at your medication's own pace. Tap the chart to see your level at any moment. Many people use it to see why food noise, appetite, and side effects shift through the week.
SNAP A PHOTO, LOG YOUR MEAL
Point your camera at your plate and the AI food scanner estimates calories, protein, fiber, carbs, and fat in seconds. You can also search foods or scan a barcode.
NEVER MISS A DOSE
• One-tap logging for weekly shots and daily pills
• Injection site rotation, so you always know where the next shot goes
• Dose escalation tracking as your prescription steps up
• Reminders that fit your schedule, plus a missed-dose guide for when life gets in the way
TRACK SIDE EFFECTS
Log nausea, constipation, fatigue, or anything custom, and rate how severe it is. See how symptoms line up with your doses on the calendar so you can spot patterns and talk them through with your provider.
WATCH YOUR PROGRESS
Track weight, body measurements, and progress photos with side-by-side comparisons and clear charts. Weigh in on any smart scale that writes to Apple Health and the reading shows up in Pep on its own. Hit a milestone? Turn your stats and before & after photos into a Progress Card you can save or share.
MAKE EVERY BITE COUNT
When your appetite is smaller, what you eat matters more. Set daily goals for calories, protein, fiber, carbs, fat, and water and see at a glance how close you are.
YOUR DAY AT A GLANCE
The Today screen shows what you've logged and what's next. The calendar puts doses, weight, meals, and symptoms side by side.
BACKED UP, SYNCED, AND PRIVATE
Sign in once and your entries and photos back up automatically. Get a new phone, sign in, and everything comes back. Progress photos are encrypted on your phone before they leave it, so only you can see them. We never sell your data. Pep Pro keeps every device you use in sync.
STAY STRONG WITH PEP STRENGTH
Short strength sessions planned around your shot day, in a free companion app. Finished sessions show up on your Today screen and calendar.
BUILT FOR YOUR ROUTINE
• Brand-name or compounded medications, shots or pills
• Pounds, kilograms, or stones; inches or centimeters
• Dark mode for late-night logging
• iPhone and iPad
WHY PEP
Pep is built only for GLP-1s, so everything connects. See how your medication level lines up with your appetite, your side effects with your doses, and your meals with your protein goals.
SUPPORTED MEDICATIONS
• Weekly shots: Ozempic®, Wegovy®, Mounjaro®, Zepbound®, Trulicity®
• Daily shots: Saxenda®, Victoza®
• Pills: Foundayo™, Rybelsus®, Wegovy® pill
• Compounded: semaglutide, tirzepatide, retatrutide
• Generic names: semaglutide, tirzepatide, liraglutide, dulaglutide, orforglipron
PEP PRO
Pep Pro is an optional auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.
Privacy Policy & Terms of Use: https://pepglp1.com/privacy-policy-terms-of-use/
Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Pep is a tracking tool and does not provide medical advice. Medication levels are estimates for general information only. Always follow your prescriber's guidance. Pep is not affiliated with Novo Nordisk or Eli Lilly. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

bluejetty:00074260:ios.description:
Recharge with Power Nap Tracker. Get just the right amount of sleep to feel your best for the rest of the day.
A short nap of 10-30 minutes does wonders for your thinking and productivity. But napping too long can leave you feeling groggy and disoriented. Power Nap Tracker helps you feel fresh and reenergized by monitoring your nap and waking you up after you've gotten the amount of rest you choose.
Power Nap Tracker will monitor your movements and wake you when you’ve reached your desired nap length, up to 3 hours. 
Enjoy waking up to a catalog of beautiful high-quality sounds recorded live around the world and feel fresh and rejuvenated all day. After your nap you can view your nap profile on a graph. 
From the creators of popular Rain Sounds HQ and Sleep Sounds HQ sleep sound apps, we’ve packed all this capability into a simple and beautiful app that works!
Try Power Nap Tracker today and recharge with the perfect nap.

• Measures your nap and wakes you after the nap time you choose, up to 3 hours.
• Wakes you gently to a catalog of beautiful natural sounds from around the world. 
• After your nap you can view your nap profile on a graph. 
• Captures the loudest sound during your nap, so you can hear noise, snoring or talking in your sleep.
• Works in background or with the screen locked.
• Snooze function allows you to extend your nap a little longer.
• Long high-quality stereo recordings with beautiful high-definition images. 
• Modern easy-to-use interface, tailored for nap time and gentle wake up.
Download Power Nap Tracker now.

bluejetty:00144397:ios.description:
One Click Boat Rental
Teknevia is an application that brings those who want to organize a boat or yacht organization and boat owners together. Teknevia, Turkey's first boat and yacht charter platform that offers online payment opportunity, is only in Istanbul for now!
Customers can examine all the prices of the boats in detail and make online reservations. Boat owners can get reservations 24/7 by listing their boats and prices.
Istanbul Boat and Yacht Charter
Istanbul is one of the important locations for boat rental and yacht charter, not only in Turkey but also in the world. The first thing that comes to mind when Istanbul is mentioned is, of course, the Bosphorus. With many historical mansions, historical palaces, the Maiden's Tower that greets the boats in the middle of the sea, the Galata Tower, the lovers' place, and the Bosphorus bridges, the Bosphorus offers its guests a magnificent visual feast, day and night. This situation makes it attractive to charter boats and yachts in the Bosphorus, both for the residents of Istanbul and for the millions of visitors who come to Istanbul for touristic purposes every year. You can easily experience this wonderful experience with your lover or friends thanks to Teknevia!
Being Isolated from the City in the Middle of the City with Teknevia
Istanbul is one of the busiest cities in the world due to its large population and demographic circulation. In your boat and yacht organization, you will feel isolated from this huge city and have a fun time. This event can be a birthday party with friends or a romantic dinner with your sweetheart.
You can be sure that you will feel special.
See prices! Reserve instantly!
Why Teknevia?
• You can reserve boats instantly by reviewing all prices.
• You can read previous customer reviews.
• With secure payment, you will be comfortable with your reservation.
• You can easily rent your boat by making an online reservation.
What are the advantages of Teknevia for customers?
• You can make reservations 24/7 at Teknevia.
• You rent directly from the boat owner without paying high commissions to the intermediaries.
• You can examine all the details of the boats.
• You can compare the offers, examine the possibilities of the boats and look at the safety equipment.
• Membership at Teknevia is completely free!
• You can reserve your boat by prepayment online.
• Teknevia boat owners are licensed and verified boats.
How Does Teknevia Work?
Compare boats and view their prices.
Reserve the boat you want instantly.
What are the advantages of Teknevia for boat owners?
• You can get a reservation 24/7 by taking your online prepayment.
• Rent your boat directly to customers.
• You can load more than one yacht or boat and update your information whenever you want.
• You do not waste your time by entering the prices of the boats in detail.
• You can see all income and expense information.
• No membership fee!
Are you a Boat Owner?
Become a Teknevia partner for free and get the chance to get reservations 24/7.
• Add your boat.
• Enter the prices of the boat.
• Get online reservation.

bluejetty:00141288:ios.description:
Are you a fan of our Match 3D games? Where you can sort and match items together to clear the screen and win the level?
Lion Studios is happy to announce our new triple pair matching 3D Puzzle Game - Match Ball 3D!
Just like our other fun Match games “Match Ball 3D” is fun and easy to learn, but has an added twist! All of the items are now in a ball that you can rotate 360° in any direction to find items to match. 
This Game is designed to relax all your muscles, release your daily stress, and increase your memorization abilities. All of that while playing a fun and easy to play pair merging puzzle game.
How To Play Match Ball 3D?
Tap on three items that look the same and connect them into triples.
Spin the ball to find covered items to match
Keep doing that until match 3 and clear all the items.
Keep having fun, start new levels and become a 3D puzzle master.
The Game has many different triple sets of 3D objects that are designed to be easy to memorize.
We have a lot of fabulous levels, including
Cute animals
Sweet yummy food
Cool toys
Exciting emojis
Surprising new shiny objects every week, all free.
Relaxing game design & unique 3D objects to connect
Match Ball 3D is a game designed with your well-being in mind. 
With many fun & cute relaxing 3D objects, each level is more interesting than the one before. In each level, the difficulty of triples and the number of items also slightly increases to keep your brain challenged.
Well-designed brain trainer levels that help you to challenge yourself
Match Ball 3D will make it easier for you to memorize objects & details by playing our brain trainer levels. You will start to notice your memorizing abilities becoming better with time and that you master to solve challenging puzzles very fast.
Visit https://lionstudios.cc/contact-us/ if have any feedback, need help on beating a level or have any awesome ideas you would like to see in the game!
From the Studio that brought you Mr. Bullet, Happy Glass, Ink Inc and Love Balls!
Follow us to get news and updates on our other Award Winning titles;

bluejetty:00186947:ios.name: Advanced Language Therapy
bluejetty:00186947:ios.summary: Take your aphasia therapy to the next level with four evidence-based advanced apps that build on the skills established the best-selling Language Therapy 4-in-1 app. This new value-priced advanced app gives you four popular speech therapy a
bluejetty:00186947:ios.description:
Take your aphasia therapy to the next level with four evidence-based advanced apps that build on the skills established the best-selling Language Therapy 4-in-1 app. This new value-priced advanced app gives you four popular speech therapy apps for the price of three to help you improve. 
YOU'LL GET THESE 4 APPS:
-----
1) ADVANCED COMPREHENSION THERAPY
Practice understanding sentences with three activities to improve listening and reading skills. 
-------
2) ADVANCED NAMING THERAPY
Practice word-finding skills with four activities to improve verbal expression.
-------
3) ADVANCED READING THERAPY
Practice reading at the paragraph-level with three levels of difficulty with comprehension questions and audio support.
-------
4) ADVANCED WRITING THERAPY
Practice typing at the word, sentence, and paragraph levels along with strengthening sound-letter relationships.
-----
WHO IS THIS APP FOR?
*Stroke survivors with mild or moderate aphasia (impaired language)
*Brain injury survivors with high-level cognitive-communication impairments
*Speech-language pathologists (SLPs) who work with adult communication
TRY FOR FREE!
Download Advanced Language Therapy Lite to try each of the four apps for free. Then purchase all four in Advanced Language Therapy, or purchase only the ones you need separately. 
THE TACTUS THERAPY DIFFERENCE
In all Tactus Therapy apps for speech therapy, you'll get wifi-free use, no log-ins, and no subscriptions. The activities are based on researched techniques that work. The content is designed with adults in mind, yet can easily be used with older children and teens. Support is built-in to encourage independent use for home practice while being flexible for in-clinic use with a qualified clinician.
Looking for something different in a speech therapy app? We offer a wide range to choose from. Find the right one for you at tactustherapy.com/find

Introducing the ultimate cooking companion, the Instant Connect ™ app - your gateway to culinary excellence. Elevate your cooking experience with over 2,000 curated recipes designed exclusively for Instant Pot appliances, including the renowned Instant Pot, Instant Air Fryers and Toaster Ovens, Duo Crisps, Slow Cookers, and more.
Whether you're embarking on your culinary journey or a seasoned pro, our app empowers you to cook to your full potential. Kickstart your adventure with easy one-pot meals, or explore a multitude of innovative recipes to take your skills to new heights.
Discover exciting ways to prepare everyday staples like eggs, rice, and chicken, or indulge in the art of baking with delectable treats such as cheesecake and brownies.
The Instant Connect ™ app revolutionizes your cooking routine, making it simpler than ever to find time and inspiration every day. Select your appliance, and we’ll provide recipe suggestions that are perfect to get you started.

 An ever-expanding recipe database, featuring over 2,000 diverse recipes inspired by global cuisines and tailored for Instant Pot appliances.
 Tailored search function and home feed, ensuring all recipe recommendations align with your specific appliance.
 Up-to-date home feeds, showcasing recipes based on seasonal ingredients, holiday content, and special occasions.
Step-by-step guided cooking for effortlessly creating mouthwatering meals.
Automatic ingredient lists at the start of every recipe, putting you in control and fully prepared from the get-go.
 A personal cookbook, so you can save your favorite recipes for seamless menu planning.
For Smart, Connected appliance owners, the Instant Connect™ app allows for complete wireless control including:
 Smart recipes that effortlessly send settings directly to your appliance with a simple tap, allowing you to explore new recipes with absolute confidence.
 Real-time appliance monitoring to keep you informed, letting you multitask with the assurance that your cooking companion has it all under control.
Clear appliance helper videos for constant guidance and assurance.
With the Instant Connect ™ app, crafting delightful meals has never been more straightforward. Rest assured, our app is consistently updated to enhance your cooking experience, ensuring faster, easier, and tastier results every time.
Gear up for a culinary revolution and savor the exceptional with the Instant family of appliances. Welcome to a world where cooking is an art, and every meal is a masterpiece.

bluejetty:00014558:ios.description:
Paycor TODEmployee is a smart, adaptive app that, when used with your employer’s Paycor Time On Demand, provides you with flexible time tracking options on the go. Paycor TODEmployee is only for employees of companies who use Paycor’s Time on Demand solution. Access to this app is by invitation only from your HR administrator.
Key Features:
∙ Punch In / Out
∙ View Time Off Balance
∙ Request Time Off 
∙ View Work Schedule
∙ Request to Swap Shifts
∙ Receive notifications when your time card needs action, such as adding a missing punch
∙ Exchange messages with your supervisor
Please Note:
- In order to use this application, an invitation must be received from your company. Please do not download this app without previously receiving an invitation.
- When you log in you may not see all the features listed above. You will only see functionality provided to your employer by Paycor for the product features that are available for mobile access. For any questions, please review the FAQs under Settings in the app.
- This application is available for employees of companies that use Paycor’s Time On Demand solution.

bluejetty:00114953:ios.description:
Stargazing: Stars & Planets is your ultimate guide to the night sky. Simply point your phone toward the heavens and instantly identify stars, planets, constellations, and satellites around you. Whether you are an astronomy enthusiast or just curious about the stars above, this app makes stargazing fun, easy, and educational. 
- Explore the Universe in Real Time 
 Our interactive sky map uses advanced overlay constellations and celestial objects on your screen. Watch as the night sky comes alive with detailed information about stars, planets, and satellites. Follow the movement of Mars, Jupiter, and Saturn, billion stars or discover deep-sky objects like galaxies and nebulae. 
- Meet Astra — Your AI Astronomy Guide
Ask anything about the universe and get instant, easy-to-understand answers. Why is Mars red? What is a black hole? When will the next eclipse happen? Astra explains stars, planets, galaxies, missions, and cosmic phenomena in plain language — perfect for curious minds, students, and lifelong learners alike. Tap any object in the sky map and let Astra tell you its story.
- Live Universe Calendar
Never miss a cosmic moment again. Browse a continuously updated calendar of meteor showers, eclipses, planetary conjunctions, supermoons, ISS passes, comet appearances, and rocket launches — all tailored to your location and time zone. See exactly when, where, and how to watch each event.
- Real-Time Event Notifications
Get alerted before the sky puts on a show. Receive timely reminders for upcoming meteor showers, eclipses, bright satellite passes, and rare planetary alignments, so you are always outside and looking up at the right moment.
- Key Features 
• Explore a precise, real-time sky map of stars, planets, and the Moon for any chosen date, time, and geographic position. 
• Browse a curated catalog of bright stars, nebulae, galaxies, clusters, and other notable deep-sky objects. 
• Smoothly enlarge detailed imagery of the Milky Way and selected deep-sky targets. 
• Switch between multiple constellation line styles and artwork from a variety of cultural sky traditions. 
• Follow artificial satellites in orbit, including major stations and bright passes. 
• View natural-looking horizons with atmospheric tint, daylight progression, twilight, and refraction effects. 
• Inspect 3D models of principal solar system bodies and their major moons. 
• Protect dark adaptation using an optional red-tinted night display mode. 
• Access an extended universe: extremely deep star catalogs, millions of galaxies, nebulae, and clusters, plus comets, minor planets and large asteroid sets. 
• Perform near‑limitless zoom into high‑resolution surface and deep‑sky imagery. 
• Operate fully offline with a compact onboard dataset (millions of stars and deep‑sky objects plus key solar system bodies). 
• Plan observing sessions with tools to evaluate visibility windows, altitude curves, and transit times. 
• Control compatible telescopes directly from the app (Meade LX200, Celestron NexStar, and RTS2), with tap-to-slew GoTo pointing.
- Why Choose Stargazing: Stars & Planets? 
Unlike other astronomy apps, this stargazing tool is designed for both beginners and experts. Whether you are watching a meteor shower, locating the International Space Station, or just enjoying a quiet night under the stars, this app gives you the knowledge and tools to connect with the universe. 
- Turn every night into a stargazing adventure. Download Stargazing: Stars & Planets today and experience the magic of the cosmos right in your pocket. 
- Disclaimer: 
Stargazing: Stars & Planets (“the App”) is provided for educational and entertainment purposes only. Do not use it for navigation, safety‑critical decisions, scientific measurement, or time-sensitive observations requiring certified accuracy. 
Privacy Policy: https://tvgsoft.com/privacy-policy 
Terms of Service: https://tvgsoft.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00062214:ios.name: Findmykids: GPS Phone Tracker
bluejetty:00062214:ios.summary:
Findmykids is a family locator that helps you stay connected with your kid throughout the day. With the help of the app you can see your kid’s phone location and use helpful parental tools to support your family’s daily routine.
Install th
bluejetty:00062214:ios.description:
Findmykids is a family locator that helps you stay connected with your kid throughout the day. With the help of the app you can see your kid’s phone location and use helpful parental tools to support your family’s daily routine.
Install the Findmykids GPS locator on your phone, create a family circle, and get an invitation code. Then install Findmykids on your kid’s phone and enter the invitation code. Your devices will be connected in one family circle, and you will be able to see your kid’s location on the map and stay connected during the day. GPS location helps you find a phone wherever it may be. You can easily check the location of any family member using the GPS locator.
Our features:
- Family GPS locator
See location history, the current location, and the list of places your kid visited during the day. Your kid’s phone location is updated in real time. Add other family members to stay connected and know where everyone is.
- Parental tools and app statistics
See how much time your kid spends using apps and games during the school day.
- Movement notifications
Add places (school, home, sports practice, etc.) and receive notifications when your kid arrives at or leaves them.
You can always find your kid’s phone or another device on the map with the help of the GPS tracker.
- SOS signal
Findmykids is more than just a locator. In case of danger or an emergency, your kid can alert you by pressing the SOS button. You will instantly receive a notification with your kid’s phone location so you can respond quickly.
- Bypassing silent mode
Send a super signal that can be heard even if the phone is on silent mode or inside a backpack.
You don’t have to constantly check on your kid. This feature can also help find the phone if your kid has lost it.
- Battery level monitoring
Receive notifications when your kid’s device battery is low so you can stay connected and avoid worrying about where your kid is.
- Stay connected in the family chat
Exchange messages in the family chat using voice messages and fun stickers.
“Where is my kid right now?” — a question every parent thinks about. With Findmykids, it’s easier to stay informed. You can instantly see your kid’s location and find the phone on the map.
Use all the service features for free for 7 days after the first launch of the app. After the free period ends, only the online location feature will remain available. To access all features, you will need to purchase a plan.
The app cannot be installed secretly. It should only be used with your kid’s consent. Personal data is stored in strict accordance with applicable laws and GDPR policy. The location data of all family members is protected.
THE APP WILL REQUIRE ACCESS TO:
— location, including background location, to determine the device’s position;
— camera and photos, to set an avatar;
— contacts, when setting up GPS watches to choose numbers from contacts;
— microphone, to send voice messages in the chat;
— notifications, to receive chat messages and movement notifications about your kid.
Please review our documents:
User Agreement: https://findmykids.org/docs/terms-of-use/ios/en
Privacy Policy: https://findmykids.org/docs/privacy-policy/ios/en
If you experience technical issues while using the app, you can always contact Findmykids support through the in-app chat or on the website: http://findmykids.org/faq

An all-in-one Sikh Gurbani application, including Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji, Nitnem Gutka, Gurpurab Calendar and over 25 different bani. Complete your daily Nitnem through this gutka app. 
So stand up and be proud to say: "This is MySikhi!"  
***A Must-Have Sikhi App***
App Features Include:
* Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji 
* MyBani - a compilation of our Guru Ji's Bani including:
Daily Nitnem Gutka:
- Japji Sahib, 
- Jaap Sahib, 
- Tav Parsaad Savayai,
- Chaupai Sahib, 
- Anand Sahib. 
- Shabad Hazaray
- Sukhmani Sahib
- Asa Di Vaar

- Ardaas

- Aarti
- Akal Ustat
- Bareh Maahaa
- Basant Ki Vaar
- Chandi Di Vaar
- Dukh Bhanjani Sahib
- Laavan
- Pantis Akhree
- Raag Mala
- Sahansar Nama
- Salok Mehla Nauva
- Sampuran Kirtan Sohila
- Sampuran Rehraas Sahib
- Shastar Naam Mala
- Sidh Gosht
- Ugradanti

Complete compilation of dates & events in calendar format, highlighting:
- Gurpurabs
- Sangraand
- Vaisakhi
- Diwali
And many more important events in Sikh History…
* Customizable Settings:
- Font size
- Font color
- Night Mode
Project MySikhi is & will always be a Free App! 
Waheguru Ji Bhul Chuk Maaf, if there are any errors in any of the features please feel free to contact us, and we will correct them ASAP, as it is not our intention to spread inaccurate information. Please forgive our mistakes.

bluejetty:00182726:ios.description:
The first type of Cambodian chess game is known to the Cambodians as Ouk Chaktrang.
The name “Ouk” was believed to come from imitating the sound made between the chessman and the chessboard while checking. As terminology and rule are concerned, the word “Ouk” means check, and it is required to say out loud by the player who checks the enemy King.
The game is also named “Chaktrang” is formal and derived from Indian, Sanskrit Chaturanga.
Like the international chess, Ouk Chaktrang requires two people to play against each other, but in Cambodia there are always two teams of people participating in the game. This does make every game played even more exciting and entertaining. People, I mean Cambodian men, usually gather to play at a barbershop or Cafe shope for men in their town or village.
The object of Chaktrang is also to checkmate the opponent’s King. In the beginning, who should move first is simply a matter of agreement between the players. However, for the next game, the loser usually has a privilege to move first. If the first game was drawn for some reason, once again the mutual agreement decides for the matter in question.
The second type of Cambodian chess game is Rek, please see the Rek game also.

listings.description:
At Airtel, we make products that are helpful, easy to use & beautiful. The Xsafe app is no exception.

Key features:
•	View Ultra High Definition live-stream of cameras anytime & anywhere
•	With 2-way talk you can speak via camera & app
•	Create a custom perimeter zone to get alerts only in your preferred area
•	Get instant alert of motion, person & intrusion
•	Smart AI for person detection

Xsafe alarm system:
•	Arm your cameras to detect a movement from the app
•	Instant alerts of any movement & view recordings anytime & anywhere
 
With Xsafe, your loved ones are never away from you.

bluejetty:00117691:ios.description:
Funk Brasil - Be the funk DJ in your neighborhood and create music with the best music production studio!
Get ready to get into the rhythm of funk like never before with Funk Brasil. The music production app dedicated to funk lovers, DJs and MCs. Create beats, create beats, mix and share your beats.
Create Amazing Funk Beats: Explore high-quality beat maker tools.
Perfect for MCs and DJs: Our funk sequencer and beat library are ideal for MCs and DJs who want to create the next funk dance hit or relive the classic funk songs of the old and cheesy funk.
Professional Mixing: Perfect your mixes with professional mixing tools and sound effects.
Export and Share: Show your creations to the world, directly from the app, and make your sound echo at funk dances.
Unlock the full potential of your talent and become a master of beat production with Funk Brasil.
Master the Rhythm of Baile Funk! Download Now.
Funk Brasil provides all the tools you need to master the art of creating beats on your smartphone or tablet. Now you can create amazing music with ease, wherever you are! Perfect for those who have a passion for making music!
No need for expensive equipment such as physical samplers, electronic drums or drum pads!
Funk Brasil offers a variety of kits with high-quality sounds, allowing you to create any music you want! In addition, you can create your own kit, allowing you to choose your own sounds and record your own samplers.
Make beats like a professional music producer and become a beat maker!
Create your own beat kit and samplers and share it, as well as videos of your performances, with your friends and on social media!
You don't need a physical sampler, electronic drums or drum pads!
Funk Brasil is an excellent choice for making beats quietly, making noise or needing a lot of space. Enjoy the freedom to produce music wherever you want!
Funk Brasil allows children and adults to make music while having fun and improving their cognitive skills. This app will stimulate your musical talents!
With Funk Brasil, you can make songs like:
- Funk das Antigas
- Funk Ostentação
- Funk Carioca
- Funk Paulista
- Brega Funk
- Love Funk
- Fank Antigo
- Funk You
- Funk Town
- Rap
- Trap
- Electronic
- Reggaeton
- Hip Hop
- R&B
- Sertanejo
- Pop.
- and much more!
Explore Funk Brasil's features:
- Over 200 drum kits to create music
- In-app tutorial
- YouTube videos showing how to play
- Easy to play, as it has pads with loops of beats and grooves
- Customize your kits: upload your sounds and record your spots, beats and samples
- Wide variety of tools to create beats
- New drum kits introduced weekly
- 30 drum pads
- Studio quality audio
- Recording mode
- Share your recordings and custom kits on social media
- Export your recordings to MP3 format
- Compatible with all screen resolutions - Cell phones and Tablets (HD images)
- Free app
- MIDI support
- Multitouch capability
The app contains the following subscription:
- Premium Version (Remove ads and Unlock all Kits)
- Monthly payment ($3,90).
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- The subscription is automatically renewed unless cancelled 24 hours before the renewal.
- The subsequent monthly subscriptions are automatically renewed unless cancelled 24 hours before the next renewal (considering the day of the effective monthly subscription).
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Terms of use and Privacy Policy:
http://www.kolbapps.com/privacy_policy_and_terms.pdf
Have a bash and a blast with the best and most comprehensive pad app on AppStore! 
Touch & Play!

bluejetty:00016275:ios.description:
Maximize your Broncos fandom by downloading the official mobile app of the Denver Broncos. This is 
your home base and one-stop shop for Broncos Country: news, schedules, stats, tickets, exclusive 
drops and everything you need for gameday, all in one place. 
NEWS, SCHEDULE & TEAM INFO 
Breaking news, roster moves, injury updates and real-time stats as they happen, plus original video 
series, photo galleries and podcasts straight from the team. 
• Full schedule with matchup, list and monthly views 
• Live scores and game updates 
• Searchable roster by player, number or position 
• Detailed player pages to track your favorite Bronco 
• Team and player stats in one place 
• Coaching bios, history and achievements 
• Draft, free agency and training camp coverage all offseason long 
READY FOR GAMEDAY 
Everything you need to get to the stadium and into your seat: 
• Access, manage and transfer your mobile tickets right from the app 
• Explore stadium experiences for maps, concessions and important stadium locations 
• Parking, transportation and clear bag policy details 
• ADA and accessibility assistance 
• Gameday guides so you know what to expect before you leave the house 
LIMITED DROPS 
Live, app-exclusive events where Broncos fans get the chance to win team-inspired prizes. No ticket 
needed, just your phone and a little luck. Each Drop runs on a live countdown with real-time fan chats 
and a single moment where winners are revealed. Be in the chat when the timer hits zero for a 
chance to win! 
BRONCOS ARCADE 
Broncos Arcade has a refreshed look for 2026. Line up your kicks in Flick Kick, put your recall to the 
test with Memory Match, and climb the leaderboard to see how you stack up against the rest of 
Broncos Country. 
MAKE IT YOURS 
• Top 5: Choose your five favorite features and put them front and center 
• Favorite Players: follow the guys you care about and jump straight to their content 
• Saved media: Bookmark articles and videos for whenever you're ready 
• Notifications: Pick exactly what you want to hear about 
SEASON TICKET MEMBER HUB 
Season Ticket Members get an app experience that’s all their own. Sign in with Ticketmaster to 
access your Season Ticket Member Hub to manage your account and tickets, unlock member-only 
content and benefits and access the exclusive perks that come with holding your seat in Broncos 
Country. 
Learn more at DenverBroncos.com/mobile-app
Please note: This app features Nielsen's proprietary measurement software which contributes to 
market research, like Nielsen's TV Ratings. Please see 
https://priv-policy.imrworldwide.com/priv/mobile/us/en/optout.html for more information

bluejetty:00018178:ios.summary:
Pay Your Nanny or Caregiver the Right Way in Minutes. Nest Payroll Handles the Taxes and Filings for You.
Paying your nanny, caregiver, or housekeeper shouldn't add more to your plate. Run payroll from your iPhone or iPad, and leave the pa
bluejetty:00018178:ios.description:
Pay Your Nanny or Caregiver the Right Way in Minutes. Nest Payroll Handles the Taxes and Filings for You.
Paying your nanny, caregiver, or housekeeper shouldn't add more to your plate. Run payroll from your iPhone or iPad, and leave the payroll taxes, tax setup and required filings to us. Nest Payroll's tax team does that work for you.
YOUR FIRST PAY STUB IN ABOUT 5 MINUTES
Once you enter your household employer information and add your employee, you'll be ready to go. You can approve a pay stub and pay your employee right away without any delay.
EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO PAY YOUR HOUSEHOLD EMPLOYEE
• Calculate wages, payroll taxes and take-home pay.
• Automatically email professional pay stubs to your employee.
• Track sick time and paid time off.
• Receive weekly payroll reminders.
• Get notifications about upcoming tax payments, filings and available documents.
• Estimate taxes and take-home pay with the payroll calculator.
• Claim eligible tax benefits.
• Access tax documents, wage and payroll history, plus Dependent Care FSA reports for easy reimbursements - all in one place.
• Receive concierge text and email support from Nest Payroll's support team in California.
WE DO ALL THE TAX WORK, SO YOU SAVE TIME AND SKIP THE HASSLE
Nest Payroll's tax team will:
• Set up your required federal and state employer tax accounts.*
• Submit required new-hire reports.
• Prepare and file required quarterly/annual payroll tax returns and remit your tax payments to the agencies when they're due.
• Prepare and file employee W-2s and W-3s, and provide a signature-ready Schedule H for your personal tax return.
This work is performed by our tax team outside the app, directly with the tax agencies. 
*Some states require employers to complete registrations and/or authorize Nest Payroll before Nest Payroll can complete filings/payments.
A SIMPLER PAYDAY
Enter your employee's hours and review their pay stub, showing calculated taxes, withholding and take-home pay. Then pay the take-home amount using Cash App or Venmo from the pay stub, another payment app like Zelle, or a check.
MADE FOR HOUSEHOLD EMPLOYERS
Nest Payroll supports families employing nannies, nanny-shares, child caregivers, senior caregivers, aides, housekeepers, babysitters, au pairs and more. It is designed for household employment, not business payroll.
CATCH-UP MADE EASY
Already paid your employee and need to catch up? You can request catch-up for your employee right from the employee's profile. Just enter the wages you paid outside of Nest Payroll, receive a summary of the taxes you will owe, approve the plan and we'll get you compliant with the IRS and your state.
REAL PEOPLE WHEN YOU NEED HELP
Get help by text or email, Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m. Pacific. Contact support right from your account when you have questions about setup, payroll or something else.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled. Manage or cancel your Apple subscription in your Apple account settings.
• Apple subscriptions do not include a free trial.
• Catch-up work and optional services may cost extra.
• If you cancel and want Nest Payroll to complete future tax work, that service is available for an additional fee.
Never Worry About Household Taxes Again.
Terms of service:
https://nestpayroll.com/terms-of-service
Privacy policy:
https://nestpayroll.com/privacy-policy-app-link
Support:
https://nestpayroll.com/support

bluejetty:00119327:ios.description:
It’s Stunning, Smart & Superior- MagicBricks iPhone app.
MagicBricks iPhone app is an intelligently designed Real Estate app for smart users who are looking for an interesting, intuitive and feature packed app for buying, selling and renting properties on the Go!
Simple, clean yet visually appealing, this Real Estate iPhone app is designed to fulfil your residential & commercial property requirement in a very simple and fast way. 
Our cleverly designed app helps you refine your property search with the help of filters like BHK, budget, furnished, possession date etc so that you get your dream property easily & quickly. Not only this, our smart app displays properties in the form of list, photos & map to give a comprehensive view of the property and make your property selection easier & quicker.
Searching for flats for sale or rent in a particular locality was never this easy. You can also check locality reviews, locality ratings and compare various localities for buying or renting purpose on our Locality Review section. Our app allows you to stay up-to-date with the latest price trends in the property market with our Price Trends feature.
Our next gen app is designed to equip you with posting a property effortlessly. In fact we have made it so easy that you can even take photos through the app directly and post it with your listings instantly.
If you are one of those who prefer taking the help of an agent to buy, sell or rent a property, our iOS app allows you to search and contact an agent conveniently anytime and anywhere. You can shortlist agents, add them as favourites and contact them later.
Magicbricks Free iPhone App is:
-- Convenient: Search Properties & New Projects on the move; set property alerts & get matching properties for sale or rent in your inbox
-- Feature packed: Compare property price trends, view neighborhood ratings, photos & reviews.
-- Smart: Post your property even ‘On The Go’. Checkout responses received on your property & contact the buyers instantly.
Key Features:
> Choose from over 6 lac properties
> Refine your search with the help of filters like price, bedrooms, locality, etc
> Set property alerts & get matching properties directly in your inbox
> Contact Advertisers on the go. Call, Send SMS/email to property advertisers for FREE
> Search agents/property dealers on the basis of properties, locality and city they are dealing in
> Save properties, projects and agents for future reference
> Post property & showcase it over 15 lac buyers
> Check out price trends to evaluate property rental & capital values
> Check out the latest news/happenings in the real estate sector
> View & manage properties posted & checkout the responses received through My Magicbox
About MagicBricks:
MagicBricks is India’s #1 Real Estate site which offers you to buy, sell, rent all kind of residential and commercial properties in India. It offers 800,000 property listings across various cities in India. MagicBricks features a host of services, like Property Advice, Localities, Rates & Trends, Prop Index, Buyers Guide etc to help its users make wise property buying, selling & renting decisions.

bluejetty:00076702:ios.description:
LightCut is an AI-powered video editing app with awesome templates and effects that help you create stylish videos and vlogs with ease. Try the AI video editor for unique videos with just a tap, or the Inspire Cam feature, which lets you shoot like a pro. You can also trim and merge your video clips and add text, music, stickers, effects, transitions, and more for expanded creativity. Simple but powerful, LightCut is an all-in-one video editing app that’s great for beginners, professionals, and everyone in between. 
Superfast AI-powered Video Editor
-Automatic video creator to edit content in seconds.
-Simply select your favorite video clips and photos, and after analyzing them for a few moments, the AI-powered One-Tap Edit feature will turn them into share-worthy clips, even in 4K UHD.
-AI can analyze your footage and select highlight moments, matching them with suitable video templates for outstanding results.
-Supports editing drone footage from the Mavic 3 Series, Air 3, Mini 4 Pro and Mini 3 Series, as well as handheld footage from the Osmo Mobile Series, Osmo Action Series, and Osmo Pocket Series without exporting the footage, saving storage space on your smartphone or mobile device.
Diverse Video Templates
-Easy-to-use Templates: Just choose the template and tempo you like, and then an eye-catching video will be made automatically.
-Multiple creative template styles available: travel, road trips, nature, building & city, fashion, lifestyle vlogs, sports, aerials, and more. 
Inspire Cam Shooting Modes for a Pro-level Look
-Unsure how to film or edit? No worries! Convenient tutorials give you step-by-step guides on how to get great shots in a wide variety of scenarios.
-After shooting, a super cool video will be made automatically. This gives you everything you need to shoot, edit, and share videos in one quick step.
All-in-one Video Editor with Powerful Tools
- Professional editing tools and features help you make epic videos in a flash. 
- Convenient features like video trimmer, video cutter, and slow/fast motion with easy adjustments make your videos instantly more attractive. You can even split videos into multiple clips.
- Multiple stickers and font styles help you get ultra-creative. 
- Edit and combine videos with filters, effects, and transitions.
Tilt-Shift Effects for a Surreal Look
-Try Tilt-Shift Effects to give your shots a miniaturized and unique look.
-Try city streets and other urban settings for truly stunning results.
Aerial AudioMatch: Automatically Add Sound Effects
-AI can automatically add sound effects to your drone footage based on themes like Forest, Sea, Field, Urban Street, and more.
-With just a few taps, you can add high-quality sound effects to your videos without having to manually search for and edit them. Whether you're creating a vlog, a short film, or just having fun, this AI-powered tool can automatically detect the action in your video and suggest an optimized sound effect to match. 
-With a library of thousands of professionally recorded sounds, you can easily enhance the audio of your videos and take your content to the next level.

bluejetty:00083648:ios.description:
Open a new era of AI-powered creativity with Clipfly. Effortlessly turn text or images into dynamic videos, including viral AI dance videos in seconds. Whether you're creating fun social content, trending dance clips, or eye-catching marketing visuals, Clipfly helps you bring ideas to life with just a prompt or a single image.
Want to turn photos into viral dance videos? Just upload a photo—baby, pet, or selfie—pick a dance template, and let Clipfly do the rest. In seconds, your image becomes a fun, expressive dance video ready to share. No editing skills needed—just upload and create. Perfect for social media, family memories, or jumping on the latest trends.
Main Functions:
Convert photos to realistic motion video
Generate photos from text and turn them into realistic motion videos
Generate videos from text and turn ideas into realistic masterpieces
Clipfly, makes every frame unique:
AI Dance Video Generator:
Turn any photo into expressive dance videos. From baby dance clips to funny pet videos and animated selfies, Clipfly helps you create engaging, trend-ready content in seconds.
Image to Video:
We have provided you with different creative ideas to create a unique piece of work by uploading just one image; if you have more creative ideas, just describe them and our powerful AI engine will realize your imagination in seconds.
Text to Image to Video:
Provide your ideas, create the image work you want using an advanced AI engine, and convert it to video.Clipfly empowers your creativity with more possibilities.
Text to Video:
Just give us your idea and we'll help you realize your creation. You can make tons of one-of-a-kind art with Clipfly.
Magic Sync:
Animate your photos by copying movements from any reference video, bringing still images to life with realistic motion.
Video Extension:
Extend your clips with AI-generated frames that blend seamlessly into your original footage—no loops or awkward transitions, just smooth and natural results.
Video Eraser:
Remove unwanted elements like people, text, logos, or moving objects from your videos for a cleaner, more polished look.
The Clipfly Pro subscription fee is charged weekly or yearly. The fees for the Clipfly Pro plan are paid following purchase confirmation. The subscription will automatically renew on expiry unless the automatic renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the expiry of the current subscription period. Once the subscription is confirmed, your iTunes account will be charged according to the plan you chose. After purchase, you may go to the iTunes Settings to manage your subscription and turn the automatic renewal off.
Terms of Service:
https://www.clipfly.ai/doc?type=termsOfService
Privacy Policy:
https://www.clipfly.ai/doc?type=privacyPolicy

With Contacts Sync Pro, you can quickly & easily sync your Google or Outlook contacts with iPhone, giving you access to your contacts wher
bluejetty:00178976:ios.description:
••• SYNC GOOGLE, ICLOUD, & OUTLOOK!
••• #1 SYNC APP FOR 15+ YEARS!
••• TRUSTED BY 10,000,000+ USERS!
With Contacts Sync Pro, you can quickly & easily sync your Google or Outlook contacts with iPhone, giving you access to your contacts wherever you go. This app distinguishes itself with its reliability, ease of use, speed, and with a true "2-way sync" that merges changes made to either account. This is the #1 app for syncing contacts both in terms of downloads & reviews.
Also of significance, this app syncs your Google labels or Outlook categories with your iPhone lists. For instance, you may have organized your Google contacts into groups such as "friends," "family," and "coworkers." After a sync, your iPhone and Google groups will match. With your groups configured on iPhone, you can easily send group emails or group messages.
SYNC THE FOLLOWING ACCOUNTS:
• Sync Google with iPhone
• Sync Outlook with iPhone
• Sync 2 Google accounts
SYNC ANY IPHONE ACCOUNT:
• Choose to sync all of your iPhone contacts, or choose to sync contacts from a specific iPhone account, such as iCloud, a local iPhone address book, Outlook, or a CardDAV account
SYNC TYPES:
• Choose from one of the following sync types: 2-Way Sync, 1-Way Sync, and Manual Sync
• Choose a 2-Way Sync to sync changes in both directions
• Choose a 1-Way Sync to transfer changes in one direction only
• Choose a Manual Sync to sync specific contacts only
SYNCS ALL FIELDS:
• Syncs all fields including names, phonetic names, nicknames, email addresses, phone numbers, postal addresses, company names, job titles, departments, birthdays, anniversaries, events, notes, web page addresses, relationships, instant messaging accounts, & social profiles
• Syncs contact photos
• Syncs custom labels & custom fields
INITIAL SYNC:
• During the initial sync, the contents of matching contacts will be merged
CONFIRM CHANGES BEFORE SYNCING:
• Review each change before the sync actually begins
AUTOMATIC SYNC:
• Automatically syncs contacts in the background 24/7
APPLY FILTERS INCLUDING GROUP FILTER:
• Apply the group filter, new contact filter, and more!
DUPLICATE CONTACTS:
• Eliminate duplicate contacts from both iPhone and Google

bluejetty:00089175:ios.description:
Experience profound relaxation with Nook, where serene sounds and HD visuals merge to create a deeply immersive environment. Whether you need to unwind, sleep, meditate, or focus, Nook offers a holistic sensory experience that enhances your mental and physical well-being.
Why Choose Nook?
Nook goes beyond just listening; it immerses you in a world of calm. By combining high-definition visuals with soothing natural sounds, Nook helps you relax faster, sleep better, focus more effectively, and meditate with ease.
Key Features:
Visual Soundscapes: Watch serene nature scenes unfold, perfectly synchronized with calming sounds for enhanced immersion.

bluejetty:00087991:ios.description:
مسبحة الذكر - رفيقك في التسبيح والذكر
سبحة إلكترونية ذكية ومتطورة بدون إعلانات، صُممت خصيصاً لتسهيل التسبيح والذكر والاستغفار على المسلمين في كل مكان. سواءً كنت تريد التسبيح بعد الصلاة أو قراءة القرآن الكريم أو أذكار الصباح والمساء، مسبحة الذكر هي خيارك الأمثل.
لماذا مسبحة الذكر؟:
» العد التلقائي الذكي - ميزة فريدة! - عد التسبيح تلقائياً دون الحاجة للمس الشاشة! ميزة نادرة تجدها فقط في مسبحة الذكر، توفر راحة أكبر أثناء الذكر والتسبيح.
» إحصائيات تفصيلية متقدمة - تتبع تسبيحك بدقة - كم مرة سبّحت؟ متى كان آخر استغفار؟ إحصائيات كاملة تشمل التاريخ والوقت واليوم لكل ذكر على حدة.
» أذكارك الشخصية بين يديك - أضف أذكارك الخاصة وعدّلها ورتبها حسب أولوياتك بكل سهولة. مرونة كاملة في إدارة أذكارك.
» نسخ احتياطي سحابي - احفظ بياناتك في السحابة ولا تقلق من فقدان إحصائياتك وأذكارك عند تغيير الجهاز أو حذف التطبيق.
» القرآن الكريم مدمج - اقرأ القرآن الكريم مباشرة من التطبيق بدون الحاجة لتطبيق منفصل. كل ما تحتاجه في مكان واحد!
» قسم خاص للأدعية - أضف أدعيتك الشخصية واحفظها في قسم خاص. دعاء من القلب محفوظ ومنظم.
» تذكير ذكي يومي - اضبط إشعارات يومية لتذكيرك بالأذكار في الأوقات المناسبة لك. لن تنسى ورد يومك بعد اليوم.
» أهداف يومية محفّزة - حدد هدفك اليومي من التسبيح وتابع إنجازك. حافظ على استمراريتك مع نظام الأهداف المحفّز.
تصميم أنيق يريح العين:
- الوضع الليلي - لراحة عينيك أثناء الذكر ليلاً
- ألوان وثيمات متعددة - اختر ما يناسب ذوقك
- واجهة بسيطة وسهلة - مناسبة لجميع الأعمار
- تصميم عصري وجميل
مميزات إضافية:
- تنبيه عند إكمال العدد المطلوب
- صوت وهزاز عند كل تسبيحة (قابل للتعطيل)
- منع قفل الشاشة أثناء التسبيح
- تصفير العداد بسهولة
- إضافة أعداد يدوياً للإحصائية
- تعديل الأذكار في أي وقت
- ترتيب الأذكار حسب الأولوية
- اختيار نوع التنبيه وصوت الإشعارات
يعمل بدون إنترنت:
سبّح واستغفر في أي مكان دون الحاجة للاتصال بالإنترنت. جميع المميزات تعمل أوفلاين.
مجاني بالكامل - بدون إعلانات
على عكس معظم التطبيقات، مسبحة الذكر مجانية تماماً وبدون أي إعلانات مزعجة. تجربة نظيفة للتركيز على الذكر فقط.
حجم صغير وخفيف
لا يستهلك مساحة كبيرة من جهازك، ويعمل بسلاسة على جميع الأجهزة.
مناسب للجميع
من سن 4 سنوات فما فوق. سواءً للاستخدام الشخصي أو لتعليم الأطفال الذكر والتسبيح.
مثالي لـ:
- التسبيح بعد كل صلاة
- أذكار الصباح والمساء
- الاستغفار المستمر
- أذكار رمضان والأيام المباركة
- التهليل والتكبير
- أذكار الحج والعمرة
- أي ذكر تريده!
لماذا تختار مسبحة الذكر؟ ليست مجرد عداد بسيط، بل هي حل متكامل يجمع:
- سبحة إلكترونية ذكية
- قرآن كريم كامل
- أذكار قابلة للتخصيص
- إحصائيات تفصيلية
- نسخ احتياطي سحابي
- بدون إعلانات إطلاقاً
كل هذا في تطبيق واحد مجاني!
حمّل الآن وابدأ رحلتك مع الذكر
اجعل هاتفك سبحة ذكية تساعدك على المواظبة على الذكر والتسبيح. 
رمضان كريم
استخدم مسبحة الذكر في شهر رمضان المبارك للتسبيح والاستغفار وقراءة القرآن الكريم.
نحن نطور التطبيق باستمرار بناءً على اقتراحاتكم. شكراً لثقتكم!

bluejetty:00099239:ios.description:
Amelia’s life takes a dramatic turn when her plane crashes during a storm while she searches for her missing parents — two archaeologists who vanished while exploring ancient ruins. Awakening on a mysterious island called Paitili, a hidden city woven into ancient paintings, Amelia finds herself stranded in the wild, with only nature, instinct, and hope to guide her. This is more than an island survival story — it's a chance to rebuild, discover, and grow.
Help Amelia survive day by day on this tropical island. Learn to farm, grow seasonal crops, harvest your bounty, and raise adorable animals like cows, chickens, and dogs. Cook, craft, and complete meaningful quests as you uncover fragments of her family’s past. Explore wild landscapes and build your own town from the ground up in this relaxing yet thrilling island farm simulator.
Dreamy Harvest is not just a farm game, it’s a perfect blend of farming simulator, exploration, and city building wrapped in a beautiful, emotional narrative. Whether you're a casual player or a passionate farmer, there's a world waiting for you to explore and shape.
◆ Game Features:
▸ Explore and build in exotic locations: uncover waterfalls, dense jungles, and ancient ruins.
▸ Enjoy a calm and cozy farm simulator game with seasonal planting, harvesting, and animal care.
▸ Build your own town from a humble village to a lively island city full of life and surprises.
▸ Face a variety of quests from island survival to touching family stories.
▸ Participate in exciting seasonal events and celebrate each harvest with style.
▸ Play fun mini-games and meet unique explorer characters as you journey across the archipelago.
▸ Craft recipes, cook meals, trade with neighbors, and expand your tropical paradise.
◆ Why you'll love Dreamy Harvest:
→ Dive into an unforgettable island farm adventure with Amelia as you reclaim the land, unlock your family legacy, and thrive in the wilderness.
→ From a bare plot of land, build, plant, and grow your crops while turning your dream farm into a vibrant town.
→ Craft, cook, and harvest with purpose. Every action helps Amelia get closer to the truth.
→ Join the global farming community, decorate your island, and enjoy the peaceful rhythm of simulator life.
→ Whether you're in it for the survival, the story, or the joy of progress — this is the best farm game for players who love to explore and build adventure.
So, are you ready to become a true farmer and write your own story of growth and discovery?
Download Dreamy Harvest: Farm Island now and begin your journey in the most charming farming adventure game.
Slow down, breathe in the ocean air, and build the island paradise you've always dreamed of.

bluejetty:00085806:ios.description:
We present to you Daiary, the revolutionary app that converts your voice notes into professional books, ready to be printed and shipped to your home. You no longer need to be an expert in writing or design; with Daiary, all you need is your voice and a little imagination.
Highlighted Features:
 • Intelligent Transcription: Our advanced artificial intelligence transcribes your voice notes and converts them into professional text, adding order and style to your writing.
 • Automated Layout: Don’t worry about design. The AI takes care of laying out your content in a flawless book format.
 • Variety of Formats: Create personal diaries, travel journals, personalized stories, reflective essays, or even your own newspaper just by speaking.
 • Professional Printing: From within the app, you can request to have your book printed and receive it at home with bookstore quality.
How It Works:
 1. Record Your Voice Notes: Talk about your experiences, share stories, or express your thoughts.
 2. Automatic Transcription: The AI accurately transcribes your notes, generating clear and professional text.
 3. Intelligent Layout: The content is automatically organized into a book format, ready to be printed.
 4. Order Your Printed Book: With just one click, you can order the printing of your book and have it delivered to your home.
Ideal for:
 • Personal Diaries: Easily document your daily life or travel adventures.
 • Personalized Stories: Create unique stories with characters that you narrate yourself.
 • Essays and Reflections: Write effortlessly about your deepest ideas and thoughts.
 • Citizen Journalism: Report and publish your own journalistic notes about the events you witness.
Daiary – Where your voice becomes a book.

bluejetty:00156430:ios.description:
S+H: More Than Just a Home 
At Steward + Helm, our vision is simple yet powerful: We believe in the dignity of having a great place to live. We manage our properties with an ownership mindset, keeping our resident’s quality of life in their home as our guiding light. We never lose sight that our properties are homes, and our residents are our community. 
Our people-first approach informs everything we do.
For our residents, that means we provide best-in-class service, tools, and technology to make it easy to live at our properties. The S+H app is your friendly and reliable companion for a streamlined, connected, and enriched living experience. Download now and take the helm, at home!
Key Features:
• Make Payments: Make one-time payments in 3 easy steps or set up recurring payments to avoid late fees.
• Sign Documents: Sign important documents, including lease renewals, directly through the app. 
• Submit Maintenance Requests: Easily submit maintenance requests with photos and voice memos and track their progress. 
• Have a Roommate? Share rent, utility, and other costs using automatic payments.
• Access Account Information: Access your resident account information and lease documents anytime.
• Stay Informed: Receive push notifications and view community announcements and event calendars.
• Connect with Neighbors: Interact with your neighbors and build a stronger community through the Bulletin Board.
• Renew Your Lease: View rates, choose terms, and finalize the renewal process directly inside the app.

bluejetty:00014336:ios.name: JetSign: Fill & Sign PDF Docs
bluejetty:00014336:ios.summary:
Say goodbye to printing, scanning, and complex e-signature apps! JetSign lets you sign any document (Word, PDF, Pages, images) and invite others to sign remotely including: 
SUPER-SIMPLE SIGNING EXPERIENCE 
Tap or click anywhere to sign wi
bluejetty:00014336:ios.description:
Say goodbye to printing, scanning, and complex e-signature apps! JetSign lets you sign any document (Word, PDF, Pages, images) and invite others to sign remotely including: 
SUPER-SIMPLE SIGNING EXPERIENCE 
Tap or click anywhere to sign with your finger. Add your e-signature, dates, and text to your document and generate a signed PDF! 
FILL & SIGN FORMS 
Use our signature app to easily fill and sign forms by editing text directly on the document - no text entry pop-ups required! Resize text, add checkmarks and X's, and clone fields with our form-filler features and save as a PDF. 
INVITE OTHERS TO SIGN REMOTELY
Send out documents for e-signature by email or with a simple signing link that you can share in your own email or text message. You and your remote signer(s) can view and sign your document with a full audit trail. When the other signer adds their e-signature, you will get notified of the signed PDF by email.
ADD SIGNING FIELDS FOR REMOTE SIGNERS 
Make signing easier by highlighting exactly where others should sign, initial, and fill out your document! You can also add text, name, date signed, and checkbox fields to your agreements and forms. 
CREATE TAMPER-PROOF AGREEMENTS WITH DIGITAL SIGNATURES
JetSign Premium uses digital signatures so you can verify the integrity of your signed document and detect any changes after signing with popular PDF viewers such as Adobe Acrobat Reader. To comply with Adobe standards, JetSign's digital signatures are powered by a Certificate Authority that is an approved member of the Adobe Approved Trust List (AATL) program.
SAVE TIME WITH TEMPLATES
Add a document once and re-use it daily for new customers and signers, including signer roles and fields, and template fields to be prefilled before inviting customers to sign.
CONVERT ANY FILE INTO A SIGNED PDF 
Add one or several documents at a time including Word (doc/docx), Pages, PDF, HTML, RTF, WordPerfect, images, and 15 other file formats. 
EASY IMPORTING
Add files from Dropbox, Google Docs & Drive, Microsoft OneDrive, Mail, and other apps to start signing. 
STRONG SECURITY 
We protect your documents in the cloud with leading encryption methods (AES-256), SSL hosting, and full audit trails for electronic signatures. 
To share documents across your devices and with your remote signers, JetSign uses encrypted cloud storage in a secure US-based data center. View our Privacy Policy for full details at https://www.jetsign.com/privacy.
JetSign can be used for NDA's, sales proposals, contracts, job offers, lease agreements, and more. Discover how easy e-signatures can be - download JetSign and get started for free! (no account or registration required)
About Us 
JetSign is made in Vancouver, Canada and is a secure e-signature service by GrowthClick Inc. We're focused on creating a super-simple signing experience that you'll love using from your smartphone, tablet, and web browser.
Get started for free (including up to 3 signed documents) or upgrade to unlock everything. Our plans start at $4.99 USD per month ($39.99/year) for additional signing and more features. (Note: Signing documents sent by other users is always free). 
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://www.jetsign.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.jetsign.com/terms

Never have time for a full-length movie?
With DramaTV, you get all the excitement of thrilling stories in a fraction of the time. Whether you’re stuck in traffic, waiting for an appointment, or just need a quick break, DramaTV offers high-quality mini-dramas, action-packed shorts, emotional stories, and short dramas in a format that fits perfectly into your day.
Need a quick escape or a dose of fun before drifting off?
DramaTV has the perfect entertainment fix for your cravings. We deliver bite-sized short stories, short dramas, and Drama TV episodes that you can enjoy in just minutes. Perfect for busy schedules, each short story and short reel is packed with high-quality, thrilling moments to keep you hooked. Enjoy a mini escape anytime!
Fresh, Addictive Content, Anytime
Get hooked on daily updates with new short movies, short reels, and episodes. DramaTV is your go-to for exclusive mini-series that bring the drama, romance, action, and suspense you crave—all in minutes. With various genres, you’ll always find something new to binge without ever feeling like you're missing out. Perfect for when you need a quick fix of drama or a refreshing break from the daily grind! 
Why You’ll Love It:
Binge in Minutes: Enjoy full short films and drama TV episodes that fit into your busy day.
New Content Daily: Fresh short reels and stories added regularly.
Something for Every Mood: Explore a variety of genres — from romance to thrillers, there’s always something to match your vibe.
Stream high-quality drama anytime, anywhere. With DramaTV, the perfect entertainment is always within reach! With a growing library of short movies and short drama series, you’ll always have fresh entertainment at your fingertips.
We value your feedback! If you have suggestions or feedback to make DramaTV better, we'd love to hear from you. Don't hesitate to contact us at support@drama.tv

bluejetty:00069162:ios.description:
Tap your way to record profits at Dunder Mifflin! Get down to business with Michael Scott, Jim Halpert, Pam Beesly, Kelly Kapoor, Dwight Schrute, Stanley Hudson and your Scranton branch favorites and make some sales!
Play through some of the most memorable moments in this brand-new free idle game inspired by NBC’s critically acclaimed Emmy®-winning U.S. version of the comedy The Office, which is streaming exclusively on Peacock. Save your branch from downsizing by selling paper to unlock and upgrade characters, desks, and memorable episodes. 
Regional manager Michael Scott needs to improve the Scranton branch's performance to avoid downsizing - easier said than done when Jim won't stop pranking Dwight, Dwight won't stop complaining about Jim, and Stanley won't stop doing crossword puzzles. Look out, though; at the end of each business day Corporate takes their share of the money. Sorry, Michael, it's back to work at the office tomorrow. But don't worry, any upgrades you've built stay with you as your progress in the game and you'll be making more in-game rewards before you know it. 
GAME FEATURES
COLLECT ICONIC CHARACTER IN-GAME
Tap, click, and upgrade to collect some of the most memorable characters from The Office including Prison Mike, Farmer Dwight, Pretzel Day Stanley, and of course Three Hole Punch Jim. 
RELIVE MEMORABLE EPISODES FROM THE OFFICE
Click through memorable episodes from all nine seasons, like "The Dundies" and "Dinner Party"! Take a seat in Michael's office, get in line for Pretzel Day, or spend the weekend at the Schrute Farms. Oh, and watch out for Kevin's famous chili!
EARN IN-GAME REWARDS TO KEEP THE BRANCH AFLOAT
Manage Dunder Mifflin Scranton with the help of the whole branch! Get new leads, and tap away as the in-game rewards start rolling in. Just make sure Michael doesn't spend the surplus on a new HD television!

bluejetty:00099006:ios.description:
Join over 2 million players and design the cozy garden of your dreams, alongside real friends. Collect and grow rare pets, complete your Garden Journal, and hang out with your friends — or play in solitude, with soothing garden sounds to relax your mind. Whether you check in once a day or stay to hang out, your plants and pets are always growing, even while you're offline!
Collect Rare Pets with Powerful Abilities
Hatch and raise a collection of unique pets — each one brings special perks to help your garden flourish.
Customize Your Avatar
Earn bread by playing and gardening, then spend it on outfits, accessories, and more. With millions of combinations, your avatar (technically they're called "bloblings" btw) is truly your own.
Relax with Friends, Your Way
Chat, garden, and explore at your own pace. Invite friends into your garden for bonuses, help each other grow faster, or simply enjoy the calm of gardening side by side. You can also play solo and enjoy the tranquil companionship of your pets and relaxing nature sounds!
Grow While You’re Away
Your crops never stop growing. Even when you’re offline, you’ll come back to a garden full of life and rewards.
Sign in with Apple, Google, or Discord
Just a few taps - no passwords! Cross-play and cross-progression supported on all platforms.
