bluejetty:00178316:ios.name: Kingdom Two Crowns
bluejetty:00178316:ios.summary: A shroud of mystery envelops these uncharted medieval lands where ancient monuments, relics and mythical creatures await. Echoes of bygone eras speak of past greatness and in Kingdom Two Crowns, part of the award-winning franchise Kingdom,
bluejetty:00178316:ios.description:
A shroud of mystery envelops these uncharted medieval lands where ancient monuments, relics and mythical creatures await. Echoes of bygone eras speak of past greatness and in Kingdom Two Crowns, part of the award-winning franchise Kingdom, you embark on an adventure as the Monarch. In this side-scrolling journey atop your steed, you recruit loyal subjects, build your Kingdom and protect your crown from the Greed, monstrous creatures looking to steal your Kingdom's treasures. 
BUILD
Lay the foundation of a mighty Kingdom with towering walls, protecting towers while cultivating prosperity through building farms and recruiting villagers. In Kingdom Two Crowns expanding and growing your Kingdom grants access to new units and technologies. 
EXPLORE
Venture into the unknown beyond the protection of your borders, through secluded forests and ancient ruins to seek treasures and hidden knowledge to aid your quest. Who knows what legendary artifacts or mythological beings you will find. 
DEFEND
As the night falls, shadows come to life and the monstrous Greed assault your kingdom. Rally your troops, muster your courage, and steel yourself, for each night will demand ever-growing feats of tactical mastermind. Deploy archers, knights, siege weapons, and even newfound Monarch abilities and artifacts to hold against the waves of Greed. 
CONQUER
As the Monarch, lead assaults against the source of the Greed to secure your islands. Send your groups of soldiers to clash with the enemy. A word of caution: make sure your troops are prepared and sufficient in numbers, as the Greed will not go down without a fight. 
UNCHARTED ISLES
Kingdom Two Crowns is an evolving experience that includes several free content updates:
• Shogun: Journey to lands inspired by the architecture and culture of feudal Japan. Play as the mighty Shogun or Onna-bugeisha, enlist the ninja, lead your soldiers to battle atop the mythological Kirin, and form new strategies as you brave the Greed hiding in thick bamboo forests. 
• Dead Lands: Enter the dark lands of Kingdom. Play as unique Monarchs, including the Shardbinder Miriam, with powerful traits from the gothic horror action-RPG Bloodstained. 
• Challenge Islands: Representing the greatest challenge ever seen for hardened veteran monarchs. Take on five challenges with different rules and objectives. Can you survive long enough to claim the gold crown? 
Additional DLC available via in-app purchase:
• Norse Lands: Set in a domain inspired by Norse Viking culture 1000 C.E, the Norse Lands DLC is a full new campaign that expands the world of Kingdom Two Crowns with a unique setting to build, defend, explore, and conquer.
• Call of Olympus: Explore islands of ancient legends and mythos, seek the favors of the gods to challenge and defend against Greed of epic scales in this major expansion. 
Your adventure is only the beginning. Oh Monarch, stay vigilant for dark nights are still to come, protect your crown!

bluejetty:00187214:ios.description:
SmartLine is a second phone number for your business. When you receive a call through SmartLine, you know it’s for business so you can answer professionally. When you call or text through SmartLine, customers see your new business phone number so your personal number stays private.

If you didn't purchase SmartLine through iTunes, you can manage your subscription through the GoDaddy website.

bluejetty:00025880:ios.summary:
Read your script on a teleprompter right over the camera, then get captions on every take, timed to each word and spelled the way you wrote them. Already have a video? Caption it in 20 languages. All on your iPhone, nothing uploaded.
TELEP
bluejetty:00025880:ios.description:
Read your script on a teleprompter right over the camera, then get captions on every take, timed to each word and spelled the way you wrote them. Already have a video? Caption it in 20 languages. All on your iPhone, nothing uploaded.
TELEPROMPTER
• Your script scrolls over the live camera, just under the lens, so you keep eye contact
• Reading speed from 80 to 220 words per minute, with the read time shown
• Adjust the text size and the dark glass behind the words
• Mirror mode, 3-2-1 countdown, light, front or back camera
• Write your script by typing, pasting, or tapping the mic and just talking
• Tap to pause the scroll and jump back to any part. Retake or keep the take
• Your scripts stay saved for the next shoot
AUTO CAPTIONS
• Every take goes straight to captions that follow your script's spelling
• Or pick any video and get subtitles timed to each spoken word
• 20 caption languages, including English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Arabic, Hindi, Japanese, Korean and Chinese
• Long videos welcome: full podcasts, lectures and interviews
• Vertical, square or landscape: captions fit the frame
• Fix any word, split, merge or delete lines, fine-tune the timing
• Choose how many words show at once. Undo and redo anything
STYLE
• 12 ready-made caption looks and 22 bold fonts, including Arabic fonts
• Color, gradient, box, outline and shadow
• Karaoke highlight on the spoken word, and stars to make key words pop
• Entrance animations. Drag captions anywhere, pinch to resize
• Save your own style for new projects
• Add your own titles and text on the video
MAGIC IN ONE TAP
• Highlights: key words picked for you
• Emojis: add them to your captions
• Translate: your captions in 15 languages with Apple's on-device translation
EXPORT
• Save your video in high quality with captions burned in
• Share an SRT subtitle file for any platform or video editor
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Transcription, translation and dictation run on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded. Some languages need a one-time language pack download, then work offline.
Captions Pro lets you save and share your finished videos. Weekly and yearly plans available.

bluejetty:00068316:ios.summary:
Use a mobile device as a secure key
dormakaba BlueSky Access is a cloud-based mobile access key delivery system available for hotels and multifamily housing, student housing, market-rate apartments and senior living properties. It merges s
bluejetty:00068316:ios.description:
Use a mobile device as a secure key
dormakaba BlueSky Access is a cloud-based mobile access key delivery system available for hotels and multifamily housing, student housing, market-rate apartments and senior living properties. It merges security and convenience for the mobile minded traveler or dweller in order to enhance the access experience.
The delivery of a key to a mobile device (phone, tablet) is enabled via LEGIC Connect, a service that operates in a highly-secure and scalable data center.
Once notification has been received and the BlueSky Access app has been installed, the mobile access key is sent to the app on that mobile device, allowing entry to those doors or areas access to which authorization has been given.
The BlueSky Access app is available for use only in properties equipped with dormakaba contactless electronic locks that have been equipped with a dormakaba Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) radio antenna.
Hotels
With the BlueSky Access app on a mobile device, guests can bypass the front desk check-in process and go directly to their room as well as gaining access to any authorized common area in the hotel requiring a room key. 
Residence
With the BlueSky Access app on a mobile device, residents can securely lock and unlock unit doors and other amenity areas within a property to which authorization to enter has been given.
About dormakaba Group
dormakaba is one of the top three companies in the global market for access and security solutions. With strong brands such as Dorma and Kaba in our portfolio, we are a single source for products, solutions, and services related to doors and secure access to buildings and rooms. With around 16,000 employees and numerous cooperation partners, we are active in over 130 countries. dormakaba is headquartered in Rümlang (Zurich/Switzerland) and generates an annual turnover of over CHF 2 billion. 
Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) technology enables the issuance and management of secure mobile access keys for hotels, multihousing, student and senior living properties. dormakaba’s latest RFID door locks and other access controls are BlueSky Access enabled. They can be installed on a variety of door types and locations giving properties a flexible, secure choice of entry options. 
BLE-enabled door locks and access controls allow an authorized user to place a compatible mobile device (smartphone, tablet) with the BlueSky Access app near a corresponding sensor on the door lock. The sensor reads the BlueSky Access key, the lock system communicates with the property management network, and determines whether the unique, encrypted code conveyed by the phone is on an approved "pass" list. If so, access is allowed, and the entry is recorded for audit purposes.

bluejetty:00182772:ios.summary: Dive into an open world of building, crafting and survival. Gather resources, survive the night, and build whatever you can imagine one block at a time. Explore and craft your way through a completely open world where you can play with frie
bluejetty:00182772:ios.description:
Dive into an open world of building, crafting and survival. Gather resources, survive the night, and build whatever you can imagine one block at a time. Explore and craft your way through a completely open world where you can play with friends, build a city, start a farm, mine deep into the ground, face mysterious enemies, or just experiment to the limits of your imagination! 
The possibilities are endless. Embark on an epic adventure and play with friends, building from the ground up. Build and expand in Creative mode, where you can craft from unlimited resources. Survive the night, face intense battles, craft tools, and fend off danger in Survival mode. With seamless cross-platform and multiplayer gameplay on Minecraft: Bedrock Edition, you can adventure solo or with friends, and discover an infinite, randomly generated world filled with blocks to mine, biomes to explore, and mobs to befriend (or battle)! 
In Minecraft, the world is yours to shape! 
CREATE YOUR WORLD 
• Build anything from the ground up 
• Craft from special resources and tools to create brand new structures and landscapes 
• Explore an endless open world full of different biomes and creatures 
• Minecraft Marketplace – Get creator-made add-ons, thrilling worlds, and stylish cosmetics on Minecraft Marketplace 
• Connect with millions of players on community servers, or subscribe to Realms Plus to cross-play with up to 10 friends on your own private server 
• Slash commands – Tweak how the game plays: you can change the weather, summon mobs, change the time of day, and more 
• Add-ons – Customize your experience even further with add-ons! If you're more tech-inclined, you can modify your game to create new resource packs 
MULTIPLAYER ONLINE GAMES 
• Join free massive multiplayer servers and play with thousands of others 
• Multiplayer servers allow you to play with up to 4 players online with a free Xbox Live account 
• Build, battle and explore other realms. With Realms and Realms Plus, you can play with up to 10 friends cross-platform, anytime, anywhere on Realms, your own private server that we host for you 
• With Realms Plus, get instant access to over 150 Marketplace items with new additions each month. Share with friends on your own private Realms server* 
• Connect and play with players across the world, wherever they are, and join in on MMO battles for survival in other worlds 
• Discover gigantic community-run worlds, compete in unique mini-games and socialize in lobbies full of fellow Minecrafters 
SUPPORT: https://www.minecraft.net/help 
LEARN MORE: https://www.minecraft.net/ 
Here are the links to our Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions:
Privacy Policy: https://www.minecraft.net/privacy/gdpr
Terms and Conditions: https://account.mojang.com/terms
MINIMUM RECOMMENDED SPECIFICATION 
To check the requirements for your device visit: https://help.minecraft.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409172223501 
*Realms & Realms Plus: Try a free 30-day trial in-app. 
Minecraft may request the following optional permissions, which require your consent. You can continue to use Minecraft without granting these permissions; however, some features may be limited or unavailable.
For more information, please see below:
• Local Network: To find other devices on the same Wi‑Fi network for multiplayer gameplay.
• App Tracking: To deliver personalized ads and improve application experience

bluejetty:00159338:ios.summary: Introducing Sporttrade. Sporttrade isn't a sportsbook: it's a marketplace. Participants buy and sell listed contracts on a central limit order book. Fair, efficient, transparent. Now available in New Jersey, Arizona, Virginia, Colorado, and
bluejetty:00159338:ios.description:
Introducing Sporttrade. Sporttrade isn't a sportsbook: it's a marketplace. Participants buy and sell listed contracts on a central limit order book. Fair, efficient, transparent. Now available in New Jersey, Arizona, Virginia, Colorado, and Iowa! New users can earn 10% cash back in their first week with code BEST.
With Sporttrade, trade the flow of the game, not just the final result. Once you try it, you’ll never go back. It’s going to change the way you think about sports!
This is how you trade the flow of the game:
PLACE YOUR TRADE
The Packers are offered at a 30% chance to beat the Lions. A 30% price means every $30 contract you trade pays $100. So let's say you get a $30 position on the Packers.
TRACK YOUR POSITION
Each play on the field in the Packers/Lions will cause the Sporttrade market to move the Packers % chance to win up or down. Track it by tapping on your portfolio, then tapping on your Packers position.
SELL YOUR POSITION
The Packers are winning into the fourth quarter, and the Sporttrade market has them at 70% chance to win. Tap Sell, then “Sell all contracts” to cashout! Or, of course wait until the end of the game to have your position payout $100.
YOU CAN’T DO THIS ANYWHERE ELSE
You may be asking yourself, can’t I trade the Packers and then cash them out at a normal sportsbook? 
You can, but you won’t make nearly as much money. Here’s why:
Our prices are significantly better. On average, our markets have HALF the spread of a normal sportsbook. Sportsbooks screw you on cashouts, we don’t. On Sporttrade, you SEE the value of your cashout (such as “80% chance to win). Sportsbooks add extra fees to cashout offers, making Sporttrade’s SELL feature 2-3x better for you! You can ask for a better price**. No one else has this feature. Asking for a better price is easy, and it keeps the market in balance to ensure you get fair prices: “I wouldn’t sell the Packers at 70%, but I’d sell them at 75%”.
WHAT SPORTS CAN I DO THIS FOR?
You can live trade anything on Sporttrade: moneylines, spreads, totals, even player props! That’s right, trade Steph to score 5+ threes at 30% pregame, then sell at 50% after the first quarter after he scores two quick three pointers!
• NFL trading
• Golf trading
• NBA trading
• NHL trading
• MLB trading
• College Basketball/Football trading
• F1 trading
• UFC trading

bluejetty:00033066:ios.description:
Welcome to Match Rush 3D: ASMR Care, a relaxing puzzle experience combining sensory satisfaction, 3D sorting, and intriguing narratives! Run various themed shops, enjoy the tactile fun of matching 3D goods in a soothing ASMR environment, and discover the secrets behind the stores.
How to Play
Explore Hidden Plots: Progress through levels and upgrade your shops to unlock a variety of rich, hidden storylines.
Serve Customers: Check incoming orders and locate the requested items within a large pile of 3D objects.
Untangle the Pile: Goods are randomly stacked using realistic physics. Move top-layer items carefully to reveal and reach the products hidden at the bottom. 
Clear and Relax: Fulfill all orders with accurate taps to completely empty the box, enjoying a highly satisfying clearing process.
Game Features
Unlock Narratives: Blends casual hidden-object gameplay with story exploration, making every level rewarding.
Soothing ASMR Vibe: Crisp tapping and collision sound effects make every matching action relaxing and satisfying.
Diverse Shop Themes: Discover unique 3D items across different environments, from modern supermarkets to cozy cafes. 
Download Match Rush 3D: ASMR Care to enjoy the satisfying rush of 3D sorting and uncover all the hidden stories!

Math 24 - Challenge 24 Puzzle is a classical math puzzle game. The mental card puzzle game can help people improve arithmetic abilities and train sharp minds. The puzzles varied from the easiest to the hardest.

bluejetty:00021256:ios.name: LastPass Authenticator
bluejetty:00021256:ios.summary: LastPass Authenticator offers effortless two-factor authentication for your LastPass account and other supported apps. With one-tap verification and secure cloud backup, LastPass Authenticator gives you all the security, without any of the
bluejetty:00021256:ios.description:
LastPass Authenticator offers effortless two-factor authentication for your LastPass account and other supported apps. With one-tap verification and secure cloud backup, LastPass Authenticator gives you all the security, without any of the frustration. 
ADD MORE SECURITY 
Safeguard your LastPass account by requiring two-factor authentication codes when signing in. Two-factor authentication improves your digital security by protecting your account with an additional login step. Even if your password is compromised, your account can’t be accessed without the two-factor authentication code. 
You can even mark a device as “trusted”, so you won’t be prompted for codes on that device while your account remains protected by two-factor authentication. 
TURNING IT ON 
To turn on LastPass Authenticator for your LastPass account: 
1. Download LastPass Authenticator to your mobile device. 
2. Log in to LastPass on your computer and launch “Account Settings” from your vault. 
3. In “Multifactor Options”, edit LastPass Authenticator and view the barcode. 
4. Scan the barcode with the LastPass Authenticator app. 
5. Set your preferences and save your changes. 
LastPass Authenticator can also be turned on for any service or app that supports Google Authenticator or TOTP-based two-factor authentication.
LOGGING IN 
To login to your LastPass account or other supported vendor service: 
1. Open the app to generate a 6-digit, 30-second code OR approve/deny an automated push notification 
2. Alternatively, send SMS code 
3. Enter the code into the login prompt on your device OR hit approve/deny request 
FEATURES 
- Generates 6-digit codes every 30 seconds 
- Push notifications for one-tap approval
- Free encrypted backup to restore your tokens on a new/reinstalled device 
- Support for SMS codes 
- Automated set-up via QR code 
- Support for LastPass accounts 
- Support for other TOTP-compatible services and apps (including any that support Google Authenticator) 
- Add multiple accounts

bluejetty:00043219:ios.description:
4 Pics 1 Word is a free game in English where you have to solve puzzles by finding a word from 4 pictures. If you're a fan of word games, love beautiful photos and solving puzzles, this game in English is for you.
It's ideal for relaxing in the evening or passing the time on your commute. You can play without a connection.
Important: This word game was entirely designed in English. Unlike most games of the type 4 Pics 1 Word or Guess the Word, it has not been translated from another language. That's why all the puzzles are coherent and designed in English.
-The principle (main game 4 Pics 1 Word)
In each level, you will be shown 4 pictures. You'll have to guess the word associated with these pictures. The letters on the keyboard and the number of letters in the answer space will help you find the solution to the puzzle.
-Free hints
Finding a word with letters isn't always easy. That's why each game earns you hints, which you can use to reveal a letter when you need one.
-Difficulty management
To keep an educational side, several levels of difficulty are available. In difficult mode, you might even learn new words!
What's more, as this type of game can sometimes seem easy or even boring in the long run, we've added:
-Alternative modes (described below), A movement mechanic that makes the game more strategic.
This forces you to make your mind work harder on each puzzle. Stay focused so you don't lose!
-Variety
In this brain and logic game, you'll have several types of puzzles always based on pictures:
-Classic: The traditional 4 Pics 1 Word puzzles: 4 pictures must guide you to the solution. The difficulty can be adjusted for more of a challenge.
-Shadows: First type of bonus level: you'll have to imagine what's hiding behind a shadow.
-Zooms: Being smart isn't always enough! Sometimes you also have to be imaginative. Here, you'll have to guess the name of the object that has been zoomed in on.
-The Intruder: This bonus is similar to the classic 4 Pics 1 Word mode. But here, there are 4 pictures and you have to find the one that doesn't fit.
-Quiz: A multiplayer general knowledge game. Answer questions and take on other players online!
-Daily challenges: Every day, a mini-logic game allows you to earn free tokens.
-Celebrity quiz: Guess which personality has been caricatured. Here, you don't have to find a word but the person's name.
-The brands game: Guess which famous and well-known brand is represented.
In summary:
-Simple and fun
-100% English
-Free game, nothing to pay to complete it
-Over 1000 puzzles and brainteasers with bonuses
-Playable without connection
-An educational game
-Get your brain working in a fun way
-A movement mechanic that makes the game more strategic
-Suitable for children, adults, and the whole family
-Hints so you never get stuck
-Several types of logic puzzles (quizzes, riddles, general knowledge, etc.)
Download our game now and play for free!

bluejetty:00013969:ios.description:
-=- Build Wealth in Real Estate, Fractionally. -=-
Concreit makes real estate investing available to everyone. Sit back and let your money produce a passive income stream for you with our flagship Cash Flow strategy and craft your own portfolio by buying shares on individual rental properties. Build your own diversified portfolio of real estate assets managed by a professional investment team. Invest any amount to get started and grow your account by setting up auto-investments or a financial goal.
-=- Not crypto. Not stocks. Just Real Estate -=-
Reduce your volatility and hedge inflation with real estate. This asset class has been used as a strategy to counter inflation for wealthy investors and now you can do it too. Concreit is an easy-to-use app that gives investors the ability to find passive income outside of publicly traded markets.
-=- Boost your payout with rewards -=-
Earn rewards to accelerate your long-term investment plan through enhanced payouts. Rewards are automatically added to your dividends and can potentially boost your payout rate by up to 1% annualized until they are fully paid out.
* Rewards cannot be directly withdrawn or redeemed for cash.
-=- Flexible for the type of investor you are -=-
We get that life has unique demands and stuff happens. Pull together a mix between more liquid investments and longer-term investments that are right for you.
We’ve made private real estate investing more flexible with our Cash Flow debt strategy. You can schedule & request withdrawals from our Cash Flow strategy anytime through our app, which is based on approval & fund availability. Easy as that.
For your long-term investment dollars, you can purchase shares of individual rental homes and build your own unique diversified portfolio.
-=- Put your money on a mission -=-
We’re building easy solutions so you can invest towards retirement, take that trip of a lifetime, buy a home, save for a kid’s education, or anything else!
-=- Professional management with over $30b of experience -=-
Access to a private market real estate investment team shouldn't be limited to the wealthy. We’re leveraging a proprietary full-stack real estate technology platform to make data-driven decisions combined with proprietary connections and experience for you.
-=- Bank-level Security -=-
Concreit uses AES256-bit encryption for your personal data, the same security level as banks. Your investor information is encrypted.
-=- Disclosures -=-
Investing in real estate involves risks including the potential loss of principal. A real estate portfolio is subject to risks similar to those associated with the direct ownership of real estate and real estate debt, as the investments are sensitive to factors such as changes to real estate values and property taxes, interest rates, cash flow of underlying real estate assets, supply and demand, and the management skill and credit worthiness of the issuer & borrowers. Portfolios concentrated in real estate assets may experience price volatility and other risks associated with non-diversification. There is no guarantee that investment objectives will be achieved, and past performance does not indicate future results. For a more complete list of risks, please refer to our website.
Incredibly Easy Real Estate® in the app screenshots refers to the ease of use of the mobile application and the platform and does not infer that private real estate investing is easy or simple. Your investments with Concreit are actively managed by a team of industry professionals. 
Liquidity Not Guaranteed: Investments offered are illiquid and there is never any guarantee that you will be able to exit your investments through our redemption program.
Visit concreit.com for additional documents, such as legal terms.

Our app is updated regularly to ensure that you have access to the latest cases and weapons in the game. We strive to provide the most realistic and accurate simulation of the actual game experience.

bluejetty:00200199:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00200199:ios.description:
Ripple Player is a record player for the albums in your Apple Music library. Albums, front to back.
Your whole albums stand on a shelf as record spines, each one made from its own sleeve. Pull one out, put it on, and it plays from the first track to the last, with nothing queued up behind it. No shuffle, no playlists, no feed.
PUT A RECORD ON
• The arm moves across the record as it plays, so you can see how far in you are.
• Lift the needle and set it down on another track.
• When the album ends, the needle settles into the run-out groove and the arm goes home.
TURN IT OVER FOR THE TRACKS
Tap the playing sleeve and it turns over to its back: the track list, set like a real sleeve. Ten tracks or sixty, the back always fits.
ONLY WHOLE ALBUMS
Your shelf holds the albums you've saved in full. Save a whole album, or add one straight from Ripple Player's search, and it takes its place on the shelf. A switch in Settings shows singles and part-saved albums too.
WATER THAT HEARS THE MUSIC
The turntable floats on dark water, with your shelf reflected on the surface. If you let it, the water ripples with the music, listening only while a record plays. Nothing is recorded and nothing leaves your phone.
MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
Open it like a laptop: the shelf stands up, the turntable lies flat, and the water reflects your records as the hinge moves. Close it on the record and it keeps playing under a glass lid. It works on every iPhone too.
YOURS ALONE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Ripple Player collects no data.
Works with Apple Music only. An Apple Music subscription is needed to play most albums.
Apple and Apple Music are trademarks of Apple Inc., registered in the U.S. and other countries.

bluejetty:00141366:ios.description:
Use Gym Plan for faster gains and unstoppable progress. Never worry about structuring your gym routines ever again. Remove the hassle and doubt from your workout planning and tracking. 
You start by picking a workout plan or choosing one we recommend for you. Maybe you want weights & cardio, bodybuilding or to target just legs and glutes. We’ve got it all, every style of training grouped in the extensive categories.
When you go to the gym your workout is ready to start. Track your weights, sets and reps. We time rest periods for best performance. What’s more, you can modify the workouts to suit your preferences or quickly adapt to what’s happening in your gym. Often a machine is in use or you want to add extra exercises. Whatever happens we’ve got you covered.
Say goodbye to boring routines and hello to exciting, challenging workouts that crush your goals! 
KEY FEATURES
----------------
TAILORED
Whether you want to target specific muscle groups, improve your fitness, or try something new, Gym Plan will has workouts for your goals. See them all grouped in the extensive categories, such as Weights & Cardio, Bodybuilding, Transformations, Legs & Glutes and many more.
CUSTOMISABLE
You can modify an existing programme to suit your personal tastes. Maybe you prefer one exercise over another or want to add an extra exercise. Imagine our workouts as your professional blueprint! Saving you endless time planning from scratch. Have the confidence it will work yet know it can be changed to match your needs perfectly.
WORKOUT PLANS
Get recommended plans to match your needs and discover a vast collection of meticulously designed workouts tailored to different fitness levels and goals. From strength training and cardio to HIIT and flexibility exercises, Gym Plan has something for everyone. Say goodbye to monotonous routines and hello to exciting, challenging workouts! 
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
Keep tabs on your workout performance and witness your growth firsthand. Gym Plan lets you easily track your exercises, sets, and reps, allowing you to monitor your progress over time. Watch as your strength and endurance skyrocket, and stay motivated by celebrating every milestone you achieve.
PERSONAL BESTS
Push your limits and set new personal records with Gym Plan. Track the weights you lift and the calories you burn. As you consistently beat your previous achievements, you'll experience the satisfaction of knowing that you're making significant strides toward a fitter, stronger you.
STAY MOTIVATED
We understand the importance of motivation in reaching your fitness goals. That's why Gym Plan offers a variety of training styles to keep you inspired. Plus, chat live with our team who provide support every step of the way.
Note: Gym Plan requires a subscription to unlock all features and access our premium workout library.
APPLE HEALTH
Sync your workouts and Personal Health Record with Apple Health (activate in Settings > Preferences). HealthKit is turned off by default.
SUBSCRIPTION - with Family Sharing for up to 6 people!
If you decide to subscribe you will pay the price set for your country, as shown in the app. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
CANCELLING
You can cancel your subscription from the Account screen. If you cancel 24 hours before an introductory trial is over then you will not be charged. If you cancel during the month period for which you've already paid (up to 24 hours before the next period starts), your subscription will continue until the end of that period. Subscriptions can be managed by you and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
https://gymplanapp.com/terms

bluejetty:00045932:ios.description:
CLARA: Level Up Your Love Life
Date intentionally with Clara, the first ever gamified relationship management tool that takes the anxiety and weight out of modern dating. 
WE BELIEVE THAT THE PEOPLE YOU CHOOSE TO BE IN RELATIONSHIPS WITH IMPACTS YOUR MENTAL, PHYSICAL, EMOTIONAL HEALTH AND WELL-BEING. 
Today’s dating world can feel overwhelming, lonely, and downright depressing. Clara for Daters is here to help you learn to choose relationships that are good for you. 
What You’re Doing. 
Making a consistent effort to date. 
Reflecting honestly on your dates. 
Dropping relationships that waste your time or are not good for you.
What Clara Does for You. 
Gives you the dating feedback you crave to help guide your dating journey. 
Keeps you honest with psychologist-designed questions. 
Keeps you organized by scoring your prospects. 
Gives you your own personal Clara Card that you can share and use as a referral tool for high value prospects within your own communities. 
Free to Download for Everyone. 
Premium features may be introduced in the future. 
100% Women & Minority Owned 
The Backstory: 
Our founder is a corporate leader turned love scientist who has always been business smart but romantically challenged. Jillian was determined to get back into the dating world after recovering from a traumatic breakup when she lost all faith in her ability to pursue healthy relationships. So she raised some money and built Clara to help her and others who are struggling in their dating lives. Join our Clara for Daters Facebook community of Intentional Daters to hear how she is not letting rejection get in her way as a thirty something looking for a healthy relationship OR as a female minority in the VC space.
Support: support@clarafordaters.com
Feedback: feedback@clarafordaters.com
Terms and conditions: https://www.clarafordaters.com/terms-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://www.clarafordaters.com/privacy-policy
FAQ: https://www.clarafordaters.com/faq

bluejetty:00100514:ios.description:
Smart Jigsaw Fun: For Every Age, Every Moment!
Rediscover the joy of jigsaw puzzles with a creative, strategic twist! Become a master of piece-matching as you turn scattered shape fragments into stunning complete images—all while sharpening your mind and exploring the world.
Whether you’re killing time on the commute, relaxing at home, or looking for a brain-boosting activity for the whole family, Jigmerge Puzzles delivers endless fun tailored just for you!
GAME FEATURES
● Innovative jigsaw gameplay: 
 Observe clues in shape fragments, merge adjacent pieces into larger blocks, and complete beautiful images—blocks can split and recombine for extra challenge, so plan your moves wisely!
● 20,000+ handpicked images:
 Dive into a vast collection spanning portraits, cute animals, breathtaking landscapes, incredible architecture, elegant art, and more—something for every taste!
● Daily Challenges & monthly rewards:
 Keep the excitement going with daily puzzles, and unlock exclusive monthly prizes that celebrate your progress!
● World exploration & culture:
 Collect famous landmarks from across the globe, and learn fascinating facts about local customs and cultures as you play!
● On-the-go optimized:
 Designed specifically for mobile life—enjoy a quick puzzle session anytime, anywhere, no matter where your day takes you!
● Senior-friendly & brain-boosting:
 Gentle gameplay that’s easy for older players to navigate, while helping strengthen cognitive function and keep the brain active and sharp.
Why You’ll Love Jigmerge Puzzles
● A unique take on classic jigsaw puzzles that blends strategy, observation, and relaxation!
● Stunning visuals and smooth animations that bring every puzzle to life.
● Regular updates with fresh images, new events, and exciting features to keep you engaged.
● Perfect for all ages—from kids learning problem-solving to seniors seeking mental stimulation, and casual players craving relaxation.

bluejetty:00161287:ios.description:
CoinGlass is an all-in-one global market data and analytics platform, providing real-time data, professional charts, and market data tools for stocks, cryptocurrencies, macroeconomics, commodities, ETFs, indices, and derivatives markets.
Whether you follow traditional financial markets or crypto markets, CoinGlass allows you to view important market changes and real-time data.
Main Features:
1. Global Market Data
 Real-time prices and market data for stocks, cryptocurrencies, commodities, ETFs, indices, and other global market assets.
2. Crypto Derivatives Data
 Data on Open Interest, Funding Rates, Liquidations, Long/Short Ratios, Trading Volume, and other key derivatives market indicators.
3. Liquidation & Liquidity Data
 Liquidation Heatmaps, Liquidation Maps, and related data for visualizing market liquidity and price distribution.
4. Capital Flow Data
 Data on ETF flows, exchange fund movements, and other relevant market metrics.
5. Stocks & Traditional Financial Markets
 Market data for U.S. stocks, company data, ETFs, major indices, and other related market information.
6. Macroeconomic Data
 Key global macroeconomic indicators and related market data.
7. Professional Charts & Data Tools
 Candlestick charts, technical indicators, order flow data, and a variety of market data visualizations.
8. Price & Market Alerts
 Customizable price and market data alerts to help you stay updated on changes in the assets you follow.
CoinGlass is committed to making complex global financial market data clear, intuitive, and easy to access through data and charts.

bluejetty:00129605:ios.summary: It's time to beat your friends in mini-games playing at the same time on the same device. Senior Games presents you this compilation of quick games for 1 2 3 4 people. 2 players, 3 players and up to 4 players at a time can enjoy a unique mu
bluejetty:00129605:ios.description:
It's time to beat your friends in mini-games playing at the same time on the same device. Senior Games presents you this compilation of quick games for 1 2 3 4 people. 2 players, 3 players and up to 4 players at a time can enjoy a unique multiplayer experience.
Fun is assured with this collection of party mini-games to play on the same mobile or tablet several friends. Start the battle of 2 players, 3 players or up to 4 players. Have a great time with competitive multiplayer games. Many games in one and all you need is a smartphone or tablet and you can play offline.
In the cool multiplayer games from the party games collection you can play with two players, but if you have more friends or family and you are many players you can challenge 3 players or 4 players. Have fun with this competitive multiplayer game. For those times when you are alone, play in 1 player mode against the bot and improve your skills to become the best. You don't need an internet connection to play. Play offline for free!
All the party games and fun pastimes in this board game have simple controls and simple rules that are easy to understand. Party games is ideal for people of all ages; the very young, adults and even senior players. With 2 3 4 players of any age, fun is guaranteed. Let the party begin!
TYPES OF PARTY GAMES FOR 1 2 3 4 PLAYERS
Within this collection of socialization games you will find different challenges. All are two player games and have extra modes for 3 and 4 players. Challenge your friends or compete against your family now! 
- Free Fall
- Crazy Traffic
- Black Hole
- King of the island 
- Broken Platforms
- Jumping party
- Dance battle
- Duck water
- Sink in style
PARTY MODE 
Party mode for 1234 players is a combination of games from the different games that appear in the application. 2 players, 3 players or a group of up to 4 players can compete in Party mode. A perfect option for those who like to try all the games and want to play with friends. Roll the dice, advance on the board and win the challenges - the winner of the competition will be the player who reaches the end of the course first!
GAME MODES
In this multiplayer game, the more people you play with, the more fun the games are. But if you don't have anyone to play with, or you prefer to play against the bots, you can also play alone in the 1 player mode. 
- 1 player: if you want to play alone, this is your ideal option. You will have to face the AI and compete against it. It is an ideal way to improve your skills so you can beat your friends when you play with them later.
- Multiplayer mode for 2 3 4 players: with this offline competitive multiplayer mode you can play Party with many friends at the same time on the same smartphone or tablet. You can play with one more person in 2 player mode, with 3 players if you are 3 friends and in 4 player mode if you want to play as a group with 4 people.
FEATURES 
- Multiplayer game for 1234 players.
- Multiplayer fun for people of all ages.
- Available in different languages.
- Offline and totally free
- Fun and addictive!
ABOUT SENIOR GAMES - TELLMEWOW
Senior Games is a project of Tellmewow, a mobile game development company specialized in easy adaptation and basic usability which makes them ideal for seniors or young people who simply want to play an occasional game without major complications. If you have any suggestions for improvement or want to stay informed about upcoming games that we will publish, follow us on our social networks.
@seniorgames_tmw

bluejetty:00153027:ios.description:
Welcome to the enchanting world of Dragon's Gold Slots, where each spin holds the promise of excitement and unexpected delights!
Game Features：
·Exquisite Graphics and Immersive Soundscapes
Adorned with resplendent red and gold hues, Dragon's Gold Slots conjures an air of opulence and good fortune. The magnificent golden dragon at the heart of the screen is brought to life with astonishing detail, and the accompanying sound effects are so vivid that they draw you right into the action, creating an immersive experience like no other.
·Diverse Gameplay with Multiple Reward Layers
There are three distinct reward levels: the highly coveted GRAND, the substantial MAJOR, and the rewarding MINI. The bonus reward springs into action when the progress bar reaches its maximum. A variety of in - game mechanisms are in place, ensuring that every moment is filled with anticipation as you spin the reels.
·Stunning Visual Effects and Dynamic Displays
The game's effect system is truly remarkable. When rewards and bonuses are triggered, a dazzling array of visual effects lights up the screen, and dynamic elements are seamlessly integrated, intensifying the overall impact of the game and making each win feel truly special.
·User - Friendly Interface and Smooth Operation
The interface of Dragon's Gold Slots is designed with the player in mind. It has a clear and uncluttered layout, making it easy for you to navigate. The operation is simple and intuitive, and the game runs smoothly without any lag, allowing you to fully enjoy the thrill of spinning the reels with ease.
Embark on this lucky odyssey with the golden dragon in Dragon's Gold Slots and unlock a world of surprises and rewards that await you at every turn!

bluejetty:00131931:ios.description:
** Fully updated to reflect the recently published DSM-5-TR®**
** Diagnose with Confidence Using The Interactive Decision Trees On All Devices Including The Apple Watch®**
ABOUT DSM-5-TR® DIFFERENTIAL DIAGNOSIS HANDBOOK
All clinicians are trained to make accurate diagnoses. Beginning with the patient’s presenting symptoms, they ultimately narrow down multiple options to one condition. The DSM-5-TR Differential Diagnosis Handbook can play a critical role in this process by improving the diagnostic process of psychiatric conditions. Leveraging latest DSM-5-TR classifications from the American Psychiatric Association, users are able to use a trusted 6-step process when dealing with, sometimes unfamiliar, psych conditions. 
Exclusive, integrated interactive decision trees provide a step-by-step process of asking yes or no questions to find a tentative diagnosis. When the initial diagnosis is reached, tables of differential diagnoses are presented to help confirm or present new options. 
FEATURES
• Interactive decision trees for narrowing down psychiatric diagnoses
• New feature allows for the review of your selected path through the decision tree
• Algorithms for enhanced assessment
• The latest DSM-5-TR classifications and ICD-10 codes
• Helpful tables of differential diagnoses
• Detailed entries featuring definitions for each psychiatric condition
• Expansive guidance on all 6 steps of the differential diagnosis process 
• Advanced Search to help find topics quickly 
• “Favorites” for bookmarking important entries
Author: Michael B. First, MD
Publisher: American Psychiatric Association Publishing
Powered by: Unbound Medicine
Unbound Privacy Policy: www.unboundmedicine.com/privacy
Unbound Terms of Use: https://www.unboundmedicine.com/end_user_license_agreement

bluejetty:00019208:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00019208:ios.description:
Always solvable! A MahjongSolitaire puzzle with no dead ends!
Simple yet deep. A classic solitaire-style game that trains your brain and lets you enjoy a relaxing challenge.
The tiles are not placed randomly — every layout is designed to always have a solution.
With our unique difficulty settings, puzzles become more and more challenging as you level up.
The game comes with an auto-save feature.
Pause freely anytime, anywhere, and continue right where you left off.
Perfect for commuting, during breaks, or whenever you have a little free time.
■ What is MahjongSolitaire?
MahjongSolitaire is a single-player puzzle game where you remove tiles from a stacked layout by following simple rules.
■ HINT and UNDO
Each level allows you to use HINT and UNDO up to 3 times each.
They are helpful when you can’t find a pair or if you make a mistake.
Keep in mind, a HINT only shows available pairs and does not always guarantee a path to clear the puzzle.
■ Simple and Clear Design
Designed and optimized for vertical smartphone play, with carefully chosen tile size, colors, and shapes.
The clean and simple design makes it easy for anyone to enjoy.
■ Tips for Success
・At lower levels, you can clear puzzles without much planning.
・As you progress, learn the rules and challenge harder levels.
・Each tile type always has 4 copies. If you don’t see them, they may be hidden under other tiles.
・Even if you fail, the layout remains the same. Remember where you got stuck and use that knowledge to succeed next time.
Each tile appears 4 times. Always think ahead when choosing pairs — that’s the key to clearing the puzzle!

bluejetty:00140028:ios.description:
Welcome to Cozy Town, the ultimate casual city-building game that combines creativity with strategy! Create a peaceful, thriving town across beautiful islands, each offering unique landscapes and challenges. Best of all, you can build and manage your city completely offline!
Explore Multiple Islands 
From tranquil beaches to mountainous retreats, discover and develop new islands. Each one brings its own challenges as you expand your Cozy Town.
Build Your Cozy City
Design homes, workplaces, and entertainment spots to ensure your residents have everything they need to live happily. Manage jobs and resources while maintaining a harmonious lifestyle.
Balance Happiness & Productivity
Keep your citizens happy by balancing their work-life needs. Create jobs, manage growth, and ensure a bright future for all your residents.
Unlock New Buildings & Features
As your city grows, unlock advanced structures and fun decorations to make each island truly unique and cozy.
Play Anytime, Anywhere
No internet? No problem! You can build your Cozy Town offline and continue your progress whenever you're ready.
Casual Yet Engaging Gameplay
Perfect for those who want a laid-back yet thoughtful experience. Plan your city carefully, manage population growth, and watch your cozy town flourish.
Key Features:
* Build your cozy city across various islands.
* Play completely offline—no internet connection needed!
* Balance residents, jobs, and happiness for a thriving community.
* Explore different island environments with unique challenges.
* Unlock new buildings and decorations as your city grows.
* Relaxing gameplay with strategic elements to keep you engaged.
* Beautiful, calming visuals and sound design.
Ready to build the coziest city of your dreams? Download Cozy Town today and start building your peaceful paradise—offline or online! 
IGRS 3+

bluejetty:00067961:ios.description:

- 100+ different categories for your different moods
- Starts off easy but gets challenging fast

bluejetty:00186918:ios.summary:
Control interest-based advertising on apps on your mobile device.
AppChoices gives you transparency with participating companies, and lets you limit their collection of cross-app data for interest-based ads. Brought to you by the Digital A
bluejetty:00186918:ios.description:
Control interest-based advertising on apps on your mobile device.
AppChoices gives you transparency with participating companies, and lets you limit their collection of cross-app data for interest-based ads. Brought to you by the Digital Advertising Alliance, and backed up by the DAA’s independent accountability program, AppChoices lets you opt out from interest-based advertising with a particular company, or “Choose All Companies” with one simple click.
Did you know that some of the ads you receive in apps are customized based on predictions about your interests generated from your app usage? This is called interest-based advertising (IBA). AppChoices gives you choices about whether you receive this type of advertising that is based on cross-app data collected over time across different apps and devices. 
To opt out your device ID out of IBA from a particular company, simply navigate to Device ID-Based Choice tool and set the switch next to the company’s logo from “”ON” to “OFF”. AppChoices lets you decide which, if any, participating companies deliver interest-based advertising to your device.
Using the new Token ID-Based Choice (beta) tool, you can opt out or revoke having your data collected or used for IBA linked to the email address you provide.
When it comes to ads in your apps based on your interests, it’s your choice.
AppChoices también está disponible en español. Solo establece la configuración al idioma español.
You may still receive other types of advertising in your apps from participating DAA companies, and these companies (and other apps) may still collect information for other purposes consistent with the DAA Principles. You can learn more about these Principles and the DAA’s enforcement and accountability program by visiting www.aboutads.info/enforcement.
v2.2.0

bluejetty:00160675:ios.name: Unnamed Space Idle
bluejetty:00160675:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00160675:ios.description:
No ads! Destroy unending waves of alien ships in this long form, unfolding, sci-fi idler.
Unnamed Space Idle is an unfolding sci-fi idle game that plunges you into a relentless battle against an alien menace that has decimated humanity. 
Voted r/incremental_games "Best F2P game" 2024 & 2025.
Customize your ship with an array of progressively unlocked weapons and defenses, strategically tailored to counter specific enemy types. With a plethora of unfolding systems and abundant options, you'll face crucial choices as you steadily increase you power through progression and prestige.
A Myriad of Different Systems
Discover over 10 distinct systems, each offering unique mechanics that evolve and expand over time.
Core - Upgrade your Weapon, Defense and Utility cores with salvage gathered from enemies.
Compute - Improve your combat stats over time in traditional Idle Game fashion
Synth - Craft and improve modules and recipes to increase your power in various ways.
Void Device - Slot in void shards dropped by enemies for different combinations of upgrades.
Prestige - Unlock different ships, weapons, defenses and utilities.
Reactor - Feed void matter into your reactor to power various system boosts.
Research - Harness the research data obtained from different sectors to unlock various upgrades.
And More...
Impactful, Understandable Decisions
Choose wisely when equipping your ship with weapons and defenses, selecting power-altering modules, or determining the optimal combination of shards to use. The distinction between optimal and sub-optimal choices can significantly impact your progress. But while there are a lot of decisions to be made, they are all plainly understandable so that the optimum, or at least very near optimum decision making is within your grasp!
Consistent Progress and Unlocks
Well paced progression combined with the amount of different systems, upgrades and enemies, means something new is frequently just around the corner.

bluejetty:00078621:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00078621:ios.description:
BIENVENUE CHEZ SÉZANE 
Download the App, enable notifications, and be the first to discover news from Paris and exclusive early access to our Collections.
Sézane was the first French fashion brand to be created exclusively online. At its heart lies a simple yet profound obsession: to craft beautiful, high-quality creations at the fairest and most accessible prices—pieces with a French touch, made to last and be worn your way. Your Parisian Wardrobe. 
Each month brings a new Collection, with weekly arrivals and restocks twice a week at 9:30 AM CEST.
Delivery costs vary by country. Please check Sezane.com for more information. 
OUR COLLECTIONS
Choosing each detail with intention, refining every cut, and designing with timelessness in mind. 
For over 12 years, every piece has been shaped by thoughtful choices.
OUR COMMITMENTS 
Since 2018, Sézane has been supporting the social impact program DEMAIN* (tomorrow in French)
that partners with global charities to equalize access to fundamental rights through two monthly initiatives: 
- The Call of the 21st: On the 21st of each month, 100%
of the net sales profits from a dedicated Solidarity Piece**, plus 10% of the day’s global sales, are donated to the DEMAIN program to support organizations working to help children access education, culture, and leisure activities. 
- Pink Wednesday: On the first Wednesday of every month, 100% of the net sales profits from a Pink Creation, along with 10% of the day’s revenue from the current ‘Sézane Denim’ line, are donated to DEMAIN and distributed to organizations working to protect women’s health and rights. 
To learn more about the supported projects, visit demain-demain.com/en.
SÉZANE ESSENTIALS
The pieces that can be found in every French wardrobe and every Parisian street. The Essentials are Sézane’s most foundational designs—knowing no seasons or age. Designed to outlast fleeting trends, these pieces are available all year round on the App, toujours.
ACCESSORIES 
The finishing touch, reimagined. From iconic leather Bags and woven baskets to timeless Shoes and Jewelry, our Accessories are crafted to elevate the everyday. More than just an add-on, these heritage pieces can define the entire look.
GIFT CARDS
The classic gift of choice. Let them decide with our Sézane Gift Cards or E-Gift Cards, delivered straight to their inbox.
OUR LOCATIONS 
From our very first boutique on rue Sainte-Fiacre in Paris to the streets of New York City and London... Les Appartements were born from our desire to create a welcoming, intimate space to share our Parisian world with you. You can find the complete list of our locations here. 
And don’t forget our Conciergerie service, available in select Appartements: a free and easy way to pick up, try on, or return your online orders.
SECURE PAYMENT 
Sézane accepts payments by Visa, Mastercard, PayPal, Amex, Maestro, Sofort, and iDEAL. All payments are fully secured.
THE FASTEST WAY TO PARIS 
Have a question? We’re here for you at bonjour@sezane.com. For even more content with je ne sais quoi, follow us on Instagram and TikTok @sezane.

bluejetty:00036474:ios.name: Unjected — Unvaccinated Dating
bluejetty:00036474:ios.summary:
Unjected is the world’s first dating and community platform built for unvaccinated singles and those who value medical freedom, bodily autonomy, and natural health.
We launched in 2021 because we believed that people who share these values
bluejetty:00036474:ios.description:
Unjected is the world’s first dating and community platform built for unvaccinated singles and those who value medical freedom, bodily autonomy, and natural health.
We launched in 2021 because we believed that people who share these values deserve a space to find love, friendship, and community without judgment.
Five years later- independently owned, no venture capitalist money, no corporate agenda- we are still here.
FIND YOUR PEOPLE
Whether you are looking for love, friendship, or simply a community that gets it, Unjected is your home. Connect with like-minded singles and community members who share your values and your commitment to natural living.
WHAT YOU CAN DO ON UNJECTED
— Create a profile and connect with unvaccinated singles near you
— Browse and match with people who share your values
— Message your matches and build real connections
— Join a growing community of people who refused to disappear
OUR STORY
Unjected was born out of necessity. When the world divided, we built a place for the people who were left out.
We have always been grassroots, always been independent, and we have always put our community first.
A full rebuild of the Unjected platform is currently underway.
We are working hard to bring you a faster, safer, spam free, and better experience very soon.
Thank you for your patience and your loyalty, it means everything to our small team.
SUPPORT
Experiencing issues? Please reach out to us at support@unjected.com and we will take care of you personally.
If Unjected has brought you a connection, a friendship, or just a place where you finally felt like you belonged - please consider leaving us a positive review.
It helps more people find their people.
Still natural. Still free. Still Unjected.

bluejetty:00061185:ios.summary:
The ORIGINAL coloring book! Join over 25 million users in a relaxing experience. Paint mandalas, patterns, animals, florals, and thematic images from our artists - or upload your own drawings and give them even more life!
The new AR virtua
bluejetty:00061185:ios.description:
The ORIGINAL coloring book! Join over 25 million users in a relaxing experience. Paint mandalas, patterns, animals, florals, and thematic images from our artists - or upload your own drawings and give them even more life!
The new AR virtual gallery lets you visualize your drawings in the real world, as if they were a painting on your wall!
Colorfy also offers a "draw mandala" mode - with a few swipes, create beautiful mandalas! Let your imagination run wild.
Features:
- 1000+ pictures to paint: mandalas, florals, animals, patterns, cats, gardens, famous paintings and more.
- Easy to color: choose your color palette and tap to color. 
- Select from different brush types for advanced effects.
- The best rated coloring app: over a million 5 star ratings!
- Get inspired by the community - view and share drawings with people from around the world
- Easily share your drawings in your favorite social network
- Optimized for the newest iPhones
- Works offline! No wifi needed!
- Paint your own drawings! Draw on paper, take a picture of it, and give it the colors it deserves.
- Draw your own mandalas with an innovative new mode!
- The new AR virtual gallery lets you visualize your drawings in the real world, as if they were a painting on your wall!
Colorfy Plus subscription
- You can subscribe for new weekly updates (every week, new images will be available for download)
- All prices are subject to change without notification. We occasionally run promotion prices as incentives or limited time opportunities for qualifying purchases made during the promotional time period. Due to the time sensitive and promotional nature of these events, we are unable to offer price protection or retroactive discounts or refunds for previous purchases in the event of a price reduction or promotional offering.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- You will be able to color all available images for the duration of the subscription
- Subscription automatically renews for the same price and duration period as the original "one week"/"one month"/"one year" package unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the cost of the chosen package (weekly, monthly or yearly package)
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's iTunes Account Settings after purchase
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period
- You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription setting through your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged. Please visit http://support.apple.com/kb/ht4098 for more information
- You may turn off the auto-renewal of your subscription via your iTunes Account Settings. However, you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period
- Any unused portion of a free-trial period, will be forfeited when the user purchases a Colorfy Plus subscription
Links to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy can be found below
Privacy Policy: https://wildlifestudios.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://wildlifestudios.com/terms-of-service/
* Prices are equal to the value that "Apple's App Store Pricing Matrix" determines as the equivalent of the subscription price in $ USD

Procurando promoções e produtos baratos? No Promobit você encontra! O Promobit é uma rede social de promoções que te ajuda a comprar na internet com segurança.
A rede social é formada por três ideais para ajudar o consumidor a economizar na internet:
- Preço Baixo: Promoções de verdade verificadas uma a uma;
- Segurança: Apenas lojas confiáveis avaliadas por especialistas;
- Comunidade: Opiniões sinceras de pessoas reais que usam o aplicativo.
Encontre no Promobit promoções e ofertas das maiores marcas do Brasil, dentre elas: Amazon, Mercado Livre, Shopee, AliExpress, Lojas Americanas, Magazine Luiza, Centauro, Carrefour, Natura, Dafiti, Fast Shop, Kanui, Netshoes, Steam e muito mais!

bluejetty:00165958:ios.description:
RaMusi is the ultimate offline music player designed for music enthusiasts who love to discover, rate, and organize their favorite tunes. With RaMusi, you can enjoy your personalized music library anytime, anywhere, even without an internet connection. RaMusi allows you to rate and score your tracks, adding a unique touch to your music management.
Key Features of RaMusi:
- Rate and Score: Create a personalized ranking system by rating each song based on your preferences, allowing you to organize your library accordingly.
- Offline Music Player: Listen to your favorite tracks without the need for an internet connection. Enjoy uninterrupted music on the go.
- Upload Your Favorites: Easily upload and store your favorite music tracks within the app, keeping all your cherished songs in one convenient place.
- Music Collection: Build a comprehensive collection of your favorite tracks, sorted by your ratings. Effortlessly discover new favorites and revisit old ones.
- User-Friendly Interface: Enjoy a seamless and intuitive experience with RaMusi’s easy-to-use interface. Uploading, rating, and managing your music has never been simpler.
RaMusi is perfect for those who want to elevate their music experience with offline listening and personalized music management. Download RaMusi now and start building your personalized music library today!

bluejetty:00015688:ios.name: SharkSmart
bluejetty:00015688:ios.developer: NSW Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development
bluejetty:00015688:ios.summary:
Enjoy NSW beaches. Be SharkSmart.
The NSW Government’s SharkSmart app helps you stay informed before you hit the water in NSW. The app is part of the NSW Government’s Shark Management Program implemented by the NSW Department of Primary In
bluejetty:00015688:ios.description:
Enjoy NSW beaches. Be SharkSmart.
The NSW Government’s SharkSmart app helps you stay informed before you hit the water in NSW. The app is part of the NSW Government’s Shark Management Program implemented by the NSW Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development (DPIRD). Check the latest shark alerts, Surf Life Saving NSW drone patrol observations, and tagged shark detections to better understand shark activity along the NSW coast.
With greater awareness and knowledge of sharks and their behaviour, everyone can enjoy NSW beaches while reducing the risk of a shark encounter.
The SharkSmart app provides real-time alerts, beach conditions, species information and helpful resources to keep you informed at NSW beaches.
Stay SharkSmart with our App.
Alerts & Notifications
Receive alerts for tagged shark detections, shark sightings, Surf Life Saving NSW and Surfing NSW drone patrol observations, beach closures and other safety incidents. Customise notifications for alerts around you, by region, by time, or for your favourite beaches.
New beach arrival notifications remind you when you are near the coast, with a quick link to today’s conditions and safety information.
Daily Updates give you a snapshot of shark activity and alerts across NSW, or focused on beaches around you and your favourited beaches.
Beach Status
Check conditions before you go with beach status and at-a-glance information for beaches near you or in your favourites. See weather, water quality, patrol information, safety advice, and other local conditions to help you plan your visit.
My Beaches
Save your favourite NSW beaches and get updates and alerts for the places you visit most. Manage your list, view beach details, daily conditions and recent shark alerts for each location.
Tagged Sharks
When a tagged shark is detected, tap through for richer detail than ever before, including when and where it was tagged, species information, recent detections, and the path the indicative shark has taken along the NSW coast. Data may include contributions from DPIRD and research partners.
Ask SharkSmart
Have a question about sharks, beach safety or the latest conditions at a particular beach? Ask SharkSmart is your AI assistant for SharkSmart-related questions. Get clear, helpful answers in a conversation-style experience, with links to relevant alerts, beaches and species where available.
Species
There are over 180 species of sharks in Australia, and the majority are relatively harmless. In terms of shark-human interactions, the three species responsible for almost all serious and fatal interactions are the white, bull, and tiger sharks, collectively referred to in NSW as the ‘target’ species of our Shark Management Program. Browse images and information on these target sharks, as well as non-target sharks and other marine animals that sting or bite, for education and identification.
Apple Watch Compatible
If you have an Apple Watch, the SharkSmart app includes a companion watch app that lets you receive SharkSmart alerts on your wrist. View alerts around you or set up notifications for a region, by time or for favourite beaches.
For more information visit: sharksmart.nsw.gov.au

Choose your case. Open the others. Decide when the offer is right.
DEAL OR CONTINUE is an exciting case-opening game where every choice can change the outcome. Twenty cases contain different prize values, ranging from 1 to 5,000,000.
Can you keep the highest prize in play, or will you accept the Banker’s offer?
HOW TO PLAY
▣ Choose one case to keep until the end.
▣ Open the remaining cases and reveal their values.
▣ Receive offers from the Banker throughout the game.
▣ Decide whether to make the deal or continue playing.
▣ Try to finish with the highest possible prize!
No questions to answer—just smart decisions, good timing, and a little luck.
Make the Deal or say No and Continue playing. The choice is yours!
All in-game prizes are virtual and have no real-world monetary value.

TreasuryViewer is a mobile app to buy and view your Treasury securities on Treasury Direct. We access TreasuryDirect.gov® and load the information for you. No more virtual keyboard nonsense or website trouble!
Buy and trade treasury bonds commission free through our interface.
This mobile app is not the official app for the US Government or TreasuryDirect®

- Make a TreasuryDirect® account on TreasuryDirect.gov®
- Login using our application to view previously purchased securities or to purchase treasury bills, treasury bonds, and savings bonds.
- We never access your data ­— the login happens completely on your phone
What’s inside the TreasuryViewer iOS app:
Biometrically protected login (or mobile pin) for easy and safe login access
Now with ID.me login supported!

- Treasury Bills (T-bills)
- Treasury Notes (T-notes)
- Treasury Bonds (T-bonds)
- Floating Rate Notes (FRNs)
- Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS)
- Series I Saving Bonds (Savings I Bonds)

Portfolio Breakdown
- See how much a security type contributes to your portfolio
- Download tax documents with a single press
Buy and Manage Orders
-Buy Treasury Bonds, Series I Bonds, Treasury Bills and More directly from your phone!
-Manage pending purchases of your Treasuries straight from your mobile device
Roadmap for upcoming features (contact us with what features you would like to see):
- More advanced portfolio statistics
- More Treasury Direct Features

Do you know how you sleep every night? 
SLEEP TRACKER is your intelligent sleep assistant, now available for FREE download. Our app combines a precise sleep recorder and sleep-talking tracker with a rich library of meditation sessions, immersive sleep stories, and soothing sounds, including white noise. By seamlessly syncing sleep watch data through Apple Health, SLEEP TRACKER provides deep insights into your sleep patterns and cycles. √ Learn your sleep depth and cycles
√ Explore your weekly & monthly sleep trends
√ Record and listen to your snore or dream talks
√ Relax yourself with sleep sounds, white noise, meditation
√ Wake you up gently by smart alarm clock
√ Log down your sleep notes & wake-up mood
√ Sync data to Apple Health
Top Reasons That You Should Download SLEEP TRACKER：
√ Feel excessively tired during the day while could not find reasons?
√ Suffer from insomnia and wish to stop sleeping with a racing mind?
√ Hope to be no longer groggy and function at your best in the morning?
√ Wish to know when you fell asleep and when you are pulled out of deep sleep?
√ Struggle to find a replacement for expensive sleep tracking devices?
√ Curious about your snoring, dream whispering or other voice during sleeping?
Who’s Using SLEEP TRACKER:
√ Working people under stress
√ Busy mom/dad
√ Overburdened students
√ Troubled sleepers
√ Frequent snorers
√ Sleep quality optimizers
√ Mindfulness pursuers
SLEEP TRACKER will make all your wishes above come true and bring you a more productive life you deserve. 
Well-designed Features:
View sleep cycles records
How is your nightly sleep quality? Viewing daily, weekly and monthly sleep reports, you can track your sleep at ease. No need to put your phone under the pillow. Placing your device nearby would suffice.
Listen to night voices
Are you curious about if you snore or talk in dreams at night? Get your nighttime voice recordings here. You can also share those funny recordings with your friends.
Aid Sleep with Relaxing Sounds & Music
Relax and fall asleep faster with our rich sleep music library. Explore our 200+ high-quality white noise and misic, from rain, ocean waves, fan sounds, to piano melodies.
Find Peace with Meditation & Sleep Stories

Customize smart alarm

Download SLEEP TRACKER today to end all of your sleep troubles. Feel its power to ease you into sleep and refresh you from waking. Sleep better, live better.

- Get unlimited access to all features for USD $19.99/year. 
- The payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.

apple-macos:6799410970.name: FluidNotes – Your Notebook
apple-macos:6799410970.description:
FluidNotes is a notebook for iPad and iPhone that feels like paper: write with Apple Pencil on iPad or with your finger on iPhone – and find everything again with search that reads your handwriting.
WRITING THAT FEELS RIGHT
• Ballpoint, fineliner, fountain pen, pencil, felt-tip, watercolour, highlighter and more, all pressure-sensitive
• Ruler, colour picker and custom colours on all your devices
• Hand-drawn shapes become clean circles, rectangles, lines and arrows
• Convert handwriting to typed text, with word suggestions as you write – on the device
• Cross out typed words to delete them
• Lasso: cut out exactly, colour, move, duplicate
• Zoom window: write large at the bottom, and it appears small on the page
ORGANISATION THAT GROWS WITH YOU
• Folders and subfolders, tags, favourites and bookmarks
• Headings automatically build an outline; links connect pages and notebooks, and a knowledge network shows topics and connections – in 3D too
• Search handwriting, typed text, PDFs, photos and recordings – through Spotlight too
• Collect the highlights of a PDF into an excerpt, with links back to the passage
• Lock notebooks with Face ID or a passcode
THE PAPER YOU WANT
• Lined, squared, dotted, planners, sheet music and more – in colour too; plus a whiteboard that grows
• Save your own pages as templates; import PDFs, Word, PowerPoint and Goodnotes
• Photos, document scans, GIFs, tables, mind maps and reusable building blocks
STUDY
• Flashcards with spaced repetition and a study plan across all notebooks, with a daily reminder if you like
• An exam date per deck, also as a proposal to the group; import and export decks as Anki packages or text files
• Flashcards from your handwriting: circle a question or sketch and turn it into a card
• Apple Watch: review due flashcards on your wrist, with a complication for the watch face
• Study time with breaks, on iPhone also on the Lock Screen
• Study tape: cover passages and test yourself
• With Apple Intelligence: flashcards, cloze exercises from A1 to C2, summaries and mind maps from your notes – and answers to questions about them
• The AI runs on the device only – no internet, no third-party AI service
STUDY GROUPS AND SHARING
• Study groups: join once and get every notebook of the group, including later ones
• Invite others to a notebook with a link or QR code – to write along or just to view
• Colour each person’s contributions and see what others have changed since your last visit
• Send a copy of a notebook or of single pages, with the recordings if you like – through a link that expires by itself
• Comments with replies; everyone shares the flashcards, each person keeps their own progress
RECORD AND PRESENT
• Record sound while you write; on playback, your note reappears stroke by stroke
• Transcripts on the device: search finds spoken words too
• Present on a projector or TV: only the current page, with a laser pointer
HANDY
• Quick Note from the app icon, as a widget, in Control Centre, with Siri or Shortcuts
• Widgets for recently opened notebooks and cards due
• Sync through your own iCloud and Handoff between iPhone, iPad and Mac
• Automatic backups to iCloud Drive; export as PDF, Markdown or FlexiNote package
• Select text in a PDF and translate it
• Optional: Zotero for PDFs, citations and the bibliography
• Getting started in five short exercises; help mode explains every button
YOUR NOTES BELONG TO YOU
FluidNotes has no server of its own and no account. No ads, no tracking, no analytics, no in-app purchases. Your notebooks live on your device and, if you like, in your own iCloud.
FluidNotes is a personal project, built with care. Questions and ideas: j.gomez@web.de

bluejetty:00200216:ios.description:
TV Jr. brings the live TV and movies you already have to iPhone and HomeView, in one simple app. It doesn't include any channels of its own.
Pick from Home, Channels or Library at the top. Choose something and it opens full screen; close it and it keeps playing in the mini player while you browse.
• HDHomeRun: find your tuner on Wi‑Fi and watch its antenna or cable channels, converted right on your iPhone. No DVR or server needed.
• Jellyfin: watch the movies and shows in your Jellyfin library. Sign in with Quick Connect, see Continue Watching and Recently Added, and pick up where you left off. Your place is saved back to Jellyfin.
• ErsatzTV: add your own custom channels in one tap.
• HomeView: Home, Channels and Library on HomeView too, playing full screen.
• What's on now: the current show and time left for HDHomeRun channels and playlists that publish a guide.
• Playlists: import an M3U playlist from your home media server and pick the channels you want. Links refresh automatically.
• Stream links: add a single live stream (.m3u8).
• Favorites, Recent channels, and sources you can turn on or off and reorder.
• iPhone Duo: open it up to watch on one side and browse on the other.
• Captions on HDHomeRun channels, AirPlay, and Picture in Picture.
• Light and dark mode. Your channels back up to your own iCloud.
Where streams come from: an HDHomeRun tuner on your network, your own Jellyfin or ErsatzTV server, your TV or internet provider, broadcasters that publish free live streams, or your own media server. Only add streams you have the right to watch.
Jellyfin is a trademark of the Jellyfin project; TV Jr. is not affiliated with it. Screenshots feature Big Buck Bunny and Tears of Steel, © Blender Foundation (blender.org), licensed under CC BY 3.0, and Caminandes, © Blender Foundation, licensed under CC BY.

fdroid:com.thothterm.arch.name: ThothTerm Rolling
fdroid:com.thothterm.arch.summary: An Arch Linux ARM AArch64 terminal environment on your phone. No root needed.
fdroid:com.thothterm.arch.description:
ThothTerm Rolling is an independent Android application that runs an Arch
Linux ARM AArch64 environment under PRoot, and a terminal to work in it. There
is no root, no virtual machine and no server somewhere else: the environment
runs on the phone itself, inside the app.
The environment is ordinary Arch Linux ARM userspace. pacman installs from
Arch Linux ARM's own repositories and checks every package's signature
against Arch Linux ARM's signing key; sudo is the distribution's sudo. The
environment is rolling: it arrives fully upgraded as of the moment it was
built, and "sudo pacman -Syu" keeps it current like any Arch Linux ARM
system. What you install stays installed across app updates, as does
everything in your home directory.
What you get
* Arch Linux ARM for AArch64, set up on first launch, with pacman ready: the
 app creates this installation's own package-signing keyring for you
* pacman and passwordless sudo for the user thoth
* Several terminal windows at once, with a window list
* Pinch-to-zoom and Zoom in / Zoom out / Reset
* An extra keys row: Esc, Ctrl, Alt, Tab, Home, End and the arrows
* Copy and paste, selection and scrollback
* Correct display of Arabic and other right-to-left text
* Upload files and folders from the phone into a terminal's current directory
* Keep screen awake, by hand or automatically while charging
* LAN Mode, to use the same environment from a web browser on another computer
LAN Mode
LAN Mode is off until you turn it on. While it is on, the app shows an address
and a one-time PIN; a browser on the same Wi-Fi or Ethernet network must pair
with that PIN before it gets anything. Every browser gets its own terminal,
and the windows on the phone are never shared. It does not listen on mobile
data or the Internet. Turning it off ends every browser's access. The
connection is plain HTTP: terminal traffic and uploaded files are not
encrypted in transit. Use it only on networks you trust.
First run
The F-Droid build does not include the Arch Linux ARM environment, so the
first launch offers to download it: about 200 MB from the project's GitHub
release. Nothing is downloaded until you agree. The download is checked
against a size and a SHA-256 checksum written into the app, and refused if
either differs. The archive holds only unmodified Arch Linux ARM packages,
each verified against Arch Linux ARM's signing key when it was built, by a
script in the app's source that anyone can rerun to get the same bytes.
A PRoot environment, not a booted system
Programs run as ordinary processes of the app. Package management and
command-line software work; services that need systemd running as PID 1
(systemctl) do not.
Requirements
* A 64-bit ARM phone (arm64-v8a), Android 8.0 or newer
* About 700 MB for the environment right after setup, plus what pacman's
 package databases and the software you install add
This app is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Arch
Linux or Arch Linux ARM projects. Arch Linux is a trademark of Levente Polyák
and Judd Vinet, on behalf of Arch Linux.
ThothTerm is free software under the Apache License 2.0, a fork of TermOne
Plus, which derives from Terminal Emulator for Android and the Android Open
Source Project. The PRoot runtime is built from source during the build. Its
licence and those of the Arch Linux ARM packages are listed in
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
